articleTitle: Short-term wind power prediction based on EMD-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Accurate wind power prediction plays a significant role in power system operation, safety analysis and consumption reduction. To make the most of the valid Consultation in the data and further improve the prediction accuracy of wind power, forecasting model based on empirical mode decomposition (EMD) and long short-term memory (LSTM) neural networks was submitted. Firstly, EMD was used to decompose the wind power data series into multiple sub-series to reduce the influences among diverse trend information. Then, LSTM was used to learn the historical time series of each sequence and complete the prediction. Finally, all prediction results are overlapping and reconstructed to acquire the final prediction of wind power. The proposed method was applied in the wind power prediction of the farm in the United States. The findings indicate that the proposed combined prediction method improves its prediction accuracy by 38.20% and smoothness by 39.19% compared with the current mainstream algorithm prediction, which has higher prediction accuracy and performance smoothness and reduces the interaction between information of different time scales.

articleTitle: A more accurate mask detection algorithm based on Nao robot platform and YOLOv7
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the global outbreak of Corona Virus Disease 2019(COVID-19), many countries had made it mandatory for people to wear masks in public places. This paper proposed a novel mask detection algorithm RMPC (Restructing the Maxpool layer and the Convolution layer)-YOLOv7 based on YOLOv7 for detecting whether people wear masks in public places. The RMPC-YOLOv7 algorithm reconstructed the downsampling structure in the original YOLOv7 algorithm. We changed the stacking of the maxpooling layer and the convolutional layer. This enabled the feature information to be fully integrated to achieve the accuracy improvement of the new model. Through comparison experiments, our proposed RMPC-YOLOv7 had was improved 0.9% and 1.2% for mAP0.5 and mAP0.5:0.95, respectively. The experimental results demonstrated the feasibility of RMPC-YOLOv7.

articleTitle: DES-Co-RSA: A Hybrid Encryption Algorithm Based on DES and RSA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The Internet is developing rapidly, which leads to a sharp increase in information transmitted by the network. Moreover, people have a higher demand for encrypting meetings and encrypting information transmission. Currently, the data encryption technologies used in network transmission mainly include symmetric encryption algorithms, asymmetric encryption algorithms, virtual network encryption technology, SSL protocol encryption, etc. However, the widely used symmetric encryption algorithm has some problems, such as complex distribution and complicated management of keys, while the asymmetric encryption algorithm generally has the disadvantages of slow encryption and decryption speed. The research and analysis of the typical symmetric encryption algorithm DES and asymmetric encryption algorithm RSA are studied to address this issue. This paper puts forward mixed cryptogram arithmetic of DES and RSA. The principle of the algorithm is that the sender encrypts the key of DES with RSA’s public key and then encrypts the plaintext with the new longer key by DES. The receiver can decrypt the encrypted key and ciphertext to obtain plaintext. The advantage of this hybrid algorithm is that RSA only needs to encrypt the short key of DES. Therefore, the encryption speed is improved greatly, and a longer new key is obtained, which makes the encryption result of DES more secure and reliable. The hybrid algorithm shows good performance through the code implementation and analysis of the results. Not only the encryption speed is fast, but the security is also guaranteed, and it has a favorable application prospect in digital signature and other fields.

articleTitle: A comparative study of machine vision-based rail foreign object intrusion detection models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Due to the lack of track foreign body intrusion dataset, classical target detection models are rarely used in the field of foreign body intrusion on railway tracks, and model comparison experiments are also insufficient. Aiming at these problems, this paper makes a comparative study on the application of yolov5 and fast RCNN in railway foreign object intrusion detection. First, the train and test dataset was established by image preprocessing, data cleaning and data labeling of UAV aerial images. Second, the canny edge detection algorithm combined with Hough transform was used to extract the track features for delineating the detection area. Finally, Yolov5 and fast RCNN, two widely used models, were used to train and test respectively based on our dataset for comparative studies. Experiment results show that YOLOv5 has better comprehensive performance in detection rate and detection speed, and Faster RCNN model cannot meet the requirements of real-time detection of track foreign objects intrusion.

articleTitle: Design of Facial Expression Recognition Algorithm Based on CNN Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved CNN model with the main process of face image preprocessing, face image feature extraction, input test sample training, acquisition of test sample features, face image feature classification, restoration of face expression images, and recognition results. In the convolution activation function, the cumulative sum operation is performed on three aspects of facial expression image pixels, the number of convolution operations, and the number of pooling operations, and a highly integrated facial expression image feature extraction is realized. It is merged with the pooling operation. In the classification loss function, two processes of convolution and pooling operations are considered, and the weight and bias updates in the convolution, pooling, and classification loss functions are included. Relevant experiments and experimental statistics show that the classification accuracy of the facial image expression feature extraction algorithm proposed in this paper is about 87%, and the recognition accuracy of the improved CNN facial expression recognition model proposed in this paper is about 88%.

articleTitle: THERP-CREAM Prediction Method for Human Failure Probability for Air Traffic Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: To Improve the human reliability of Air Traffic Control (ATC) for reducing the human error of air traffic controllers, a combined human failure probability prediction method based on THERP and CREAM is proposed. Based on binary tree model of THERP method, the basic context of incident development is constructed, and the trigger probability of each behavior is corrected on the basis of CREAM method, so as to get a more accurate probability prediction conclusion. Through the comparative analysis of similar incidents, the key incident impact factors can be identified to formulate targeted control measures, thus providing an effective analysis means for studying and predicting the failure probability of air traffic controllers.

articleTitle: Test and Analysis of Acoustic and Vibration Characteristics of Transformer in Winding and Iron Core Loose
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, a 10kV transformer sound vibration test platform was built in the semi-muffler chamber to test the sound and vibration of the normal state, winding loosing state and iron core loosing state, and compared and analyzed it. The analysis results show that the noise on the high-voltage side is larger than the same three sides, the noise in no-load condition is larger than the short-circuit and on-load conditions. The vibration test results show that the top vibration of the transformer is greater compared to other positions, the vibration level of no-load condition is larger than the short circuit and load conditions, also consistent with the rules of the noise test.

articleTitle: Parameter Identification of PMSMs Considering VSI Nonlinearity with Coupled Adaline NNs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel parameter identification method of permanent magnet synchronous motors (PMSMs). The parameters of the PMSM are identified by using Adaline neural networks designed to operate with two steady states obtained without signal injection or ad hoc tests. Furthermore, the voltage-source inverter nonlinearity is compensated to increase the accuracy of the parameter identification. The proposed identification procedure is suitable for offline as well as online implementation, overcoming the drawbacks of conventional parameter identification methods. The method is validated with both simulation and experimental data.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatchable Space Considering Aggregation of EV Swapping and Charging Stations to Participate in Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The electric vehicle battery swapping and charging station equipped with retired batteries energy storage system (RBESS-BSCS) can be used as a demand-side flexibility resource, to serve the power grid operations under the unified management and dispatched by their aggregator. A BSCS can be used as a time-sharing electricity price strategy for load response, and also as an incentive mechanism to participate in the demand response resources. An optimization model with the goal of maximizing the BSCS aggregation comprehensive income is constructed to obtain the optimal decision of the BSCS day-ahead charging plans and reporting to the power grid dispatching dispatchable space. Firstly, the operation principle of BSCS in aggregation mode is analyzed, and the state transition model of power battery (EVB) is proposed. On this basis, by considering the uncertainty of EV demand, CPLEX is used to solve the model. The optimization results show that BSCS aggregators can formulate charging plan and dynamic demand response space on the basis of meeting EV’s power replacement requirements. The results verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: An Ultra-Low Power Fast-Transient Response Capacitor-Less Low-Dropout Regulator (LDO)
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, an enhanced amplifier is employed for ameliorating the general performance of low-dropout regulators. The presented LDO possesses not only current boosting at the power transistor gate, but also improved voltage regulation of the LDO due to the combination of the Flipped Voltage Followers (FVFs) adaptive input structure and local common mode feedback (LCMFB) technique. Moreover, the realization comprehensive performance improvement of the LDO demands only 2 μA quiescent current, resulting in the current efficiency is greatly improved. The designed LDO is simulated in 0.18 μm process. From simulation experiments, the undershoot is 466 mV under the load switching response of 2 μA-100 mA within 500 ns edge time. Moreover, the current efficiency in this design is up to 99.99%.

articleTitle: An Anomaly Detection Approach of Part-of-Speech Log Sequence via Population Based Training
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Log data is a valuable resource for understanding system status. Log recording running status for a computer system is commonly used to identify performance issues and malfunctions. Sequential anomaly detection of logs is crucial for building a secure and stable system and is beneficial for the discovery, location, and analysis of system failures. In this paper, we propose a new log sequential anomaly detection method based on natural language processing techniques by the Population Based Training (PBT) algorithm, which can make full use of semantic information in log templates to analyze log sequences. The Part-of-Speech (PoS) weight mechanism is first employed to improve the digital representation quality of the log template in the feature extraction. And then, TextCNN is used to extract noteworthy information in log template vectors. In the sequence log anomaly detection stage, the combination of TextCNN and LSTM neural network can improve the accuracy of log sequential anomaly detection. On the other hand, the proposed method jointly trains the parameters of the PoS weight mechanism and the parameters of the anomaly detection neural network model through the PBT algorithm, which accelerates the model convergence speed and improves the accuracy of the log sequential anomaly detection. Our model has been tested on four data sets and compared with two state-of-the-art models to prove the effectiveness of our model. The experimental results show that, compared with other log anomaly detection methods, the proposed method performs well.

articleTitle: Prediction of Concrete Strength Based on Random Forest and Gradient Boosting Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The design of concrete proportion is directly related to the engineering performance and cost of concrete, and the conventional concrete proportion design method often requires a lot of trial-formulation practice, spending a lot of time and money to get a concrete proportion that meets the requirements. In this paper, it is proposed to use the technology of artificial intelligence to establish the prediction model of the compressive strength of concrete for the corresponding mix ratio to assist in the trial-formulation work in order to reduce the cost in the trial-formulation work.Based on regression model, especially Random Forest regression model and Gradient Boosting Machine, this paper uses 8 properties of cement, water and coarse aggregate to predict the compressive strength corresponding to the concrete mix proportion. The R-squared of the Random Forest regression model reached 0.9167, and the R-squared of the Gradient Boosting Machine reached 0.942.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Research on Network Information Security Service Model Based on User Requirements under Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper proposes a general network security framework based on artificial intelligence technology. Then the relationship between security objectives, security boundaries, security system elements, security services and security risk assessment are described. The modeling methods of security objectives, security boundaries and security system elements are given by using the power and universality of Unified Modeling language (UML). On the basis of building the network scenario, this paper sets up the association rules of network information security event detection and constructs the information security risk measurement model from the three perspectives of network database security vulnerability, data islanding risk and network security protection ability. Finally, a typical network example is given to analyze the application of the above model and algorithm in network security evaluation and optimal active defense. The analysis results show that the model and method presented in this paper are feasible and effective.

articleTitle: To study the sandstorm’s influence on high voltage transmission network based on the weather characteristics in northwestern area in China
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In recent years, Sandstorm occurred frequently in the northwest of China, which caused a serious impact on the industry, agriculture and daily life of residents in many provinces of northwest of China. Especially the insulation of the high voltage transmission line is prominent, which caused many large area flasticity accidents. The impact of sandstorm on transmission lines is mainly reflected in the impact on insulator strings and the line itself during transit and the surface area of insulator strings is polluted after transit due to the significant increase in the content of solid particles such as wind-blown sand and salt minerals, thus affecting the pollution lightning voltage. On the one hand, during the sandstorm transit, due to the influence of strong winds, the insulator string swings and the dielectric constant of the medium between the air gaps changes, which is more prone to wind deflection flashover. In addition, due to the great changes in the working environment of the wire, the corona loss in the transmission process also increases sharply. On the other hand, the flashover voltage of insulator string will be reduced after sandstorm transit because of surface area pollution, and once snow, fog, rain and other weather occur after sandstorm transit, the water content of dust on insulator surface will increase, which will have a serious impact on the insulation level outside the line. This paper comprehensively analyzes the influence of sandstorm weather on various aspects of high-voltage transmission lines, and refers to a large number of existing literature and existing research results, and makes a relatively comprehensive analysis of these influencing factors.

articleTitle: The Pacific Wave Advanced Network Backbone: An Emulation Approach Under IPv6
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Nowadays almost all countries have its own advanced network, but few organizations use their capabilities. So, cooperation interconnecting some advanced networks even to the regional level helps to share and contribute to projects in a collaborative way. This is the case of many countries in the Pacific, integrating their education and research networks. The backbone of Pacific Wave has evolved from 1 to 100 Gbps links, involving backbone and high-performance infrastructure. Nowadays this network interconnects 29 countries through 45 backbone routers for developing several collaboration projects. In this work, to study the pacific wave advanced network, the GNS3 emulator was used to make an approach for connectivity and management using IPv6 protocols, such as OSPFv3, BGPv4 and SNMPv3. The capabilities and limitations of the emulator and Pacific Wave are shown as results, mainly when emulating different file transfers which are of the interest of ISP companies.

articleTitle: Research on the Innovation System of Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology in Museum Financial Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper designs a museum financial management system based on computer artificial intelligence technology. The system introduces RPA technology to automatically collect, identify and classify image data of image recognition, speech recognition and original documents to help improve the efficiency of voucher entry and audit. This paper focuses on the general ledger management certificate of museum financial sharing service center to optimize the design of financial process automation. The system realizes the concentration and integration of business and financial activities through the process reengineering of financial fund settlement, accounting, budget preparation and financial analysis of the museum, so as to improve the quality of financial information disclosure, budget management and internal control efficiency of the museum.

articleTitle: An Improved Cartoon Character Avatar Generation Algorithm Based on GAN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Aimed at solving the problems of poor diversity of generated results and generally blurred images in traditional image generation methods, an improved cartoon character avatar generation algorithm WGAN-GP based on GAN is proposed. During the process, this method is used for generating image. By using transposed convolutional layers and inserting BN layers in the middle of each convolutional layer to define activation function as Leaky_ReLU as well as using Wasserstein distance instead of JS divergence as the adversarial loss function of the network and choosing RMSProp as the optimizer, improvements of our method are realized. The experimental results show that, the improved model solves the problems that the network is difficult to converge and the model is easy to collapse, and improves its generation diversity. Meanwhile, the details and texture of the generated images are clear and close to the sample set, which proves the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Identification of VSI Nonlinearity in IoT-Embedded PMSM Drives Using FFT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel method to identify the voltage-source inverter (VSI) nonlinearity in internet-of-things (IoT)-embedded permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) drives. The accuracy of existing online approaches for the identification of the VSI distorted voltage is limited by additional harmonic distortion of the voltage references caused by phenomena not considered in the PMSM model. Moreover, methods that rely on the direct compensation of the VSI nonlinearity in the PMSM control scheme cannot be easily implemented in commercial drives since the firmware of the control unit is generally not customizable. The proposed method is designed for contexts in which commercial PMSM drives generate data that are collected and stored in cloud data lakes and custom algorithms cannot be implemented on the drive control unit. To overcome the drawbacks of the existing online approaches, the fast Fourier transform is adopted to compute only the 6-th harmonic components of the d-axis distorted coefficient and d-axis voltage reference corrected using the estimated q-axis stator inductance. The method is validated by using data generated with an accurate Simulink model of a high-speed PMSM drive and comparisons with other methods are provided to show the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Research on Bearing Fault Diagnosis Based on SPWVD and Grid Optimization CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Bearing diagnosis is essential in mechanical operation. However, the traditional bearing fault diagnosis has the problems of a large amount of data and weak signal characteristics. This paper proposes an improved method based on a time-frequency graph and grid, which is applied to bearing fault diagnosis under different conditions. The method firstly changes the SPWVD time-frequency diagram of the original data to eliminate the cross interference term and optimize the quadratic time-frequency distribution; Secondly, inputs the time-frequency map to the CNN network for training; Thirdly, the grid method is used to search the learning rate and the number of batch samples of CNN, and the best parameters are obtained. Finally, the optimal fault diagnosis model is obtained by setting the CNN parameters with the optimal parameters. The result of the example analysis shows that the method proposed in this paper improves the accuracy by 5.2% compared with the traditional method and has more advantages in diagnosis.

articleTitle: An Underwater Wireless Sensor Network Localization Algorithm Based on Salp Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Underwater wireless sensor networks (UWSNs) are widely used in the fields of underwater environment monitoring and ocean data collection, and the accurate location of nodes is the basis for the network to be widely used. However, the stratification effect underwater and the limitations of traditional localization algorithms can affect the localization accuracy, so this paper proposes a high-precision localization algorithm for underwater wireless sensor networks. Firstly, to compensate for the sound ray bending caused by the underwater stratification effect, gradient sound ray tracing is used. Secondly, the salp swarm algorithm is improved in terms of introducing coarse estimates in the initial population, dynamically limiting the range of the salp movement and adopting inertia weight following strategy in conjunction with the actual underwater wireless sensor network. Based on the above improvements to accelerate the convergence speed of the localization algorithm and improve the local search capability. Finally, the numerical simulation using ARGO measured hydroacoustic parameters shows that the proposed algorithm can effectively reduce the node ranging error, accelerate the node localization process, and improve the localization accuracy and success rate of unknown nodes in the case of underwater medium stratification.

articleTitle: An improved YOLOX method for surface defect detection of steel strips
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: During the production process of steel strips, various surface defects are caused by processing technology and environmental factors. Therefore, detecting such defects is the key to ensure the high quality of steel strips. To solve this, an improved method based on YOLOX is proposed. Firstly, the coordinate attention block is embedded into the backbone for enhancing the modeling capability. Secondly, the Varifocal loss is adopted to solve the foreground-background class imbalance problem and predict the IoU-aware classification score as the detection ranking criterion. Finally, the CIoU loss is applied to the regression branch to improve defect location performance. The experimental results on the GC10-DET dataset show that the improved YOLOX method reaches 70.5% mAP at 28.4 FPS. Compared with existing advanced detection methods, the improved YOLOX method can accomplish better speed-accuracy trade-off.

articleTitle: A Smoking Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOV5
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In a public place, smoking will cause potential hazards to the health of oneself and other people, and also cause hidden dangers such as fire. Therefore, for the sake of health and safety, an algorithm based on YOLOV5 is proposed to quickly detect smoking behavior in hospitals, schools, stations and other places where smoking is prohibited. The detection algorithm improves the capacity for the model to detect smoking effectively by improving the feature extraction network. By replacing the C3 module in the feature extraction network with the CoT module, the ability of the model detection is effectively enhanced. CBAM attention mechanism is inserted in front of SPPF structure in feature extraction network, which effectively improves its ability to mine target features. Through experimental comparison, the improved algorithm has a certain enhancement effect in the ability and real-time of detection.

articleTitle: Stock Market Forecasting Method Based on LSTM Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Stock investment is a low barrier but high-risk approach of investing, which requires lots of knowledge and experience for investors in order to earn money. The work in this paper enables investors who do not meet the above conditions to still make accurate investment actions with the predicted output given by the model. In this paper, ten years of historical data of Amazon was used to train the LSTM model, then different candidates of model architecture were attempted to test out the optimal one for predicting the stock close price of Amazon and evaluated. It was observed in the result that the model with more neurons in each hidden layers and less LSTM layers and Dense layers showed a higher accuracy and a more stable forecast. In the other hand, the numbers of historical data memorized did matter. The less memory days could result in a smaller mean absolute percentage error.

articleTitle: Image-based Apple Disease Detection Based on Residual Neural Network and Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Apple planting is an important part of China's agricultural economy. With the progress of computer technology, China, as the first apple planting country in the world, also needs to change to a digital and intelligent working mode. As apples are easy to be attacked by various diseases and pests during planting, and the early pathological changes mainly occur in leaves, especially mottle leaf disease, gray spot disease, rust and cedar rust. How to find these diseases in time and quickly make accurate classification is the key to subsequent treatment. In this paper, Based on the ResNet50 network architecture, the attention mechanism is added to design the new work model needed to improve the accuracy of disease identification. Aiming at the problem of small sample size of apple tree disease image dataset, we uses the idea of transfer learning to upgrade the network model training process. The network model is trained according to the set training strategy to increase the convergence speed and the working accuracy of the network model. Compared with other traditional classification methods, it is proved that the detection method based on ResNet50 network model in convolutional neural network is more effective.

articleTitle: A Common-Mode Voltage Suppression Oriented Modulation Method for Modular Multilevel Converters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Modular multilevel converter (MMC) has become the mainstream topology of flexible DC transmission and is widely used in many fields. But since MMC has lots of sub-modules (SMs), power electronic devices will generate high dv/dt and di/dt in the high-frequency switching process, and then generate serious common-mode interference through the parasitic capacitance to ground. By analyzing the traditional nearest level modulation (NLM), this paper proposes a modulation method that divides the area on the basis of the number of ON-state SMs, which is area-division nearest level modulation (ADNLM). Finally, the availability of the proposed method in suppressing the common-mode voltage is verified by comparing the output waveform and common-mode voltage waveform using different methods through simulation.

articleTitle: Analysis of High Gain DC-DC Converters for DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: DC microgrids are considered a key component of smart grids, which will make the power grids more reliable, obtain good power quality and system energy efficiency, and provide the possibility of being independent of the grid for individual users. Compared with traditional power grids, DC microgrids have the advantages of enhancing combinations of distributed and renewable energy and reducing energy consumption. There are many applications in real life. It is significant to apply high-gain DC-DC converters in specific conditions in order to increase voltages of low-voltage DC power sources like photovoltaic power sources and small wind turbines in DC microgrids. This paper describes the basic principles, voltage gain formulas, and components used and their quantities in the classical boost converter, Double-Duty-Triple-Mode converter, and quadratic voltage gain converter, compares and analyzes these parameters, analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of these converters, and obtains the results to draw conclusions in the end of the paper.

articleTitle: Comparison of CNN Models in Non-small Lung Cancer Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Since the traditional manual method of classifying lung cancer CT photos is very time-consuming, a new automated, highly accurate classification method is urgently needed. This has led to the use of the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for image classification and recognition as the best choice in the medical field. However, due to the problem of vanishing gradient when the layer depth of these models is too deep, the gradient will be vanishingly small and this leads to extremely low learning efficiency, which may even be close to 0. In this paper, a reimplemented CNN model based on ResNet is used to improve low learning efficiency. Three different CNNs are also compared and illustrate that the deeper neural networks have better learning efficiency and higher accuracy for classifying lung CT images. Specifically, LeNet, AlexNet, and ResNet are reimplemented, where the first two CNNs represent traditional models. By comparing the accuracy of the three models, we conclude that the traditional model is sufficient for the task of classifying lung cancer models and has an acceptable accuracy rate when the number of training sessions reaches a certain level, but it is not competitive in learning efficiency and accuracy for the same number of training sessions compared to the subsequent models with more neurons.

articleTitle: Detection of Pneumonia Based on ResNet Improved by Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In recent years, Covid-19 is one of the major health challenges facing the human population. Due to the highly infectious nature of Covid-19 and the difficulty of detecting symptoms in the early stages, it is definitely necessary to combine X-ray for the diagnosis of pneumonia. Using traditional neural networks such as VGG, ResNet, and DenseNet to diagnose pneumonia based on X-ray images faces a number of difficulties. These models have insufficient spatial information extraction capability and are prone to overfitting on the training set. The attention mechanism is a means to improve model performance by helping the model better extract channel and spatial features from the feature maps. To identify pneumonia more accurately, we combined the ResNet network and CBAM attention mechanism to design the ResNet101-cbam model with a series of data augmentation methods as well as training strategies. We used the same approach to add attention mechanisms to ResNet50, ResNet101 and ResNet152 and tested their performance. The results show that ResNet101-cbam is the best performing model overall. It achieved a recall of 0.8205, a precision of 0.822, and an accuracy of 0.8285 on the test set, while the original pretrained ResNet101 had a precision of 0.7280 and an accuracy of 0.7644. Its performance were better than the more complex model: ResNet152-cbam, a little bit, but the training speed is improved by more than 25%. More importantly, the model with the added attention mechanism effectively overcomes the effects of positive and negative sample imbalance. The ResNet101-cbam model can be used as a medical aid, which can improve diagnostic efficiency and help us better deal with large-scale pneumonia epidemics.

articleTitle: Object detection of double-sided copper laminates based on YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: A YOLOv5-based object detection inventory algorithm was proposed to address the problem of low efficiency and high cost of inventorying the number of stacked compact double-sided laminates by manual means. The algorithm first collected images of laminates in a real factory environment and annotated them with the network; then constructed a double-sided copper clad laminate inspection dataset with a real application background and trained the dataset with the YOLOv5 object detection inventory algorithm to obtain a training model; finally, detected the number of laminates inventoried based on the validation set. The experimental data verified that the trained model could achieve 99% accuracy in detecting different numbers of sheets in stacked scenarios, which own more advantageous than manual inventory methods in terms of both detection accuracy and speed. The results show that the proposed YOLOv5-based object detection counting algorithm is reasonable, feasible and effective for counting stacked compact double-sided copper clad laminates.

articleTitle: Edge detection and processing method of plant root image based on joint wavelet transform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The root system of the plant has the function of conserving water source, absorbing nutrients and preventing wind and sand fixation. The outline of the plant root system is an important parameter, which can extract the characteristics of the diameter and length of the plant root system. Therefore, it is very important to find a fast and accurate method for detecting the edge of plant root system. In this paper, the classical edge detection operator method is combined with the image sharpening and enhancement processing method of wavelet transform for edge detection, and Sobel operator and Canny operator are selected for edge detection in spatial domain. The wavelet transform was used for high-pass filtering in the frequency domain to sharpen and enhance the image, and Labelme software was used for image contour annotation. This paper proposed method can extract the edge contour more accurately.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of the Automatic Sorting System Based on PLC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Automatic material sorting is widely used in enterprise automatic production line, product assembly line and automated warehouse. Compared with traditional manual sorting, automatic sorting has the advantages of high efficiency, low error rate, many sorting points, unmanned industrial operation, etc. The control system of automatic sorting device is the core of the sorting device. This paper presents an automatic material sorting system based on PLC and pneumatic control, and completes the design of PLC control system and pneumatic control system. The automatic separation system is controlled by PLC of Mitsubishi FX2N series. The system is mainly composed of material feeding module, material handling module, material conveying module and separation module. The experimental results show that the system has high sorting accuracy, stable operation and meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: Cable Fault on-Line Monitoring Based on Transient Traveling Wave Signal Analysis Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper mainly studies a fault identification and location technology for optical cable lines using transient traveling wave mode maxima method, which mainly includes the following steps: real-time monitoring and synchronous upload of traffic information; Information collection and preservation; Cable fault identification, including: current oscillogram drawing, fractal box dimension calculation, current information space transformation, discrete wavelet transform and wavelet coefficient calculation for flow information in mode space, inspection of maximum point of initial traveling wave mode of flow information, and cable fault identification; Cable fault location, including: drawing of current oscillogram, spatial transformation of current information β The module voltage component and the module voltage component of the flow information on the load side are calculated using discrete wavelet transform and wavelet coefficients. The maximum point of the initial traveling wave mode of the flow information is checked, and the cable fault is located. The technical process of this paper is simple, the calculation method is simple, the accident identification and location efficiency is high, the accuracy is good, the technology is comprehensive, and the application is strong.

articleTitle: Optimization of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Speed and Rotor Position Detection Based on High Frequency Pulsation Voltage Injection Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Permanent magnet synchronous motor is an important power device in industrial system. To enhance its performance at idle speed, this paper designs a new rotor observer using the conventional voltage signal injection method as a reference. A generalized second-order integrator with center frequency adaptively varying according to the speed is used to extract the response signal of currents, and a square-wave signal with the same frequency as the injected signal and the extracted signal are multiplied instead of a low-pass filter. The simulation model was then built and tested, and after continuous testing it was found that using the new rotor observer designed reduces the speed convergence time by 0.79 s when the motor is started at no load and by 0.6 s when running a sudden load increase at constant speed. It reduces the position error by 0.29 rad when running a speed switch at no load and reduces the position error by 0.11 rad and the speed error by 0.24 r/min when running a sudden load increase at constant speed. The observer designed in this paper can reduce the speed convergence time and rotor position error, has better dynamic performance, and has certain application value.

Author Keywords: high frequency pulsation voltage injection method

articleTitle: Tesla Model S Induction Motor Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The induction motor in the Tesla Model S electric car is very mysterious, so this article attempts to introduce a basic model that considers the problem across multiple disciplines: kinematics, Newtonian mechanics, induction motors, numerical methods, and induction motors for electric drive control. This paper proposes three different steady-state torque-speed curves for the induction motor and analyzes its field weakening operation mode. We propose a mathematical description of the torque and speed curves of an induction motor, which can be applied to vehicle motion modeling. An electromechanical equation also integrates the moment of inertia of the induction motor rotor and the mass of the electric vehicle. The mathematical model analyzes the motion of the Model S electric vehicle as well as the connection between the mechanical gearbox and the induction motor.

articleTitle: An Efficient Face Recognition Method Based on CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: As a prevailing research in artificial intelligence, the application of computer vision is widely used in many fields which are closely related to people's livelihood, such as industrial automation, new retail industry, smart transportation and security monitoring. And the proposed face recognition method is a branch in the field of computer vision, it integrates neural networks, biology, image signal processing, machine learning and other fields, which promote research and cross-development among different disciplines. Hence, this paper focuses on face recognition method by using convolutional neural network(CNN), and CNN has the property of "weight sharing", which has been widely popularized in image recognition, it can greatly simplify the work of large-scale network training. The experiments demonstrate that the proposed face recognition method is successful, and the accuracy of the proposed method can be as high as 98%.

articleTitle: Short-term electricity sales forecasting model based on wavelet decomposition and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Accurate forecasting of electricity sales is very important to promote the development and construction of the electricity market. Considering the characteristics of non-stationary, non-linear and time-varying electricity sales, a prediction model based on wavelet transform and LSTM algorithm is proposed. Firstly, a transformation method with both time domain and frequency domain information, wavelet transform, is adopted to decompose the electricity sales data into detailed and approximate components; then the LSTM model is used to predict each component to obtain preliminary prediction results, and then the NPGARCH model is used to correct the prediction results; finally, the predicted results are accumulated to obtain the final prediction results. The analysis of the prediction results based on the historical statistical electricity sales data using a real data set of an electricity sales company shows that the prediction model based on wavelet decomposition and the LSTM algorithm has good prediction accuracy.

Author Keywords: long and short-term memory neural networks
nonparametric generalized autoregressive conditional heteroskedasticity model

articleTitle: Based on the LDA - RBF Electric Power Information Network Security Situational Awareness
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Aiming at the threat of power information network attack, a situation awareness method of LDA-RBF is proposed and applied to power information network security. Firstly, the linear discriminant analysis (LDA) is used to optimize the sample data of power information network, and the feature indexes are effectively fused and extracted to obtain the best projection, so that the samples have the best separability; Then the preprocessed data is used as the training data of RBF neural network to realize the security situation awareness of power information network and identify the intrusion attacks existing in power information network. In this paper, the KDDCup99 dataset and the network attack data under the electric power information network environment are used to simulate the method proposed in this paper. The comparison results verify that the network security situation awareness method based on LDA-RBF proposed in this paper can achieve more accurate and efficient network security situation awareness.

articleTitle: A Method for Improving Transient Response of the Source Measure Unit Based on PID+LPF Controller
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The current NI SourceAdapt technology is unable to effectively eliminate overshoot, shorten rise time and settling time of the transient response in a source measure unit (SMU). A method based on the proportion-intergration-differentiation controller with a low pass filter is proposed to improve the performance of the transient response. The method utilizes Simulink to establish simulation models of the SMU and PID+LPF controller, takes advantage of PID Tuner to determine PID+LPF parameters, and implements the controller in terms of Verilog HDL program. In the condition that transient response of the PID+LPF controller tested in Modelsim is consistent with the simulation result in Simulink, the Verilog HDL program is downloaded to FPGA to realize PID+LPF controller. Demonstration of the method on HP6633A SMU shows that PID+LPF controller, compared to NI SourceAdapt technology, can significantly improve rapidity and stability of the transient response in a SMU.

articleTitle: A multi-objective optimization model of robot path planning under different scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the rapid development of logistics industry, path planning of mobile robots has been widely concerned. The main purpose of this paper is to solve the problem of path planning for autonomous mobile robots in static environment. The problem can be solved by determining a collision-free path that satisfies the selected criteria of shortest distance and path smoothness. The proposed multi-objective path planning model aims at scientific and reasonable path planning for mobile robots to increase the path smoothness and reduce the moving distance. Firstly, according to the characteristics of obstacles, two groups of different robot workspace scenarios were set from the degree and density of obstacles. Secondly, a multi-objective nonlinear programming model is established to maximize path smoothness and minimize path distance. Finally, different scenarios are simulated, and a fast non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm based on elite strategy (NSGAII) is used to solve the model. Simulation results show that the multi-objective path planning model established in this paper can generate an optimal feasible path even in a complex environment, so as to overcome the shortcomings of traditional methods such as grid method. Moreover, compared with recent path planning techniques, the proposed multi-objective evolutionary algorithm is highly competitive in path optimization.

articleTitle: Inverter fault diagnosis algorithm based on midpoint voltage deviation polarity and topology reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper proposes a fault diagnosis method of three-phase inverter based on pulse transform. Firstly, the voltage between DC side midpoint and AC side midpoint is used to detect the occurrence of open circuit fault and judge the upper and lower position of the fault tube. Then the pulse signal of the three-phase inverter is adjusted to transform the circuit and the change of the midpoint voltage is detected in real-time to achieve the judgement of the faulty tube phase, Thus, the faulty tube location is realized. Compared with the previous diagnosis method based on voltage, this method reduces the use of devices, only needs to detect a midpoint voltage to achieve diagnosis and the diagnosis speed is fast. The feasibility of the proposed fault diagnosis method is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Optimal Allocation of Demand Response and Energy Storage Load in Agricultural Systems Considering Distributed PV Power Consumption
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to improve the photovoltaic (PV) consumption rate and economy, a PV-accessible capacity assessment model for agricultural systems is established. Taking a village in north China as the research object, the most economical premise is obtained by comparison. The comprehensive planning of battery energy storage and demand response in the distribution network is proposed. The results show that the improvement strategy proposed in this paper is effective in reducing the installed capacity of demand response and increasing the total revenue of agricultural networks, thus improving the local absorption capacity of PV power in agricultural systems.

articleTitle: Proposal and Design of Filtering 0°/180° Phase Shifter for Modern Wireless Communications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, a fixed response 3.5-GHz filter-integrated SPDT switch with ripple bandwidth (RBW) of 195 MHz is designed using capacitively coupled LC resonators. The switch consists of five capacitively coupled LC resonators and four groups of P-I-N diodes, and three ports all use a 50 feeder circuit. The ports’ opening and closing are controlled by controlling the forward or reverse bias of the diodes. However, p-i-n diodes have a certain influence on the state channel. Then, four sets of P-I-N diodes are replaced with their equivalent circuit in the design. Based on this, a new design scheme of 0°/180° filter phase shifter for modern wireless communication is proposed. The working state of the phase shifter is changed by changing the diode state. The electric length of the transmission line used in this design can effectively avoid series resonance. At the same time, the transmission lines in this design are far away from each other to prevent coupling. Moreover, the filter function of the phase shifter allows it to filter out other rf signals effectively and realize a more accurate phase shift of useful RF signals. Simulation results show that the design has a better reflection coefficient and higher isolation degree, and has a relatively small circuit size. The design simulation and physical test results will be presented and analyzed at the end of the article.

articleTitle: Intelligent Home IoT Intrusion Detection System Based on RISC-V
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper analyzes the security requirements of smart home IoT system, and constructs its intrusion detection system environment on RISC-V. By simulating the attack behavior, the key nodes of the Internet of Things are tested for intrusion detection and warning. The test results show that the deployment of intrusion detection system in smart home IoT can effectively improve its security.

articleTitle: Application of Transient Traveling Wave Technology in Fault Location and Condition Monitoring of Collecting Line in Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper mainly studies a multi terminal traveling wave fault location scheme of distribution network using path search method. First, a new matrix expression of distribution network topology is constructed. Through broken line search in the matrix, all shortest propagation paths of transient fault traveling wave are found, and then all transient traveling wave signals collected at each end of the distribution network are integrated to achieve accurate fault location. This paper has the advantages of quickly and accurately determining the fault location, reducing the workload of manual line patrol, and improving the efficiency of fault finding.

articleTitle: A novel approach for obstacle avoidance maneuverer controls to a 49ton autonomous drive heavy-duty truck in GCV
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper presents a novel obstacle avoidance maneuver for a 49-ton heavy duty truck in a narrow campus environment, which is surrounded by a narrow two-way street. In the beginning of the paper, the autonomous drive system implemented in the GCV (Geely Commercial Vehicle) project are introduced. The proposed planning algorithm combine a state machine and lateral sample method to achieve a balance between real-time functionality and controllability. To simplify the path planning process, a global path from routing module is used as a reference path for vehicle to follow if there’s no obstacle exists. Planning algorithm calculates a feasible local path based on the reference path and avoids obstacles on the reference path. Our test shows that our method is easier to calibration, quicker and safer comparing to an A star search method, which is widely used in autonomous robot domain.

articleTitle: Research on the Casing System of Big Data Information Security Management and Control Platform of Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper proposes a scheme to design the information security terminal architecture of the power mobile Internet of Things based on the background of big data. Firstly, this paper proposes the overall architecture of secure terminal and designs the functions of user layer, perception layer, network layer and application layer. Then this paper uses Hadoop technology, wireless communication, Internet technology, sensor technology and so on to give the system big data storage and terminal collection solutions. Finally, this paper constructs the system database and analyzes the operation mode of the power monitoring system network with the support of hardware equipment and data. This paper uses big data technology to collect and process real-time network data. The experimental results show that the information security evaluation parameters of the proposed architecture are higher than those of the conventional architecture, which can strengthen the information protection ability of the power Internet of Things.

articleTitle: Electricity charge anomaly detection based on PCA-IK-means
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to quickly and accurately mine the user's electricity bill anomaly from the massive electricity bill data, a PCA-IK means based electricity bill anomaly detection method is proposed. First of all, the principal component analysis method is used to extract the main features that reflect the electricity bill and achieve data dimensionality reduction. The traditional K-means randomly initializes the cluster center, which is difficult to obtain accurate clustering results. Therefore, K-means algorithm based on improved density peak optimization is proposed to improve the clustering accuracy. The extracted principal components are used as the input of improved K-means, and the output is the abnormal detection of electricity charges. The simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Wireless Sensor Networks Coverage Based on Fruit Fly Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In the coverage of wireless sensor networks, there are some problems in the coverage rate, node energy loss, etc., so this paper proposes a coverage optimization method of WSN based on Fruit Fly Optimization Algorithm. FOA network model is established and analyzed based on fruit flies optimization algorithm of wireless sensor network coverage optimization process, the Smell value of individual fruit fly is introduced. Find out the individual fruit fly with the highest Smell value in population of fruit flies and its corresponding density, group of fruit flies to the fruit flies the coordinates of individual mobile location, complete iteration, so as to improve coverage; In addition, the aspect of energy is improved by setting an energy value for each node in the area to be measured. Energy is consumed in the process of moving, covering and calculating each iteration. With the increase of iteration rounds, when one node energy is lower than a certain threshold, it will stop iterating and the remaining energy will be retained. In this way, the energy loss of the node is avoided on the basis of ensuring the coverage, the number of dead nodes is reduced, the lifetime of the wireless sensor network is prolonged, and the comprehensive performance of WSN is improved.

articleTitle: Distribution system reliability assessment method considering integrated energy system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The interconnection operation between distribution system (DS) and integrated energy system (IES) is an important development direction, which has a profound impact on the reliability of energy supply. In order to evaluate the reliability of DS more accurately, a reliability assessment method of DS considering the impact of IES access is proposed. Firstly, the IES-DS joint system is modeled; Secondly, the load reduction models of IES and DS are established respectively; Then, the analysis target cascading (ATC) method is used to solve the load reduction problem of the joint system and the reliability index of IES-DS joint system is calculated based on Markov chain Monte Carlo.

articleTitle: Research on contour extraction and edge detection of sugarcane image based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Using image processing technology to study sugarcane image contour extraction and edge detection methods has important research value and practical application significance for realizing pre-seed sugarcane planter to complete the seeding task stably, quickly, accurately and efficiently. In this regard, with the help of the MATLAB platform, this paper uses the hollowing out internal point algorithm to achieve the contour extraction of the sugarcane image, and uses five more classic edge detection operators for the same original sugarcane image to realize the edge detection of the sugarcane image. Analyze the results and draw the conclusion that Canny operator is the most suitable and effective edge detection operator for sugarcane image edge detection. This also provides an important reference for subsequent monitoring of the seeding status and efficiency of the precut sugarcane planter.

articleTitle: Research on natural disaster target change detection method based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In recent years, with the increasing global climate problems, our country has been relying on remote sensing technology for early warning and post-disaster assessment in the field of disaster prevention and control for some time. However, there are many kinds of natural disasters, especially sudden natural disasters, such as earthquakes, floods, typhoons and mudslides, which are often too late to prevent, and there is also a strong recurrence between disasters, which is very likely to cause massive data interference to remote sensing recognition. Compared with the traditional convolutional neural network-based remote sensing image recognition processing, this project proposes to use the Faster-RCNN target detection algorithm, which adds the Region Proposal Networks (RPN) module to the traditional Fast CNN to generate the algorithm, making the target change detection speed and accuracy greatly improved. The change detection algorithm is based on the traditional Fast CNN. This change detection model has the natural advantage of processing remote sensing data, which can automatically and multi-levelly extract the features of complex objects, learn to discover the geometric and spatial relationships of feature targets in images from massive data, and solve complex classification or regression problems through multi-layer nonlinear networks, thus significantly improving the accuracy of remote sensing image interpretation. After the model design is completed, in order to improve the detection accuracy of the model, it is proposed to train the Faster-RCNN change detection model by acquiring a large number of original samples of remote sensing images with manually expanded samples.

articleTitle: Semantic similarity detection based on knowledge augmentation for short text
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The task of semantic similarity detection is crucial to natural language processing. Deep learning-based word embedding with text-matching models has improved the accuracy of spotting semantic similarities in recent years. However, traditional word embedding techniques cannot deal with polysemy sufficiently. In order to improve the quality of the semantic similarity detection for short text, this paper proposed a method based on knowledge augmentation. Here HowNet, as the tool for knowledge augmentation, is introduced integrating pre-trained BERT with fine-tuning and attention mechanisms. Experiments on two Chinese datasets show that the proposed method outperforms a variety of typical text similarity detection methods.

articleTitle: Research on the Life Cycle Carbon Emission Model of Wind-Solar-Storage Hybrid Power Generation System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper determines the carbon emission system boundary of the the wind-solar-storage hybrid power generation system based on the life cycle assessment(LCA) method, and divides its full life cycle into five stages, namely raw material production, transportation, construction, operation and maintenance, and waste recycling stages. Then identify the carbon emission inventory of each stage and build the carbon emission model of each stage, so as to achieve the full life cycle carbon emission model of wind-solar-storage hybrid power generation system. Finally, an example is given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Electricity load forecasting based on long and short-term memory neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Efficient and accurate power load forecasting is extremely significant to the safety and stability of power systems and dispatching operations. In order to fully exploit the influence of multivariate data information on load forecasting accuracy, in this paper, a short-term load prediction method based on long-term short-term memory neural network is proposed. First, to reduce the influence of diverse magnitudes on the accuracy of load prediction, the relevant factors affecting the load change are normalized; then, the trained LSTM-based load prediction model is tested; finally, different methods are used to realize the short-term prediction of electric load and the predictive precision is compared. Taking the actual load data of a certain area for instance, the results suggest that the proposed method could more accurately track the future trend of electric load than other algorithms.

articleTitle: A Novel Attitude Feature Extraction Method for Multi-IMU Based Fall Detection System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Falling has become the leading cause of non-fatal and preventable injuries. The majority of existing fall detection systems (FDSs) rely on motion sensors. However, most of the applied feature extraction methods result in longer processing time and higher computation. This study proposes a novel attitude feature extraction (AFE) method that extract five feature sets from 54 raw measurements obtained from nine inertial measurement units (IMUs) placed on the firefighter’s protective clothing. Our results indicate that the metrics of attitude feature extraction (AFEM) method outperforms the existing metrics of raw feature extraction (RFEM) method in the fall detection. In addition, the proposed method reduces the algorithm processing time and computations significantly. This enables on-device fall detection classification on constrained processing architectures.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Network Security Situational Awareness Platform for Logistics System Using Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The current attack technology of the network is constantly innovating, and for each enterprise in the logistics system, the cyber security threats to the logistics network established based on the massive amount of data are endless. The network security situational awareness platform can be used as the basis for monitoring, early warning and analysis of network security events in logistics systems, providing early warning and traceability of the security situation of enterprises in the system. Based on this, this paper proposes the construction of a network security situational awareness platform for logistics systems, analyses the design ideas, construction difficulties, and functional design of the platform, and verifies the expected results that the platform should achieve in conjunction with experiments, so as to lay a solid foundation for improving the network security level of logistics systems.

articleTitle: Research of Chinese relation extraction based on BERT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Facing massive text data on the Internet, it is meaningful to extract valuable information for building knowledge graphs and knowledge engines. Relation extraction is a widespread issue in current research. This paper proposes the BERT-BiLSTM-CRF model for Chinese relation extraction. This paper focuses on ten types of Chinese named entity relations, and the model achieves excellent results in the extraction task of these ten relations. This paper first constructs word vectors using the pre-trained BERT encoding model and then extracts features using a bidirectional long short-term memory network (BiLSTM) followed by semantic encoding processing. Finally, this paper uses a conditional random field (CRF) to predict relation categories and complete Chinese relation extraction. Experiments show that the performance is improved after applying the model.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of 3D Visualization Technology Based on GIM Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, GIM model / 3D display, virtual reality and information integration technology is combined to put forward a four-layer framework of urban power grid 3D spatial visualization information platform. Through data analysis, parameter modeling, model assembly, model optimization and attribute warehousing, the system converts GIM model into a general standard 3D model file FBX, which reduces the data amount of the model to a large extent. The reconstruction and optimization of GIM model are realized. The platform integrates engineering information, geographic information, digital models and documents throughout the whole process of engineering construction to complete the application of three-dimensional digital handover. Finally, the application of 3D model in the secondary system simulation analysis, online monitoring and fault diagnosis is realized with the actual 220kV smart substation as the pilot. The simulation results show that this technology can effectively improve the efficiency of three-dimensional design, operation and maintenance of secondary system.

articleTitle: A Method for Image Recognition and Processing of Windmill Contour
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, an image recognition and processing method for windmill contour features is proposed. In this paper, the luminous color features of the windmill are screened by segmenting the color channel, the contour features of the windmill are extracted by the wheel galley screening algorithm, and the discrimination between the blade to be hit and the blade to be hit is realized by the template matching algorithm. Atter debugging, the image recognition and processing method designed in this paper can effectively and accurately identify the wind wheel corridor, and has certain anti-interference ability.

articleTitle: Development of non-contact detection device for coal moisture based on microwave transmission method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to quickly and accurately detect the moisture content of coal and realize online non-destructive testing. An on-line measurement system of coal moisture content based on the principle of microwave transmission is designed. The measurement principle is introduced emphatically, and a method for quickly detecting the moisture content of coal by detecting the voltage signal is proposed. Different fitting models between decay voltage and water content were established, and the best calibration equation was determined by comparing different fitting models. On this basis, a coal moisture detection device applied to the conveyor belt was developed. The device consists of a 10GHz microwave signal source, a horn antenna, a detector, a single-chip microcomputer, an electric conveyor belt machine and a sample holder. Finally, coals with different moisture contents were evaluated experimentally. The results show that the measurement accuracy and deviation of the system are within the acceptable range.

articleTitle: MSDB-based CNN architecture for image dehazing in driverless cars
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the booming development of image processing technology and computer vision technology, scene detection and image processing in special weather has become an important research direction in this field. Among them, images taken in foggy days are easily affected by fog or haze, resulting in blurred details and low contrast to the loss of important image information, and to solve such problems image defogging algorithms are born. To address these challenges, a lightweight convolutional neural network based on multi-scale dense connectivity, called MSDL, is proposed in this paper for reconstructing blurred images. DehazeNet is the End-to-End defogging system that takes the fogged image as input, its transmission map as output, and then uses an atmospheric scattering model for image reduction. The proposed MSDL uses the transformed atmospheric scattering model to jointly estimate the transmission map and atmospheric light. In addition, a novel feature extraction module MSDB is proposed. Finally, extensive experiments are carried out using synthetic and natural hazy images. The experimental results show superiority over both non-deep learning and deep learning methods in both qualitative and quantitative evaluation. The PSNR, SSIM and MSE metrics were measured on different datasets, and the advantages were obtained on NYU2 dataset.

articleTitle: Soundprint Feature Analysis of Main Transformers in a 500kV Substation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper presents the transformer soundrint characteristic quantity analysis method, and then selects a 500kV transformer as the research object. Determine the 500kV transformer from day 19 to day 20. In the case of DC magnetic bias, the system measures the same characteristic trend from A, V, and C three phases, and makes an accurate judgment. Therefore, comprehensive multi-point data collection and analysis can make a better judgment of the DC partial magnetism of the power grid. If the soundprint monitoring linkage is realized in different substations of the power grid, it should be able to be very accurate. The voice print characteristic quantity threshold should be set according to the characteristics of the transformer. At present, the threshold value of the transformer adopts the default value, which is not adjusted according to the actual situation of each transformer, resulting in the deviation of the system judgment state. Considering this analysis, the feature quantity can be adjusted in the following ways, such as the harmonic ratio should be raised appropriately, and the complexity threshold should be lowered. This requires constant tracking, appropriate adjustment of the number of features, to achieve accurate fault alarm, and less false alarm..

articleTitle: A Review on 3D Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The convolutional neural network (CNN) is a potent and popular neural network types and has been crucial to deep learning in recent years. A standard CNN which is known as 2-dimensions CNN was first proposed to solve image classification problems at first. With advancements in science and technology, as well as the growth of the internet, tasks involving video analysis have received increased attention in recent years. As a result, it was suggested that a 3-dimensions convolutional neural network (3D CNN) be applied to tackle 3D image processing or video analysis. 3D CNN is primarily used in the field of human activity recognition, video classification, medical imaging detection, and so on. This paper offers a succinct introduction to the general architecture and representative models of 3D CNN, contrasts the variations between 2D CNN and 3D CNN, explores the widely used models derived from 3D CNN, and displays the application outcomes of 3D CNN.

articleTitle: Traffic Sign Detection Based on YOLO v3
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Machine vision has penetrated into every field of our daily life and is being used more and more widely, especially in the field of automatic driving in recent years, computer vision in ImageNet Dataset will show very strong accuracy and robustness. The research objective of this paper is to analyze the network structure of YOLO V3 and summarize the loss function, use the GTSDB dataset to train and test the YOLO V3 algorithm, get the recall rate, accuracy and average accuracy of YOLO V3 in identifying traffic signs, and compare the results with R-CNN series algorithms. After testing, we find that YOLO algorithm is faster and more accurate than RCNN algorithm in traffic sign recognition, which is exactly what automatic driving needs. This provides a new way for the traffic sign recognition algorithm in the future, and also has potential application value.

articleTitle: Super short-term wind speed prediction based on CEEMD decomposition and BILSTM-Transformer model
