publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Wind speed has the characteristics of non-linearity, non-stationarity, intermittence and randomness. In order to improve the accuracy of wind speed prediction, this paper proposes a wind speed prediction model based on Complete Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition(CEEMD) and improved transformer. Firstly, CEEMD decomposition is used to reduce the instability of wind speed series and improve its predictability. Then, the BILSTM-Transformer prediction model is established for each sub-sequence obtained by decomposition. The bidirectional long-term and short-term memory artificial neural network BILSTM is used to replace the positional encoding in the transformer to extract the position characteristics of the sequence, and then the encoders in the transformer are used for prediction. Finally, the prediction results of all sub-sequences are superimposed to obtain the wind speed prediction results. Through the experiment of a domestic wind farm data, the prediction accuracy of the model in this paper is improved by 0.65 % ~ 1.47 %. The results show that the combined wind speed forecasting model has good forecasting ability and is feasible and effective in short-term wind speed forecasting.

articleTitle: Yoga action recognition based on STF-ResNet
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Aiming at the disadvantages of traditional two-stream convolutional networks which are difficult to learn spatial-temporal correlation information and low recognition accuracy, a yoga action recognition algorithm based on Spatial-Temporal Fusion Residual Network (STF-ResNet) was proposed. The spatial-temporal features are complemented by mixing spatial and temporal stream features with residuals, and the information loss of high-level features is compensated by low-level features. The convolutional block attention module (CBAM) is added before mixing to filter the yoga action features again in both channel and spatial dimensions. A convolutional block attention module is added before the fusion to filter the yoga action features again from both channel and spatial dimensions. Experimentally validated on a custom Yoga dataset, the algorithm improves the accuracy of yoga recognition with an average accuracy of 98.6%, a 6.3% improvement compared to traditional two-stream convolutional networks.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Indoor Patrol Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, the depth camera and lidar are used in indoor patrol robot, and the Gmapping algorithm of particle filter algorithm is used to construct map, which realizes the automatic navigation of Move_base algorithm combining global path planning and local path planning. In this paper, the adaptive Monte Carlo localization algorithm is used for localization, and the real-time analysis of obstacles to achieve automatic obstacle avoidance, to improve the actual use of the robot security. The feasibility of the robot is verified by simulation experiments in this paper. Through experimental debugging, the robot can accurately realize autonomous positioning and navigation, and achieve the basic function of indoor patrol.

articleTitle: Research on turn-based war chess game based on reinforcement learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The search algorithm for turn-based war chess game is still using the traditional algorithm, and the whole war chess game needs a huge computational power, resulting in the research of turn-based war chess game in artificial intelligence is relatively backward. In this paper, we design a turn-based war chess game algorithm based on reinforcement learning, which is composed of Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS) and deep neural network. Monte Carlo tree search relies on strategy network to simulate chess several times, to choose better chess quality; The deep neural network reversely trains the strategy network through the final chess outcome. The experimental results show that there is no defeat in 10Kvs5K and 10Kvs3K game. This algorithm can improve the chess skill through self-game when there is no human knowledge and learning from scratch in turn-based war games.

articleTitle: Optimal Design and Simulation of DC Copper Bus support
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: When DC copper bus is used in electrolytic refining plant, the support spacing of copper bus is usually set according to experience. In this paper, an optimal design method is proposed. The Lorentz force on the conductor is calculated based on the electromagnetic theory, and the magnetic coupling analysis is carried out. Under the constraints of allowable stress of copper bar and bending failure load of insulator, the support spacing of DC copper bus is optimized and solved. Maxwell and Workbench simulation results show that the optimal design is correct and reasonable.

articleTitle: Research on pure azimuth passive positioning of UAV based on least squares method and grid search method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: When the UAV swarm is flying in formation, it only needs to realize the positioning function of the UAV according to the received direction information, and can adjust the position and ensure the formation. In this paper, it first establishs the corresponding polar coordinate system, constructs multiple circumscribed circles through the knowledge of plane geometry, and establishs a multivariate nonlinear equation system to complete the positioning of the UAV. Then this paper sets the leader according to the leader-follower method, determines the order of the UAV transmitting signals and obtain the direction information before takeoff. This paper solved the multivariate nonlinear equations using the least square method and grid search method, obtained the number and biased coordinates of the UAV transmitting signals, and finally obtained the position adjustment scheme of the UAV.

articleTitle: Feature extraction and analysis of speech signal based on fractional Fourier transform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: As an analog signal carrying specific information, voice has become an important means of obtaining and disseminating information in people’s social life. The purpose of speech signal processing is to extract effective speech information in complex speech environment. Speech signal has a strong time-varying characteristics. In a short time interval, the characteristics of speech signal can be regarded as basically unchanged, which is an important starting point of speech signal processing. The rate of speech recognition also depends on the accuracy and robustness of Speech signal feature extraction. Therefore, Speech signal feature extraction plays an important role in speech signal processing applications. By comparing the time-frequency resolution of Fourier transform and fractional Fourier transform in noisy background, the unique advantages of fractional Fourier transform to frequency-varying signals are further clarified.

articleTitle: Research and system architecture design of dispatching data chain technology for load regulation and control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The construction of the new power system makes the traditional “source and load” grid regulation mode change to “source and load interaction”, and the large-scale access of load-side distributed power sources, the unified management of adjustable loads, and the participation of multiple entities in energy operation have put forward new requirements for the security, trustworthiness, openness and transparency of the load dispatching environment. In this context, this paper carries out research on the consensus mechanism, encryption technology and identity authentication of data chain for load regulation and control, and designs the system architecture of dispatching data chain to effectively solve the problems of mutual trust among multiple parties, data security and business authentication in the process of business interaction involving a large number of external entities in the field of regulation and control, so as to build a dispatching environment with information transparency, mutual supervision and mutual trust for power grid enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on Motion Simulation of Stacking Robot Workstation Based on RobotStudio
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In view of the problems of small paper packaging boxes in factory packing and transportation, this paper proposes a method to use the simulation software RobotStudio to carry out motion simulation on the design scheme in the Stacking Robot Workstation and optimize the mechanical structure. First, this paper uses SolidWorks modeling software to design the virtual prototype of the stacking robot workstation, import the model into RobotStudio to complete the space layout, and complete the intelligent setting of pneumatic gripper and conveyor belt. Secondly, this paper creates the teaching point, generates the path, establishes the communication connection between the robot and the intelligent components, and realizes the simulation of the stacking robot workstation.According to the simulation results, the position coordinates of the robot and the structure of the pneumatic gripper are optimized, which makes the design of the workstation more reasonable. This method can also be used for the simulation of industrial robot production lines for other purposes.

articleTitle: UAV Intelligent Forest Inspection System Based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The forestry inspection adopted in China at this stage is still mainly based on manual inspection, which is not only inefficient, but also labor-intensive and has high safety risks for the inspectors. Therefore, this paper proposes a UAV intelligent forest inspection system based on computer vision. However, the application of this UAV intelligent forestry inspection system in complex scenarios has the problems of low model detection accuracy and slow detection speed. To address the problem of low model detection accuracy due to unbalanced data categories and inaccurate labeling, this paper mainly proposes a data cleaning algorithm based on image operation to improve the quality of data labeling, thus improving the object detection accuracy. To address the problem of slow detection speed, this paper proposes a light-weight structure improvement algorithm based on SOLOv2, which uses grouped convolution to improve the detection speed on the basis of ensuring the object detection accuracy, and uses TensorRT for hardware acceleration. Experiments show that the detection accuracy of the improved model is improved by 1.7%, and the reasoning speed is improved by 14.2 frames.

articleTitle: Application Analysis of FlexE Technology in the New Type of Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the explosive growth of various devices, terminals and services, communication networks are in urgent need of security, reliability, flexible access and real-time interaction. Meanwhile, the power communication network extends to the low-voltage side, which needs to analyze a lot of interactive information to realize the perception, prediction and control of the system operation state. The traditional network model has certain deficiencies in taking into account the economy, efficiency and performance. This paper studies and analyzes the application of FlexE (Flexible Ethernet) technology in new type power systems to adapt to services with different granularities and performance requirements, realize unified access of various services, and promote the deep integration and adaptation of FlexE technology to the new type of power system.

articleTitle: Application and Analysis of Convolutional Neural Networks and Vision Transformer Models in Fruit Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: As an important area of deep learning, image classification has become increasingly critical. This paper aims to use two deep learning models to recognize fruits with different backgrounds and strange shapes fruits. First, this paper introduces the principle of the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model and vision transformer (ViT) used in the experiment. Then the paper gives the results of applying these two methods on a dataset called Fruit 360, which includes the result of 8 classifications, 11 classifications, 32 classifications, and 131 classifications. After adjusting some parameters, the two models performed well in 131 categories. Finally, this paper applies the trained model to several pictures of fruits with odd shapes or complex backgrounds. The results show that the ViT model performs much better when a problem becomes challenging than the CNN model. There are still a few issues, though, that need be considered. Instead of sampling, a comprehensive robustness test data set that includes all strange fruit photos should be created. After assessing the performance of ViT in this study, it was discovered that, although maintaining outstanding overall performance, the model's accuracy rate was incredibly low for an unidentified cause.

articleTitle: Study on applicability of electromagnetic eddy current internal inspection for gas field gathering and transmission pipeline
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The risk of internal corrosion failure of gathering and transmission pipeline in sour gas field is high, but due to small pipe diameter, low pressure and complex internal environment, the internal magnetic flux leakage detection is difficult to complete smoothly, and the corrosion condition of inner wall is unknown for a long time. In view of the above problems, two natural gas gathering and transmission pipelines are selected to carry out the field test of electromagnetic eddy current internal detection, and the effectiveness and detection accuracy of this technology in small-diameter, low pressure and complex internal environment pipelines are verified and analyzed through excavation. The test results show that due to the simple structure and small size of the equipment, the electromagnetic eddy current internal detector has superior trafficability and can be successfully implemented in natural gas gathering and transmission pipeline; Electromagnetic eddy current technology has high detection rate of internal corrosion defects, high detection accuracy of defect depth and width, but low detection accuracy of defect length and circumferential position; The electromagnetic eddy current internal detector is less affected by the moving speed of the equipment. Even under the condition of serious unstable speed, it can still ensure good defect detection rate and defect depth detection accuracy. The test results can provide data support for the popularization and application of electromagnetic eddy current internal inspection technology in gas field gathering and transmission pipeline in the next step.

Author Keywords: gas field gathering and transmission pipeline

articleTitle: Thermal Analysis of IGBT Module in Two-Level Neutral Point Inverter Using PSIM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this study, a 20kVA two-level neutral point inverter is simulated for two different linear load cases using PSIM program. In the simulation study, thermal losses and thermal temperature analysis were carried out at two different ambient temperatures by using the real parameters of the IGBT module. Output current and voltage graphs of the inverter are given for two different load cases. Thermal losses and thermal temperature results at 25 °C and 40 °C ambient temperatures are shared in tables.

articleTitle: Research on quantitative evaluation method of demand response of new load park based on real-time data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the development of the new generation of information technology, the scale and capacity of the data center are growing day by day. The new load park with the data center as the main load has the potential to be a demand side response by integrating various resources. This paper studies the operation characteristics and dispatching mode of the new load park. Combining the rules of the power market, the new load park with the confidence capacity as the measurement index is proposed as the adjustable capacity of the demand side response and its contribution to the power supply reliability of the power system. The results show that the proposed method can effectively evaluate the adjustable capacity of the new load park.

articleTitle: UAV cluster adjustment strategy based on passive pure azimuth
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper focuses on the pure orientation passive localization problem in UAV cluster control. UAV cluster control in circular and conical formations is studied from shallow to deep using geometric relations. Firstly, the sine theorem is used to construct the relevant system of equations, and the polar coordinate localization model of the target to be measured is derived by solving the system of equations. Then two UAVs with unknown numbers but accurate positions are added, and the corresponding system of equations is constructed by evolving the two-point rendezvous localization method into the triangulation localization method, and the effective localization coordinates are solved by the least squares method to find the effective localization of the point to be measured. Finally, the corresponding UAV initial position is given, and the corresponding UAV position adjustment strategy is given according to the analysis of the flight distribution of UAVs in circular and conical formations.

articleTitle: Online Estimation of Residual Electrical Lifetime for PV Low Voltage Circuit Breaker Based Grey Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: To solve the problem of real-time estimation of residual power lifetime of low-voltage DC circuit breaker in photovoltaic(PV) distribution network, The metabolic grey model, needs four original data, was established to predict the electrical lifetime of the circuit breaker. The electrical lifetime data were fitted by the exponential model, and the algebraic equation which could comprehensively characterized the electrical lifetime of the circuit breaker of the photovoltaic system under different short-circuit currents was obtained. The conversion scheme between the electrical lifetime of the circuit breaker under different short-circuit currents was given. Considering the important role of the circuit breaker as a relay protection device, the online estimation strategy of residual power lifetime of low-voltage DC circuit breaker under the worst working conditions was constructed. The example analysis results show compared with the measured results, the maximum error of the proposed online estimation strategy of circuit breaker residual electric lifetime is only 9%, which demonstrates the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Research on pedestrian trajectory prediction by GAN model based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: As the application scenarios of unmanned vehicles are gradually diversified and complicated, how to improve the safety and efficiency of unmanned vehicles requires the prediction of dynamic obstacles for mobile robots, and this paper studies a pedestrian trajectory prediction algorithm that can be applied with unmanned vehicles in the first-view video images. A pedestrian trajectory prediction model method based on GAN model of LSTM is proposed. Firstly, in the feature extraction module, the observer camera motion state vector, pedestrian pose information and pedestrian history trajectory are considered as loses. Secondly, in the attention module, the motion attention mechanism is used to measure the degree of influence of the observer camera motion on the pedestrian trajectory, the pose attention mechanism is used to extract hidden features from the human pose, and the interaction attention mechanism is used to model the social interaction between pedestrians, and finally the GAN network module is used to obtain the predicted trajectory using generative adversarial networks. In this paper, we use ETH this dataset for model analysis, and the experimental results show that the proposed model of GAN model based on LSTM can effectively predict the future motion trajectory of pedestrians.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction Model of Photovoltaic Power Generation Based on Nonlinear Regression Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Meteorological factors will have a certain impact on the output characteristics of the optoelectronic system. This is an unstable random signal. This paper uses a post-a priori prediction algorithm to classify it. In this way, a more accurate simulated climate can be obtained. In this method, particle swarm algorithm is used to optimally solve the correlation weights and thresholds in the neural network. The method proposed in this paper takes into account the advantages of BP neural network and particle swarm at the same time. It has achieved good results in terms of convergence rate, generalization and prediction accuracy. Experiments show that the PSO algorithm is used to predict the BP neural network, and its prediction accuracy is higher than that of the traditional BP neural network.

articleTitle: Research on the Visualization Technology of Diesel Engine Acoustic State Based on Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of insufficient visualization and insufficient visual and intuitive monitoring methods in the field of diesel engine acoustic condition monitoring, this paper proposes a method for visual monitoring using augmented reality technology. Through the research on the visualization modeling processing technology of the analysis results of the acoustic state of the diesel engine, the visualization processing methods are explored, the acoustic state parameters are presented through the visualization means, and the presented results are displayed based on the augmented reality glasses, which improves the visualization of the acoustic state monitoring. And it is more intuitive.

articleTitle: Walking problem of bipedal humanoid robot: comparison between model-based and learning-based method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: It is a challenge to make a humanoid robot do perfectly bipedal walking, many obstacles will arise during the process. The problem of humanoid robots needing to be able to maintain the stability of their posture in order to continue walking movements in the presence of external disturbances like uneven ground or external force has been discussed in this paper. There are two different approaches to solving the problem: the model-based method and the learning-based method. In this paper, the non-linear state estimation framework and the PR-SRL algorithm are picked to represent the two approaches. By comparing the methodology, result, and analysis of the two methods, the conclusion that in some cases, the model-based method should be used, and in some other cases, the learning-based method is better can be drawn.

articleTitle: GIS Switch State Detection Based on Coupling Current and Heterogeneous Information Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Because the disconnector in GIS equipment is sealed in the metal shell, its exact position cannot be directly seen by naked eyes. After running in for a long time or severe external influence, the opening and closing position of GIS equipment knife switch may change, and the equipment and power grid will be seriously damaged when the knife switch is not in place. Therefore, this paper quickly and accurately judges the opening and closing status of GIS equipment knife switch by collecting and fusing the grounding current of GIS equipment knife switch, lightning arrester leakage current and shell vibration. First of all, this paper adopts the fast research and judgment method of GIS equipment opening and closing states based on coupling capacitance current, and uses particle swarm optimization to find the super parameters of the subsequent classification CNN network to speed up the network research and judgment. In addition, it further accurately studies and judges the network through the time-frequency memory recurrent neural network based on IMF energy entropy.

articleTitle: A Recommendation Algorithm Incorporating Moth-Flame Optimization Algorithm and Fuzzy Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Aiming at the issues of data sparsity, restrictions on discovering nearest neighbors, and accuracy of similarity calculation of conventional collaborative filtering techniques, a hybrid recommendation algorithm based on MFO-optimized fuzzy clustering and combined similarity is developed. The computation of similarity for the differences in feature attributes of various users is done using a multi-attribute similarity calculation model that incorporates user feature attributes. Based on the different fuzzy clustering affiliation levels, the nearby neighbors are filtered, the mothballing method (MFO) is included, the initialized clustering center is identified, and rating prediction of the clustered results is carried out. The experimental results on the MovieLens dataset demonstrate that the algorithm successfully addresses the issue of data sparsity, dramatically lowers the recommendation error and provides a more thorough examination of the recommendation outcomes than the conventional approaches.

articleTitle: Failure Mechanism Analysis of High Resistance Grounding Fault Protection in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: When a high resistance grounding fault originates in the distribution network line,the fault current flowing through the system is highly faint. At this time, the zero-sequence voltage and zero-sequence current of the feeder are more and more affected by the asymmetry of the three-phase grounding admittance, which makes the weak fault electrical characteristics of the high-resistance grounding fault more blurred. The difficulty of detecting and processing high-resistance grounding faults increases, and the number of long-standing faults that cannot be detected increases. In this paper, the characteristics of zero sequence voltage and feeder zero sequence current of asymmetric distribution network under high resistance grounding fault are analyzed in depth. The capacity that the distribution network can perceive transition resistance, the critical transition resistance when phase selection failure and the fuzzy boundary of feeder zero-sequence current fault characteristics are quantified respectively. The essential reasons for the failure of protection start-up, phase selection and line selection under high-resistance grounding fault are revealed.

articleTitle: Research on Enterprise Information Transmission System under Computer Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper studies and designs a standard networked data acquisition and transmission system based on OPC standard and Web Services technology. The system establishes master and slave stations for FMS equipment, and conducts communication test between master station and slave station. The OPCUA server is used to store the collected and converted real-time data and interact with the OPCUA client, and at the same time upload the converted data to the cloud storage system for further data analysis. The cloud combines Redis and MySQL to realize the storage of running data. Finally, the feasibility and integrity of the proposed system are verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Design of automatic terminal device parameter acquisition based on single chip microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the development of electrical engineering, the performance requirements of existing feeder automation terminal devices for protection devices are increasing. This project uses STM32F103ZET6 as the main control MCU, with 4.3' TFTLCD LCD touch capacitive screen as the display and control device, and RN8302 chip with mutual inductor to form the acquisition circuit. The acquisition chip can use current and voltage transformers to directly calculate the parameters of the feeder automation terminal device, and then transmit the data to the main controller, and then analyze the status and information transmission of the collected parameters, and display the final results on the display, and can be synchronously transmitted to the cell phone.

articleTitle: Data-driven prediction of SOC during discharge of Li-ion batteries
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: As an important component in new energy vehicles, improving the SOC prediction accuracy of LiFePO<inf>4</inf> batteries during vehicle operation helps users to make advance planning. In this paper, a data-driven deep learning algorithm is proposed for predicting the state of charge of LiFePO<inf>4</inf> batteries. The model uses the CBAM attention module to assign spatiotemporal attention to time-windowed sample data, focusing on the degree of influence of both variable and time dimensions, and uses the LSTM structure to focus on the influence of historical data on the SOC at the current moment to further improve the prediction accuracy. Experiments on the prediction of Li-ion battery SOC under dynamic operating conditions show that the method proposed in this paper has higher prediction accuracy and practical value compared with the traditional mechanistic model approach.

articleTitle: Test and verification of electric field characteristics in seawater based on ship scaled model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The test and verification of the electric field characteristics of the scaled model is to make a certain scale model by scaling the size and electrical parameters of the ship through the electric field similarity criterion, and the electric field characteristics of the scaled model are measured under controllable conditions through experiments, and the test results are compared with the simulation results to verify the effectiveness of the test. At present, the characteristics test and analysis of scalar potential or single vector electric field in water based on the scaled model have been carried out in China, but the research on using vector array to obtain three-component electric field data is still in preliminary development, and it is difficult to obtain its spatial characteristics at the same time, resulting in unscientific test methods and incomplete characteristic parameters. In this paper, the model is fixed on the vehicle, multiple sensors are fixed and arranged according to a certain distance to form a measurement array, and the scaled model moves in the direction of the vertical measurement array to obtain the electric field value of the model in a certain plane range at the measurement depth through the sensor array in the water, which can obtain more comprehensive and systematic spatial distribution characteristics than other test methods.

articleTitle: Research on Information Database Construction System Based on Computer Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: First of all, this paper proposes a strategy to construct a transparent access system for distributed heterogeneous database using the basic architecture of middleware, virtual database strategy and XML as the means of data exchange of heterogeneous database, aiming at developing a simple and easy to use, high efficiency, portable and reusable transparent access system for heterogeneous database. Then based on the computer big data technology, this paper puts forward the middleware to ensure the consistency of workflow application data interaction in the running environment. At the same time, the method of data consistency mapping from business model to middleware and from middleware to workflow model based on common language XML is presented. The heterogeneous multi-source database engine in this study can not only conveniently connect to various mainstream databases at present, but also solve the problem of connecting to Web data interface based on Webservices technology. The research results can meet the heterogeneous data integration requirements of different application environments.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Driving Vehicle Auxiliary System Based on Computer intelligent Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Autonomous vehicles will still be in the stage of man-machine co-driving for a long time, which needs man-machine cooperative control. Based on the development of intelligent connected vehicles, this paper designs the human-computer interaction verification framework of autonomous vehicle assistance system. The development of the system uses Python language. Then the system uses PyCharm as the development environment and YOLO framework to realize object detection. In this paper, vehicle radar is integrated to realize an intelligent networked vehicle autonomous driving health system based on machine vision. The simulation results show that the system CAN realize the fusion analysis and intelligent processing of vehicle operation data, road environment data and external data at various scales of "vehicle-road-network". At the same time, this system completes the construction of the "vehicle-road-network" multi-scale real-time monitoring, intelligent decision-making, collaborative control of networked vehicle intelligent control platform.

articleTitle: Analysis of Electromagnetic Interference and Restraining Measures of Brushless DC Motor Drive System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Aiming at the electromagnetic interference problem caused by high frequency and integration of power circuit in the brushless DC motor drive system in the industrial field, the transmission path of difference and common mode interference noise in the motor drive system is analyzed by using the circuit equivalent method, and its equivalent circuit and parameters are obtained. On this basis, according to the brushless motor speed control principle, the influence of load change on conducted interference noise is analyzed. Finally, the EMI suppression measures are analyzed and summarized, and the future development trend is pointed out.

articleTitle: Research on Large-scale Ship 3D Design Method Based on Remote Cross Domain Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Collaboration of design institute and shipyards is needed in large-scale ship design and construction. However, large-scale ship design is operated in independent 3D design platforms of design institute and shipyards, poor transmission of date especially 3D design data results in design bottlenecks. Comprehensively considering the design task characteristics, 3D design technical conditions and security requirements of design institute and shipyards, this paper proposes a cross domain collaborative 3D design method. A cross domain collaborative 3D design system is constructed for design institute and shipyards based on the concurrent collaborative 3D design software. The quality and efficiency of large-scale ship development is greatly improved by concurrent collaboration of design and construction.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent parking management system based on embedded sensor technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the continuous development of economy and the steady improvement of people’s living standards, a large number of cars enter families. In many cities, there are not only traffic congestion, but also a series of problems such as tight parking spaces and difficult parking. In large shopping malls, there is a common phenomenon that the parking range is single or the parking space is difficult to find, resulting in congestion caused by vehicles staying in the parking lot in a short time. At the same time, the existing management system has some problems, such as low efficiency, poor expansibility and few service contents, It is difficult to solve new problems. Aiming at the existing problems of difficult parking and difficult parking management, this project studies a set of intelligent parking management system based on embedded sensing technology and front terminal control technology, which provides a series of solutions to solve the above problems. Its technology and scheme mainly include the following points: Design the embedded sensors for testing, and the information of vehicles entering the parking lot shall be statistically summarized and communicated for display, so as to facilitate the management of managers and the collection of relevant fees in the later stage; Storage and replacement of information and analysis of information through neural network can guide various information acording to the needs of users; Control the whole through the front and rear clients, so that users can easily park and managers can facilitate management

Author Keywords: Front and rear end separation development

articleTitle: Apple bagging system based on machine vision and multi-factor discrimination
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper designs an apple bagging system based on machine vision and multi-factor discrimination by combining apple varieties and planting areas and using convolutional neural networks. This article uses a knowledge base-based apple bagging time query system to obtain the best bagging time, uses machine vision and convolutional neural networks to visually locate the bagged apples, uses the path planning method to plan the bagging path, and controls it by sending Command to control the bagging machine to complete bagging. The use of this system can effectively solve the problems of time-consuming, low efficiency, and insufficient labor for apple bagging, and improve the quality and output of apples.

articleTitle: Raspberry Pi 4B-based cloud-based robot design and demonstration platform construction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper addresses the current situation that it is difficult to carry out experimental courses and practical training courses, especially virtual experiments and robotics experiments, in the education industry, and proposes a cloud-based demonstration and teaching platform, which can effectively close the distance between robotics development and application and students and save the cost of conducting robotics experiments based on the design and interaction of the cloud-based robot. In this paper, the functional and interactive design of the robot is carried out from the design of the cloud-based robot based on Raspberry Pi 4B, and the functional architecture of the cloud-based robot is designed and preliminary functional experiments are carried out, which lays the theoretical and developmental foundation for the subsequent development of the robotics teaching platform.

articleTitle: Application of Fuzzy Clustering Algorithm in Predictive Control of Resource Optimal Allocation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to solve the low utilization efficiency of aviation logistics resources, the problem of not giving full play to air transport capacity, the author proposes an algorithm for optimal allocation of aviation logistics resources based on fuzzy clustering. This algorithm classifies the aviation logistics task requirements through the fuzzy clustering PCM algorithm to improve the retrieval efficiency of logistics resource services. Match the logistics task demand with the logistics resources in the logistics service platform through feature matching, then we can get the resources and services that best meet the needs of logistics tasks, and realize the optimal allocation of aviation logistics resources. The experimental results show that: The algorithm can optimize the allocation of aviation logistics resources with high efficiency (single object processing takes 24.68 ms) and 95.27% accuracy. Conclusion: The experimental results fully verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: An Automatic Generation Method of Patent Specification Abstract Based on "Extraction- Abstraction "Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: China has a large number of patent applications, which are more than millions each year. How to extract useful information from massive patent specifications to improve one's own work and avoid meaningless research and waste of funds has become an urgent problem to be solved. To solve these problems, this paper proposes an automatic generation model of patent specification abstract based on "extraction-abstraction". This model uses the output of the DGCNN-based extraction model as the input of the NEZHA-UniLM-based abstraction model, and the abstraction model optimizes the results of the extraction model to obtain a patent specification abstract with strong readability and generality.

articleTitle: Research of Digital Image Processing Technology of Photoelectric Theodolite’s Target Based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Digital image processing is a technique to digitized image data,which is also called computer image processing. Modern technology keeps digital image processing evolving and expands the application scope. Because of the complexity of the sea scene, as well as the the characteristics of the photoelectric theodolite, the background of uneven homogeneity can be occured in the measured images over the time, and various kinds of clouds and other complex backgrounds may appear a because of the changing weather. How to suppress the diverse backgrounds, enhance the contrast and improve the target extraction ability are the key to successfully capturing the tracking target. This paper takes the processing operation of edge detection and pseudo-color processing. Meanwhile, an improved K-means clustering method is proposed; different kinds of clusters were selected for different kinds of images and realized the rapid and effective image segmentation. The clear edge and detail of image can be realized after the abovementioned operations. In this paper, the processing algorithm of the theodolite image has advantages and disadvantages,the corresponding algorithm can be taken according to specific requirements in practical application, which can be technical reference for the image target recognition and feature extraction.

articleTitle: A Multi-Modal Knowledge Graph of Intersection Traffic State
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Knowledge mapping has become a key method to solve urban computing tasks, such as traffic flow, taxi demand and air quality prediction. Although the existing data is explosive growth, there are relatively few effective data, and data recognition is difficult, so it is impossible to use such data to build a good knowledge map model. The existing massive traffic data includes image and text modals. If these two kinds of modal data are fused together, the problem of less effective data can be solved. Therefore, exploring a correct road traffic information scheme that integrates multimodal information has become the focus of this paper. In this paper, a multi-modal road traffic state knowledge graph is designed to extract vehicle image features and traffic intersection text information features respectively. On this basis, we built an intersection traffic multimodal knowledge graph suitable for structured and semi-structured data. We carry out relevant experiments based on the real intersection data. The experimental verification shows that the method can successfully build the knowledge graph, the data of the image mode and text mode at the same intersection are highly consistent, which lays a better foundation for the later application of multimodal knowledge graph.

articleTitle: Research on the Replacement Strategy of Steel Manufacturers Based on the K-means Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Traffic engineering construction requires various steel building materials, and different manufacturers produce different types and qualities of steel. In the construction process, for multiple reasons, the construction party may need new manufacturers to replace the original manufacturers to provide materials, so it is very crucial to find manufacturers with the same production characteristics. According to data engineering, the original data set is merged, organized, and cleansed. According to feature engineering, a total of 240 features from each manufacturer are selected from the cleaned data set. Then, the k-means clustering algorithm is used to divide manufacturers into different categories according to different k-values (number of categories) and the classification method corresponding to the optimal k-value was found. In the classification results, other manufacturers in the same category can be used as alternative options for that manufacturer. Finally, the Apriori algorithm is used to optimize the algorithm further to find the best alternative for each manufacturer based on the results.

articleTitle: Research on Electronic Information Control System Based on Computer ARM Embedded Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper proposes an architecture of an ARM-based remote video electronic information monitoring system. The system converts the embedded Linux terminal system memory allocation problem into a 0-1 knapsack problem. The system solves the knapsack problem by dynamic programming method to realize the memory optimization of embedded Linux terminal system. The system is sent to the client through the sending program based on Real-time Transport Protocol (RTP) to realize real-time encoding and sending. At the same time, the system realizes the CGI programming of A/D data acquisition. The experimental results show that the system has better real-time performance, clearer images and meets the system design requirements.

articleTitle: New incomplete data imputation based on k-nearest neighbor type framework
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Data classification methods such as KNN and LMKNN have received extensive attention in machine learning, but these methods can only perform on complete datasets. However, incomplete data is very common in real life. Therefore, based on the classification method, this paper proposes five new methods to impute missing data: LMKNN_Imputation, LMPNN_Imputation, Weighted KNN_Imputation, Weighted LMKNN_Imputation, and Weighted LMPNN_Imputation. For the first two methods, based on the classification method, the k nearest neighbors / k-nearest pseudo neighbors' local mean vectors in the class closest to the missing value are to be found first and then used local mean vectors to impute the missing data. For the last three methods, a larger weight is assigned to the point / local mean vector of the class closest to the missing value. Then, use the weighted average or local mean vector to substitute the missing value. After completing the data, classification is performed in five different datasets which are imputed based on five new methods, mean substitution, and KNN imputation, and test the effectiveness of five new methods through the classification accuracy. Finally, the experimental results show that these five methods have an accurate prediction for missing values, the LMPNN_Imputation and the three weighted methods performed even better.

articleTitle: Research on Semantic Segmentation of Airborne LiDAR Point Cloud Based on Spatial Position Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Airborne lidar detection technology can quickly and efficiently observe the earth, actively, real-time and directly obtain the three-dimensional information of a large range of ground objects, and generate a large range of LiDAR point clouds. However, complex categories and uneven heights of ground objects lead to difficulty on the semantic segmentation. To overcome this difficulty, this paper proposes an new semantic segmentation network for point clouds based on the spatial position attention mechanism and deep learning network. This network can directly process original point cloud without converting the original point cloud data into groups of 2D feature images or 3D voxel grids, avoiding information loss. The semantic segmentation model uses the encoder and decoder to extract multiple scale features, and uses the multiple layer perceptron to realize high precision segmentation. By the spatial position attention mechanism, this network can strengthen or weaken weights of the convolution kernel to automatically adapt to spatial structures of point cloud objects. In this paper, the ISPRS dataset provided by the International Society for Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing is used to carry out experiments. The experiment results indicate the proposed network can effectively identify various ground objects and has higher semantic segmentation accuracy than other popular methods.

articleTitle: Mobile Robot Path Planning Based on Triangular Clip Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In the running process of mobile robot equipment, the path planning to reach the specified target under the condition of known map modeling is an important topic. Traditional ant colony algorithm is an eight-degree-of-freedom search probabilistic algorithm derived from the foraging behavior of ant colony. Ant colony belongs to a class of intelligent path planning, which has good implementation effect in raster map path planning. However, the traditional ant colony algorithm has a simple choice of step size, which limits the efficiency of path planning of mobile robots. In this article, the triangular pruning ant colony algorithm is proposed, which introduces the guiding factor φ of target points and the inducing factor μ of obstacles, and effectively changes the way of path search. Experimental results show that compared with the traditional ant colony algorithm, it can improve convergence speed, improve the search efficiency and shorten the optimal path length under different grid environments.

articleTitle: Data Encryption Algorithm Based on Chaos Sequence in Computer Network Security
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Information security is related to personal interests, enterprise survival, social stability, state secrets, etc., and is closely related to my country's economic security, social security and national security. Therefore, research on reliable and secure information transmission encryption technology has important academic and practical value. The purpose of this paper is to study the application of data encryption algorithm in computer network security based on chaotic sequence. The related theoretical knowledge of chaotic image encryption algorithm is studied, including chaotic cryptography and chaotic time series; a data encryption algorithm based on chaotic sequence is designed and applied in image encryption; the realization of the whole image encryption is completed. In addition, the performance of the designed image encryption algorithm is analyzed in various aspects, including the correlation of adjacent pixels and the analysis of security performance. The experimental results show that this paper designs an image encryption algorithm with better performance.

articleTitle: Research on New Terminal Name Card Technology Based on Core Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Traditional caller service can only display phone number or address book name, and no information interaction is possible during voice/video calls. The new terminal business card technology supports users to set the authentication name, call subject, location, image, video, motion and expression before the call, so that the caller's pre-set content can be displayed on the caller ID screen of the called user's cell phone terminal in the call scenario. The technology relies on the operator's network with the advantages of security and trustworthiness, and has the characteristics of native terminal, functional integration and experience upgrade, bringing a new experience for the majority of users and promoting the overall development and breakthrough of new terminal messages in China.

articleTitle: Structure Design and Motion Study of Transformable Hexapod Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In view of the needs of robots with complex environment adaptability in various application fields, in order to solve the problems that wheeled robots are difficult to travel in complex and rugged terrain, and footed robots have poor stability when walking on flat ground, a deformable hexapod robot is designed. The hexapod robot has both flexibility and stability, and realizes all-terrain walking. By measuring the motion state of the robot, analyzing the state of the hexapod robot during the motion process, and studying the measurement results in different motion processes, the rationality of the structure of the hexapod robot and the feasibility of the motion are verified. Further study of the model provides ideas and proofs.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Model of Weapon Firing Firepower Distribution and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The optimal firepower distribution is used to give full play to the overall coordination advantage of multiple firepower units, and the distribution scheme with the best total damage effect is sought under given constraints. To solve the following two problems: first, how to distribute the firepower to maximize the overall damage value of the enemy armor target; The second is to achieve a certain degree of overall damage to the enemy armored target, how to allocate fire reasonably, so that the amount of ammunition consumed by our side is minimal. The optimal model of fire distribution is established and the simulation calculation is carried out. The results show that the model has a high precision and a wide range of applications, and it is of great significance to improve the precision of combat.

articleTitle: Markov Process Based Reliability Study of Private Network System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: A private network refers to a network dedicated to some services with high confidentiality requirements, such as an internal private network of an enterprise or a private network of a confidential state department, whose security and reliability is an issue that cannot be ignored. In this paper, we analyze the general private network composition and study the evaluation method of network system reliability based on Markov process from the current situation of the network, and consider the influence on the reliability of the elements that generally have in private networks, such as routers, firewalls, encryption equipment, switches and transmission links, and give the evaluation model to derive the network system reliability.

articleTitle: Design of cross-metal wireless power supply resonance tracking circuit
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to realize the cross-metal transmission of electrical energy on aircraft surface, based on the vibration mode of metal structure and piezoelectric material, the model of piezoelectric metal composite structure in longitudinal standing wave mode was built and simulated, and the frequency spectrum experiment of composite structure with different thickly was carried out to analyze its resonant frequency variation and phase characteristics. Finally, according to the characteristics, a broadband resonant frequency adaptive tracking circuit is designed, which can act on the metal wall of 5~10mm thickness. Its bandwidth is up to 200kHz, tracking error is less than 1%, and output power is up to 1 W.

articleTitle: Sewer biogas monitoring and recycling system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of environmental pollution and explosion in urban sewers, a monitoring and recycling system of biogas in intelligent urban sewers is designed and developed. Based on the characteristics of ordered mesoporous materials, the main body absorbs biogas and uses its properties to separate methane and realize recycling. The hardware implementation is mainly composed of Lora networking, MQ-4 sensor monitoring methane concentration, WIFI uploading methane concentration data of each node to the cloud platform, water level sensor monitoring water level and timely alarm. The system accords with the concept of energy saving and environmental protection, improves the level of urban intelligence, takes into account both environmental protection and economy. It has the advantages of automation, recyclability, low cost and strong practical pertinence.

articleTitle: Optimization Method of Backbone Power Grid under Extreme Disaster Condition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to improve the power supply reliability, an optimization method of backbone power grid under extreme disaster condition was proposed. Firstly, the elasticity evaluation of power system under extreme meteorological disasters was analyzed. The backbone power grid scheme under normal operation was established by grey wolf optimizer (GWO) method. And the backbone power grid scheme under outage situation was optimized by introducing recovery index. Then the relevant examples were analyzed. It can be obtained that the proposed method can optimize the restoration power supply path of important loads and generator units. Reduce the risk of power restoration failure caused by multiple steps of power restoration process and improve power restoration efficiency. The power recovery time is only 105 minutes. The success rate of power restoration was increased by about 15%. The research results have reference significance for the research of power grid construction.

articleTitle: Application of millimeter-wave radar in giant-magnetostrictive brake by wire environment perception system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem including insufficient accuracy of the giant-magnetostrictive brake by wire environment perception system in sensing target motion in complex environments and the noise of millimeter-wave radar during data collection, a Kalman filter method is proposed to predict the target distance and speed, and MATLAB simulation has verified its feasibility and effectiveness. The simulation results show that the prediction accuracy of the target through the millimeter-wave radar data can be centimeter level, which improves the perception accuracy of the environment perception system to the target, and it provides a good basis for the date fusion for millimeter-wave radar and other sensors.

articleTitle: Parallel Quadrature Index Modulation with Transmit Diversity in Large MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, a new scheme, named after parallel quadrature index modulation (PQIM) with transmit diversity, is proposed to not only greatly increase the spectral efficiency but also achieve the transmit diversity gain for improving the bit error rate performance. Specifically, the total number of transmit antennas is grouped into multiple groups. For each group, in the in-phase dimension, two components of a three dimension (3D) constellation symbol are modulated on two active transmit antennas; in the quadrature dimension, the remaining one component of the 3D constellation symbol is modulated on only one active transmit antenna. Then, for achieving the diversity gain, each group of transmit antennas modulates an identical 3D symbol. Furthermore, the average bit error probability (BEP) is analyzed. Simulation results demonstrate the proposed PQIM outperforms other schemes in terms of BEP in wireless communication.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Convolutional Neural Networks and Multilayer Perceptron in Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: A Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) model has a generative and discriminative network, in which they compete to obtain the desired outcome to make the fake generated data look real. To evaluate the functionality of a GAN, a dataset with 8431 male images and 11596 female images is introduced in this paper as the sample set. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) are used as generators and discriminators. The dataset is divided into two subsets, with one only having male images and the other female images. Then each set is used as a sample set to evaluate the network using CNN for both generator and discriminator, CNN for generator and MLP for discriminator, and MLP for generator and CNN for the discriminator. The result for each experiment is different, but they all indicate that the generator serves a more critical role than the discriminator because of the functionality of a GAN. Also, a dataset with a narrow interval between each element of the set with permutations of eigenvalues, instead of a larger or smaller sample size, indicates a better performance of a GAN.

articleTitle: Injection Pulse Source Using Linear Magnetic Induction Voltage Superposition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Electromagnetic interference (EMI) problems in substations have become more prominent with the development of smart grids. Exploring the effects of EMI such as very-fast-transient overvoltage (VFTO) on sensors requires high performance injection pulse sources. In this paper, an injection pulse source based on magnetic induction voltage superposition is designed. Particularly, a simulation model of the circuit with the structure of linear transformer driver and the fast action characteristics of MOSFET is built. Moreover, the influences of the main circuit parameters such as load resistance, switch performance and energy storage capacitance on the output pulse waveform are studied. The simulation results show that appropriately increasing the load can reduce the leading and trailing edge time of the pulse. The use of fast-opening switch can speed up the output pulse leading edge, but it also increases the fly-back spikes in the induction output. And the increase of energy storage capacitance can prolong the waveform drop time of the pulse and hardly affect the pulse leading edge within a certain range. On the basis of above, the injection pulse source prototype is developed. The fastest pulse leading edge can reach about 10ns, and the pulse amplitude can be up to 40kV, which can meet the needs of secondary system anti-electromagnetic interference research.

articleTitle: Bilstm Personalised-Style Poetry Generation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Chinese poetry plays an important role in people's daily lives, promoting an understanding of history and culture, enriching their emotions, and enhancing their aesthetic skills. It is an integral part of China's cultural heritage. In natural language processing, Chinese poetry generation is challenging because its unique rhyme format requires expressing certain meanings and achieving perfect harmony between syllables, tones, and rhymes. An improved long and short-term memory network framework is used in this paper to generate each line of the poem. The innovation of this paper is that a style dictionary is provided for different dataset sources, the generated poems are scored based on the style dictionary for their similarity to different styles, and the final poem with the highest similarity is then generated. The results of our comprehensive evaluation of human judgments indicate that our proposed method improves the similarity of the generated poems to the target style and is somehow comparable to the quality of human poetry.

articleTitle: A High Resolution DOA Estimation Based on Random Array in Underwater Multipath Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In the underwater sonar signal processing technology, linear sonar array should conform to Nyquist sampling theorem, otherwise the problem of azimuth ambiguity will occur in the underwater Direction of Arrival (DOA) estimation. To solve this problem, a kind of nonuniform linear array random spacing array is studied, and the application of this array structure in DOA estimation of underwater targets is studied. In addition, after different transmitted signals of underwater active sonar detection target are scattered and refracted through underwater acoustic channel, the echo signal will appear coherent, which seriously affects the detection accuracy of underwater target. To solve this problem, this paper proposes Compressed Sensing Basic Pursuit De-Noising (CS-BPDN) algorithm based on random array. In this paper, CS-BPDN algorithm and Multiple signal classification (MUSIC) algorithm are combined with random spacing array to estimate the DOA of underwater targets by using the acoustic ray propagation simulation in BELLHOP model. The simulation results show that the CS-BPDN algorithm based on random spacing array can effectively deal with the problem of mixed coherent signals caused by underwater multipath effects.

articleTitle: Research on Raman Spectroscopy in Geology, Rock and Mineral Physics Optical Exploration and Detection Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Laser Raman spectroscopy has shown good application prospects in the analysis of micro components. In this paper, the laser Raman high-resolution large-area fast imaging method is applied to the full-area large-area scan of two standard rock thin sections. The method can accurately identify the transparent minerals such as alkaline feldspar, plagioclase, quartz, common amphibole, biotite, calcite, sphene, apatite, zircon and epidote, and opaque minerals such as magnetite, there are close associations and secondary alterations among some minerals. Based on this, the content statistics are carried out in this paper, and they are named as fine-grained amphibole quartz monzonite and fine-grained biotite amphibolite. The experimental study found that the fluorescence effect, the similarity of the peak positions of the isomorphous minerals (feldspar, amphibole) and the peak position shift of the altered minerals would interfere with the identification of minerals and the analysis of the spectrum. In addition, the smaller the surface scan step size is, the higher the analysis accuracy will be, and the time cost will increase accordingly. This method realizes the convenient, intuitive and accurate large-scale rapid identification and identification of fine minerals. This method can make up for the shortcomings of traditional rock and mineral identification and other technical methods, and expand the application range of Raman spectroscopy in geological work.

articleTitle: A Corporate Public Opinion Classification Method Based on Multi-teacher Knowledge Distillation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the raising of media convergence, network public opinion monitoring system has become a necessary tool for government, enterprises and financial institutions to respond to public opinion events and create a favorable development environment. In recent years, pre-trained large-scale language models have established significant improvement in performance on a variety of natural language processing tasks such as text classification etc. However, the parameters of these large-scale models are at least hundreds of millions of, which makes it difficult to popularize. Therefore, knowledge distillation technology has attracted more and more attention as one of the ways to accomplish model compression. Based on public sentiment data of enterprises, this paper builds a three-teacher knowledge distillation deep learning framework to achieve the training of public opinion classification models with the same performance as large models at low computing costs as well as to pre-train large models in enterprise public opinion detection systems. An experiment in China shows that the model learned by knowledge distillation has slightly improved performance (Acc 2.45%) even under the premise of reducing the number of parameters by 41.58%, which illustrates the effectiveness of multi-teacher knowledge distillation network framework.

articleTitle: The Influence of Axial Flux Leakage from Motor Coils on the Magnetic Bearing and Shielding Measures
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In the high-speed and compact magnetic levitation motor, the distance between the motor and the magnetic bearing is close. The axial flux leakage of the motor coil, introduced to the magnetic bearing easily, causes interference in the magnetic circuit of the magnetic bearing. This paper reports the crosstalk between the motor armature field and the magnetic field of the nearby magnetic bearing for the first time. The key factors affecting the magnetic field interference are explored, and the corresponding magnetic shielding measure is proposed.

articleTitle: Parameter Identification of IoT-Embedded PMSMs Using an AWS Cloud-Computing Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Permanent magnet synchronous machines (PMSM) represent the core of many industrial processes. Therefore, the monitoring of electrical and mechanical parameters and variables allows to obtain important information for a predictive maintenance and fault detection. However, some parameters are not directly measurable and need to be estimated. For this purpose, it is good to define a parameter estimation approach relevant in large-scale industrial processes. In this paper a parameter identification of IoT-Embedded PMSMs approach is defined. This approach combines the benefits of IoT, edge computing and cloud computing technologies. AWS services are used in the implementation of the parameter identification algorithm in cloud environment. So, a scalable, reliable, and secure solution is obtained to be applied in contexts related to facility management.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Distributed Alternating Current/Direct Current Hybrid Power Supply on Power Quality of Distribution Network and Its Reliability Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: A microgrid is an efficient power system with two different characteristics, Alternating current and Direct current. Aiming at the problem of power quality interference in Alternating current and Direct current hybrid networks, a power quality detection method based on stability criterion is proposed. In this paper, the energy quality dispersion fusion of Alternating Current-Direct current hybrid microgrid is carried out by using high frequency interference characteristics, and the modeling and modeling are carried out. Simulation experiments show that this new control strategy can effectively identify the power quality disturbance in the power system, and has good anti-disturbance.

Author Keywords: Distributed Alternating current and Direct current power supply

articleTitle: Research on the Control under the Participation of Heat Storage Device and Fast Cut Back Control Strategies in Isolated Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: It mainly focuses on the similarities and differences between the traditional FCB (Fast Cut Back) control strategy for thermal power units and the control strategy with heat storage device when the external grid fails. It provides a more reasonable way to deal with emergencies to ensure equipment is safe. When the external grid power restores, the unit will be quickly reconnected to the grid.

articleTitle: Early Stage Fire Warning of Substations Based on Concentration Prediction of Thermal Ionization Particle
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Due to the imperfect fire monitoring and early warning measures, it is difficult to find out and take corresponding measures to deal with the fire in the early stage. A method of substation fire identification based on thermal ionization particle prediction is demonstrated in this paper. Firstly, the influence of environmental gas fluctuation on fire identification is eliminated, the collected data are extracted, and the particles of thermal ionization particle are screened out by distinguishing wavelength, light transmittance, and light spot dissipation speed. Then, a neural network model for predicting the concentration of thermal ionization particles is established, and the selected thermal ionization particle data is input into the neural network model to predict the variation curve of thermal ionization particles in the substation in the future. Taking the exponential change of thermal ionization particle with time as an important feature, it is judged whether the concentration change curve of thermal ionization particle is consistent with the exponential change of fire, and if so, a fire warning signal will be sent out to achieve the purpose of a timely warning.

articleTitle: Breeding model of Bumblebee based on linear regression and BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Bumblebee is the natural enemy of many bees. If the reproduction of bumblebee is not predicted, it may destroy the balance of the whole colony. Firstly, Positive ID was selected by preprocessing the datasets and dividing the resulting datasets according to laboratory status. In this paper, linear regression is used to analyze the data set of time series, and BP neural network algorithm is further used to analyze the data set of the relationship witness report and detection date of the longitude and latitude bumblebee, and finally the prediction and analysis are carried out. The experimental results show that the transmission of bumblebees can be predicted by the longitude, latitude and detection date reported by witnesses. The establishment of the model is helpful for ecological researchers to predict the overall reproduction of bumblebees in space and provide support for the protection of bee colonies

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Target Tracking Technology Based on Particle Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Using CNN deep convolutional neural network model to extract image sample features, this paper designs an image multi-target tracking algorithm combining particle filter and Softmax classifier.
