The possible transformation state factors of the tracking target are considered in the design of the particle filter, the possible transformation states are defined by the Bayesian probability operation method, the particle filter is introduced into the CNN model, and the extracted particle image block is analyzed by the Softmax classifier. Features to achieve accurate classification. The single-target and multi-target tracking accuracy of the proposed algorithm is evaluated through four experiments. The experimental results verify that the premise of improving the accuracy of image multi-target tracking is to obtain accurate feature information of the tracked image and achieve accurate classification. The accuracy of single-target and multi-target tracking has reached more than 94%.

articleTitle: Pure Azimuthal Passive Positioning in UAV Formation Flight
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Aiming at the UAV formation flight problem under purely azimuthal passive conditions, this paper establishes a geometric relationship model, a UAV positioning method for circular formations in two different cases, and a formation position adjustment method under a slight deviation of the UAV position. In order to minimize the number of adjustments, an optimization model with the objective of minimizing the number of adjustments is established, and the validity of the model is verified. The results show that the proposed method can achieve better UAV positioning and formation position adjustment, and this method can provide reference for other UAV swarms in similar situations.

articleTitle: A Blockchain Covert Communication Method Based on Voting Contract
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to meet the increasing demand for information transmission with high confidentiality, it is important to propose new covert communication methods. The performance of covert communication technology includes security and hiding rate. At the same time, blockchain technology is characterized by decentralization, anonymity and traceability, and is a natural hidden communication carrier. Ethereum is one of the classic and commonly used blockchain currency applications. Therefore, this paper uses the voting contract in Ethereum smart contract to build a hidden channel based on the blockchain, and encodes information through different options in the voting contract. In addition, we analyze the channel from security, scalability and cost.

articleTitle: Design of Sports Online Multimedia Resource Sharing System Based on Data Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: During the post-epidemic period, the construction of online resources for physical education courses in colleges and universities provides an important guarantee for realizing real-time conversion during the epidemic prevention and control period. Through the research of major online courses at home and abroad, the teaching reform of college physical education courses with "results as the center" as the core is put forward. The shared teaching system is researched on the success of students and designed according to the actual situation. Using data clustering technology, the information management of college physical education teaching is studied. Based on the overall functional requirements, the cloud computing architecture of the platform is analyzed in detail. Based on the data processing requirements, a data-based management system is established and data management is carried out. According to the APP architecture of student users, the requirements of integrated data collection and distribution of training tasks are carried out. Then, the specific realization of APP architecture is elaborated. At the same time, using the theory of output gain stability analysis, a linear analysis model for data analysis in sports industry is established. Using the combination of quadratic programming and linear integration, the integration of internal information and the regulation of parameters are carried out in the sports industry. Through the analysis of the sports industry, it is proved that the algorithm proposed in this paper has high accuracy and reduces the interference error in the sports industry.

articleTitle: Research and development of VR based substation operation and maintenance simulation system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Using VR technology to construct virtual environment for substation simulation system can greatly improve the reality of substation scene, and can bring a technological leap for substation training simulation. This paper analyzes the relevant key technologies, proposes solutions, and finally develops a set of VR based substation operation and maintenance professional scenario simulation system. The system uses interactive 3D engine technology and gesture interaction technology to train operators and provide strong talent guarantee and intellectual support for the successful operation of the grid company.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Engineering Modeling System under Computer Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper deeply understands the functional modules of the VERICUT software system and the NX software modeling technology based on the computer virtual reality technology of CNC machine tool engineering. Then this paper uses three-dimensional software to build the measured size model of machine tool engineering, and builds the virtual simulation environment of the machine tool in the numerical control virtual simulation processing software VERICUT. Then this paper obtains the parameters of the virtual material model of the joint based on the multi-objective optimization method, and builds an accurate virtual material model of the joint. In this way, an accurate dynamic model of the CNC machine tool is established. The system realizes the information exchange between the machine tool simulation controller and the model, and supports the virtual debugging function of the model. The simulation results show that the method is feasible and can effectively improve the virtual-real interaction ability, data visualization degree and state monitoring efficiency of machine tools.

articleTitle: Autonomous Detection Principle of Mission Payload of a Ground Armored Mobile Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The mission payload of ground armored mobile platform can be directly capable of the missions given by the superior with one button, form control instructions by analyzing the specific mission files, and realize the autonomous reconnaissance and ranging function of the payload. On the basis of traditional payload control system, this paper proposed a stepping autonomous detection method, obtained the image recognition results under stable condition of the panoramic mirror, meanwhile, matched the target distance information obtained by laser ranging with the recognized pixel information of the target, filtered false alarm in image recognition and reduced the false-alarm rate. The autonomous detection principle can complete the stepping autonomous detection of the payload and the filtering of false alarm in the image, which provides technical support for the autonomous combat of unmanned equipment in the future.

articleTitle: Intelligent Control System of Construction Machinery Based on PLC and Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In the field of industrial automation, the application of machine vision(MV) technology in industrial production positioning detection is developing rapidly, and the positioning task can still be accomplished by image detection and recognition in the harsh environment of industrial sites. And construction machinery(CM) also towards the direction of intelligence and automation, people also pay more and more attention to the design of CM control system(CS) research. This paper develops an intelligent CS for CM suitable for industrial production process. The system processes the image information by MV system, and then the processed data is calculated by PLC, which combines MV technology and PLC technology to realize the detection of pulse signal frequency and the monitoring of CM and equipment status. The test results of the intelligent CS module in this paper also show that the system meets the design requirements and can be put into engineering production applications.

articleTitle: Intelligent Detection of Unauthorized Buildings Based on UAV and Computer Vision Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, Beidou technology is combined with computer vision to control UAVs for automatic detection of illegal structures. The RRT algorithm is used in the UAV flight to achieve automatic path planning, aided by the addition of a bird discriminator and an automatic obstacle avoidance algorithm. When the UAV detects an illegal building, it sends an alert to the client and location information. The building pictures are detected using target recognition algorithms in computer vision.

articleTitle: Bionic, Fin-propelled Underwater Multi-legged Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Industrialization and technology advancement have brought convenience, but they also have side effects, mainly because they cause pollution. The introduction of plastics improves people’s lives a great deal, yet plastics products are easy to drift into the ocean from lakes and rivers and since they are undegradable, it is easy for them to remain as sediment in oceans. Although land garbage collecting as well as classification have already been relatively developed, ocean trash is extremely difficult to deal with, causing pollution and posing danger to species living within these areas. This is mainly because it is almost impossible to send humans to these water regions to collect garbage, and even if we can, the process would be tedious and timely, so here is where robots come into play. They can reach these oceanic environments and bring back garbage thrown away by human beings. This paper encompasses the methods used in designing and building the robot as well as its structural characteristics. It is an underwater robot, meaning it mainly dives into the water to perform its functions. It is quadrupled, meaning it has four feet. It propels itself in a bionic way and propels itself using fins. Specifically speaking, it has four feet with each having silicon gel attached to it, thus enabling the robot to swim like a sea turtle. Finally, it has a mechanic arm that helps it pick up garbage from the water.

articleTitle: Capacitor-Current PID Feedback Control Method for Grid-Connected Inverter to Improve System Stability and Harmonic Rejection Ability
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The wide variation of the grid impedance can easily cause system resonance or even system instability of LCL-type grid-connected inverter in weak grid, and the injected grid current is severely distorted due to grid voltage harmonics. To address this issue, a capacitor-current PID feedback control method is proposed in this paper to correct inverter system impedance. It makes the output impedance of inverter and the equivalent virtual impedance of the filter capacitor in parallel have a nonnegative real part within the Nyquist frequency, while increasing the inverter output impedance’s low-frequency gain. Then, the design guideline for the parameters of capacitor-current PID feedback coefficient is given. The proposed method has the ability to significantly enhance system stability and harmonic suppression capability, simultaneously enhancing system robustness to variation in grid impedance. Finally, simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method and parameter design.

articleTitle: Analysis of Acoustic Signal in Switchgear Based on VMD Decomposition Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The switchgear acoustic signal collected in the field environment is usually non-stationary and nonlinear, with a complex composition, mainly composed of noise, effective sound vibration waveform and harmonic superposition. At the same time, due to the weak energy of the fault feature signal, it is often submerged by the noise, and it is difficult to find and extract the fault signal with periodic and shock characteristics. This paper presents an acoustic vibration signal analysis method based on variational mode decomposition (VMD) to decompose the raw data into narrow-band eigenmode functions to mine fault information. Practical tests show that this method works well.

articleTitle: Research on interior office comfort system combined with two factors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In the office environment, the factors that affect human comfort are very complex. Scholars all over the world have done a lot of research on thermal comfort. Among them, the predicted mean voice (PMV) model stands among the most recognized thermal comfort models. Based on the investigation of the literature this paper analyzes the factors and research objects of human comfort in the office and determines several important factors affecting human comfort in the office. we use BP neural network algorithm to predict and verify the model by fitting the changing relationship between indoor environmental factors.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Gearbox Oil Temperature Exceeding the Limit of Wind Turbine Generator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper studies a gearbox fault monitoring device for wind power, which includes digital signal processor, sensor module, A/D conversion module, ad hoc network communication module, memory module, diagnosis module, mobile communication module; A/D conversion module, ad hoc network communication module, storage module, diagnostic module and mobile communication module are all connected with the digital signal processor; The sensor module is connected with the A/D conversion module; The diagnosis module can judge and alarm the monitoring level; By setting up the self-organizing communication module, data can be exchanged with neighboring nodes, and data information of neighboring nodes can be uploaded.

articleTitle: Detection of electricity theft based on ISSA-DELM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to improve the identification accuracy of electricity theft by smart grid users, a deep extreme learning machine optimized by improved sparrow search algorithm (ISSA-DELM) is proposed. The population diversity and global optimization performance of the traditional sparrow search algorithm (SSA) are improved by modifying the location of the finder and the watchman. Due to the random initialization of weights and thresholds, the traditional deep extreme learning machines are prone to fall into local optima. The weights and thresholds of DELM are optimized by the improved Sparrow search algorithm to improve the convergence accuracy. Then, the ISSA-DELM is used to establish the identification model of electric theft. Simulation results show that the ROC and AUC of the proposed method are better than the traditional DELM and K-means, which verifies the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Improved application of SCR flue gas denitrification control system in power plant
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper introduces the automatic control system of flue gas denitrification in thermal power units, and makes many improvements on the traditional control strategy. The improved algorithm has the advantages of simple process, clear parameter setting, fast object identification, and makes full use of the dynamic relationship between oxygen concentration at denitrification inlet and NOx concentration at flue gas inlet. On the basis of traditional control, the problem that NOx concentration at flue gas outlet is difficult to be controlled due to large delay is solved. The actual operation OF the unit shows that the improved control strategy has strong robustness, achieves the control indexes, especially the environmental protection requirements, has strong universality and practicability, and meets the requirements of denitrification automation control.

articleTitle: Multimodal actuator for legged robot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: A multimodal elastic actuator based on the brake and clutch device of worm gear is designed for efficient legged robot locomotion. Several modes of operation can be outputted with the engaging and disengaging of the brake module, including motor drive, series elastic actuation, the energy storage and release. The simulation and performance experiments are applied for the multimodal actuator. The results that the output bandwidth of the system increases gradually with the increase of spring coefficient, and the knee robot leg based on multimodal elastic actuator can realize switchable mode during walking cycle.

articleTitle: Design of near-infrared photoelectric thin film devices based on Macleod software
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the development of modern optics, the application of infrared optical system is increasing day by day, and more and more optical devices require the working band in the near infrared region, which makes the development of high-performance infrared transmittance film become an important part of optical research. In this paper, an antireflective film with transmittance higher than 99% at 400-800nm was designed on K9 glass by using the software of film system design. According to the theoretical basis of optical film, the reflectivity of antireflection film is obtained by analyzing the admittance function of antireflection film. Using TiO<inf>2</inf> as the coating material with high refractive index and SiO<inf>2</inf> as the coating material with low refractive index, the near-infrared antireflection film with T≥99% was designed, and the total thickness of the film layer was 1660.07nm. The design results meet the requirements of technical indicators.

articleTitle: Two-Level Hierarchical Reliability Evaluation Method for Distribution System Considering Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to better evaluate the reliability of active power distribution system after the access of distributed photovoltaic, a two-level hierarchical reliability evaluation method of distribution system considering distributed generation is proposed in this paper. In this paper, the reliability evaluation of distribution system considering distributed power is divided into two levels. On the first level, the reliability of distribution lines, circuit breakers, transformers, protection devices, etc. managed by distribution system operators in the operating system is evaluated. On the second level, the connection of load side distributed power is classified into reliability evaluation, a multi-state model of DG is established to quantify the contribution of user side DG to the overall system reliability. The simulation results in the RBTS system show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Abnormal electricity identification based on intelligent clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: An abnormal power consumption behavior detection method based on improved support vector machine (SVM) is proposed to analyze the abnormal power consumption behavior of power users in the big data environment. An abnormal power consumption behavior detection method based on improved support vector machine (SVM) is proposed to analyze the abnormal power consumption behavior of power users in the big data environment.

articleTitle: Ultra-wideband (UWB) localization problem under signal interference
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With more and more attention paid to the service based on location information, wireless location technology has also been developed rapidly. Among them, ultra-wideband (UWB) technology has the characteristics of high measurement accuracy and low power consumption, which is more and more widely used in wireless positioning system. However, the transmission of wireless signals is easy to be interfered with by the environment, which leads to a sharp decline in the positioning accuracy under signal interference, which restricts the application and promotion of this positioning technology. In this paper, a nonlinear fitting, spatial error compensation, measurement error compensation, and machine learning-based pattern recognition model are established by using accurate spatial positioning equations to solve the problem of UWB accurate positioning under signal interference.

articleTitle: Improved BP neural network-based subsurface displacement prediction method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Natural disasters such as landslides and mudslides are extremely harmful to society. In order to better monitor the subsurface displacement, this paper proposes to apply the Seagull optimization algorithm (SOA) to the Back Propagation Neural Network (BPNN), and use the SOA algorithm to optimize the parameters in the neural network algorithm to improve the accuracy and efficiency of its fitting prediction. The SOA algorithm is used to optimize the parameters of the neural network algorithm to improve the accuracy and efficiency of its fitting prediction. The subsurface displacement data provided by the landslide detection platform are cleaned and interpolated by three splines to expand the data set and weighted by the entropy method to enhance the differentiation ability among the indicators. After that, the data were brought into the SOA-BP model for prediction. The results show that the accuracy of the fit is improved by 33.07% compared with the conventional BP neural network, and the mean horizontal and vertical errors are kept within ±1mm. In terms of implementation efficiency, the displacement is obtained faster than the existing segmented linear interpolation method. It can be shown that the SOA-BP model is a better method for predicting subsurface displacement data and satisfies the requirements for subsurface displacement monitoring.

articleTitle: Computer Artificial Intelligence IT Technology Data Transmission Center Construction System Research
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Based on computer artificial intelligence, this paper proposes a reliability analysis algorithm model for multi-attribute data transmission based on improved cuckoo search algorithm. In this paper, the reliability problem of multi-attribute data transmission is transformed into a multi-objective combinatorial optimization problem of multi-attribute decision making by constructing the reliability quality evaluation system of multi-attribute data transmission and the mathematical model of data transmission reliability analysis. Then we study the probability distribution of node reliability and its transmission path reliability. Finally, the experimental results show that the algorithm has the advantages of short response time, low iteration times and low error when analyzing the reliability of network multi-attribute data transmission.

articleTitle: Research on the Dynamic System Faults of Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In electric vehicles, the dynamic system is the key to operating stably, and if there is a failure, it will inevitably reduce the safety of running the car. In order to understand the common faults of the electric vehicle dynamic system and grasp the handling methods of different faults, this paper introduces the fault types and causes of the electric vehicle dynamic system directly. After research, it is found that the causes of various types of failures have the characteristics of different failures, so it is necessary to eliminate the causes of the faults. According to the study, this paper believes that in order to prevent and effectively deal with the electric vehicle dynamic system, it is necessary to perform regular maintenance and use appropriate and effective methods to analyze and deal with the causes in order to improve the stability of the electric vehicle dynamic system and meet the basic needs of vehicle operation.

articleTitle: Lightning overvoltage protection of 35kV collector lines in wind farms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper focuses on the design of 35kV overhead lines in wind farms, some measures about lightning overvoltage protection. It aims to fully realize the protection of high-voltage cables, padmount transformer and electrical equipment of substations. These countermeasure seems to be a little conservative, but it is correct in terms of lightning overvoltage protection, and it is feasible in operation. The specific measures are: erecting lightning protection lines throughout the overhead line; perfecting the protection connection of lightning intrusion waves of cable; strengthen the grounding device of the line tower.

articleTitle: Chance-constrained Energy Management Strategy for Micro-grids Intra-day Operation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With increasingly high penetration of renewable energy resources (RERs), modern energy system suffers great uncertainties from the perspective of stable intra-day operation. Micro-grid (MG) is an effective solution integrating the RERs to provide clean energy. In this regard, a chance-constrained intra-day energy management strategy (CC-IEMS) is proposed in this study. Kernel density estimation (KDE) is employed to capture distribution features of RERs output by taking advantage of historical data. Assisted by the estimated distribution, chance-constrained electricity balance constraints can be derived with high probability. Then model predictive control (MPC) based strategy is proposed to alleviate negative effects caused by imprecise day-ahead predictions. Moreover, the adjustment cost is also taken into consideration to measure the transfer cost from day-ahead scheduling plan to the rescheduled. Three cases are studied to verify the performance of the proposed strategy. Simulated results show that the strategy doesn't only achieve probabilistic guarantee but also improve the computation effectiveness.

articleTitle: Construction of a New Generation of Information Technology Remote Collaborative Office Efficiency Improvement Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper designs an intelligent integration system of online resources based on collaborative office. The system supports staff face recognition check-in, online conference, online leave reimbursement and so on. At the same time, the system realizes office document collaboration through independent cloud document module. The centralized deployment of the system to the operation performance, data processing, IT deployment and integration, real-time monitoring and other aspects of the requirements and corresponding technical processing. Develop and design the mobile intelligent collaborative office system, shorten the fault response time of the business platform, and form the fault log of the business platform. In this paper, the non-systematic work in the daily office process is integrated, and the routine work is recorded and archived, business traces are left, and quantitative assessment is carried out. The system performance test results show that the system has high server resource utilization, system throughput, and HTTP response number. It realizes intelligent processing of online confidential resources.

articleTitle: Design and Application Research of Bank Customer Portrait System Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Firstly, this paper proposes a portrait architecture of commercial bank application system based on log analysis. The system can realize effective analysis of log files and extract effective information to guide production and optimization decisions. Then based on the cluster analysis of customer data, this paper combines rough set theory and information entropy theory to reduce the property of investment customer portrait of commercial banks. The results show that the algorithm can effectively reduce the profile data of bank customers. The algorithm presented in this paper can provide a basis for attribute screening.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of YueXiang Aviation Information Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology in recent years, many information management models have been updated and iterated. Because of the complicated management content and the large number of management, the air ticket information can not be processed manually to meet the needs of users, so the aviation information management system emerged. The aviation information management system is divided into two permissions of the administrator and the user, the administrator can manage the basic information content of the user, the user can view the ticket information, can view the use of help and view the administrator reply information. The aviation information management system uses the B/S three-layer structure mode which is the most popular in the development of WEB applications. It uses the MySQL database which occupies a small space but has complete functions to store the data. The system development technology uses JSP technology. The aviation information management system can solve many problems of traditional manual operation. In general, the performance of the aviation information management system is stable, the function is more complete, and the cost performance is very high.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Network Attacks Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Nowadays, the rapidly growing internet also brings more and more network attacks. Such attacks seriously affect normal activities and threaten individual privacy. Applying machine learning approaches makes the detection and response to network attacks faster and effective. In this paper, it aims to review many of the individual researches and looks forward to future changes and modifications based on existing model. In this paper, it collects and analyzes many previous researches utilizing Naïve Bayes and SVM (Support Vector Machine) approaches in detection to network attacks. Starting from basic data processing to the detailed explanations of each research and its result, this paper compares their differences and similarities. In this paper, it also discusses the introduction to Naïve Bayes classifier, SVM classifier, and fundamental concepts involving in result analysis. In the end of this paper, it also summarizes the overall machine learning application on network attack detection, and looks forward to the future.

articleTitle: Research on automatic extraction method of quiet zone index in anechoic chamber
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Anechoic chamber is an indispensable measurement environment for antenna, electromagnetic scattering and electromagnetic compatibility measurement. The quiet zone of the anechoic chamber is an important indicator for evaluating the uniformity of the field, which directly affects the performance of the anechoic chamber. Compared with the measurement method used to search the quiet zone, it is a low-cost implementation method to determine the range of the quiet zone of the anechoic chamber by numerical simulation. However, most of the widely used methods are based on the prior knowledge of researchers. Specifically, the approximate range of the quiet zone in the anechoic chamber is first estimated, and then a large amount of planar grid data within this range are calculated to determine the accurate quiet zone. However, this method is time consuming, and the results obtained can only be presented in the form of a two-dimensional plane. In order to overcome these problems, this paper proposes an extraction method based on regional growth algorithm to efficiently and accurately extract the three-dimensional space of the quiet region of the anechoic chamber. The numerical results show that the proposed method can automatically determine the three-dimensional spatial range of the static zone without the needs of prior knowledge, which greatly shortens the solution time of the quiet zone compared with the conventional planar grid based extraction method.

articleTitle: Face tracking by fusing convolutional neural networks and particle filtering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Objective To address the problem of target loss due to the change of color, shape, texture and other features in face tracking, this paper proposes a face tracking algorithm integrating convolutional neural network and particle filtering. Methods Firstly, a large number of face images with different poses, different lighting and occlusion conditions are trained in the convolutional neural network to get the face feature maps under different conditions, then the trained network weights are used as the weight coefficients in the particle filtering algorithm, and finally the particle filtering algorithm is used for face tracking. Results In this paper, the OPE (one pass evaluation) evaluation criterion in OTB2015 database is used, and the area under the line (AUC) and the center point position error of the success rate graph are used as the evaluation criteria, and by doing comparison experiments with classical KCF, CSK, SRDCF, ECO-HC and other algorithms, the algorithm proposed in this paper achieves The proposed algorithm achieves a tracking success rate of 0.978 and a tracking accuracy rate of 0.97 on the test data. Conclusion In this paper, a face tracking model incorporating convolutional neural network and particle filtering is proposed, which can automatically track regions with large face differentiation and effectively improve the tracking accuracy of the target. Experimental results show that the algorithm in this paper can adapt to face tracking in complex situations such as different postures, different lighting and occlusion, with good robustness and real-time performance.

articleTitle: Convolutional neural network-based ASIL rating method for automotive functional safety
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the rapid development of the automotive industry, research in the field of functional safety has become increasingly important. Hazard analysis and risk assessment are extremely important aspects of the conceptual stage of automotive functional safety, so it is of practical guidance to design an objective and fair formulation method for the ASIL rating therein. In this paper, a convolutional neural network-based ASIL rating method for automotive functional safety is designed in conjunction with deep learning algorithms typical in the field of artificial intelligence. The algorithm is trained and validated on an existing ASIL rating dataset, achieving more satisfactory results.

articleTitle: Research on Public Opinion Data Collection of Electric Power Information Based on Web Crawler Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: As network communication becomes an important data foundation for the development and application of electric power. The rapid development of electricity public opinion will cause rapid spread and adverse effects if it is not controlled. Therefore, the collection of power network public opinion data has become an important research content in recent years. This paper uses web crawler technology to construct public opinion topic vectors. The web page similarity is calculated, and the public opinion topic data is crawled to realize the collection of public opinion data. By testing different numbers of web pages, the results show that the method in this paper has the advantages of high average recall rate, high accuracy rate, and less time-consuming data collection. It can effectively improve the efficiency of public opinion collection on the power network.

articleTitle: Dual Reciprocal Sensing Prediction Method of Underground 3D Displacement Based on RBF-MLP Neural Network Combination Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Landslides are a common natural disaster, often causing severe damage to people's lives and property. It is, therefore, necessary to monitor the three-dimensional underground displacement in geological hazard monitoring. The device uses the dual reciprocal voltage method to infer three-dimensional subsurface displacements based on the principle of electromagnetic mutual inductance. In this dissertation, the horizontal and vertical displacements are studied, and the reciprocal inductance voltage one, reciprocal inductance voltage two, and tilt angle are used as input parameters. The radial basis neural network is chosen to approximate the non-linear function by interpolation. Considering that RBF has only a single hidden layer, it may not perform well for highly non-linear problems. Therefore, a new method is proposed for predicting subsurface 3D displacement based on a combined RBF-MLP neural network model by augmenting the number of nodes in the RBF output layer and connecting the MLP neural network. The training data and model structure are essential for predicting subsurface 3D displacements, so the intervals of horizontal and vertical displacements are 0-50 mm, sampled at 1 mm intervals, and the relative axes are 0°-80°, sampled at 5° intervals. In the model evaluation, the average absolute error of horizontal and vertical displacements is within 0.4mm, which meets the accuracy requirements of landslide subsurface displacement monitoring.

articleTitle: Research on Power Stability Control Technology of Light Source for Steel Ball Surface Defect Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: When the semiconductor laser is used as the light source device to detect the surface defects of steel balls, because its output light power and light wavelength are greatly affected by injection current, ambient temperature and other factors, the output power of the light source is unstable, which will seriously affect the accuracy of steel ball surface defect detection. To solve this problem, this paper designs a power stability control system of small power semiconductor laser based on single-chip microcomputer, which can feedback control the output power and working temperature of the laser, and add an optical isolator in the laser to achieve automatic control of laser luminous power stability. After the simulation of the system, the 1310nm and 1550nm lasers are tested experimentally. The test results show that the circuit works reliably and the optical power control effect is good. The instability of the output power of the two lasers is 1.42% and 1.7% respectively. This design provides a relatively stable light source for the detection of steel ball surface defects.

articleTitle: Steel Types Association Analysis in Traffic Construction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Steel and connection joints are important and large amounts of materials for traffic engineering, research on the relationship between the use of different types of steel and connecting joints in the construction project is helpful for reasonable distribution and combination of them. The Apriori algorithm is used to analyze the association. First, according to the data engineering, some with fewer occurrences and unclear definitions are deleted in the original data, secondly, the association algorithm is used to select the frequent itemset and the maximum frequent itemset with high support, and then the association rules of the high index through the confidence level is found out, and finally, the association rules results with high lift in the association rules selected in the previous step are screened.

articleTitle: Structure Design and Simulation of Robot Arm for Confined Space Inner Roadway Repair
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to solve the problems such as low efficiency, heavy task, low mechanization and potential safety hazards in the process of underground roadway repair in coal mines, a multifunctional mechanical arm with large folding expansion ratio is developed to improve the roadway adaptability of the roadway repair robot and ensure that it can successfully complete the designated roadway repair task in the confined space. This paper introduces the structure composition, working principle and structural characteristics of the multi-functional roadway repair manipulator, and then uses the computer virtual simulation technology to verify the rationality and safety of the manipulator structure. The finite element analysis is carried out in the ANSYS Workbench environment, including the static analysis, dynamic analysis and modal analysis of the manipulator under two extreme working conditions. The analysis results show that the strength of the manipulator meets the requirements; The amplitude of the first six modes of the boom is too large, so it is necessary to increase the rib plate or the thickness of the plate at the appropriate position to improve its stability.

articleTitle: Optimal Allocation and Operation of Combined Heat and Power Microgrid Including Phase Change Heat Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In the combined heat and power (CHP) microgrid, the phase-change regenerative thermoelectric boiler bears part of the heat load, which can absorb the surplus renewable energy output and change the constraint relationship between electric energy and heat energy. Firstly, the model of cogeneration microgrid is established, and the operation mode of CHP microgrid including phase change regenerative thermoelectric boiler is established. Then, aiming at minimizing the equipment investment cost, the optimal operation configuration strategy of microgrid is studied. Finally, the legacy algorithm is used to analyze and solve the capacity optimization allocation model, which improves the renewable energy consumption capacity.

articleTitle: Research on Design of Advanced Marine Scientific Survey Vessel Based on Computer Data Engineering and Intelligent Information System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper studies the integrated fishery environmental scientific survey vessel system, which has the topology and data flow model of the scientific survey vessel information system with the time series database. The performance testing technology of big computer data in scientific survey ship information topology system has established a comprehensive fishery scientific survey system in ocean waters. The scientific research ship information topology system can meet the requirements of the information management algorithm for scientific research ship operation. In this paper, the topological structure of the information system is used to build the data flow model of the scientific research ship. series database. This paper designs a set of ship systems suitable for research and found that the system can meet the needs of comprehensive investigation and research tasks of fishery science in distant waters. The system provides computer platform support for fishery resource protection, environmental restoration, responsible exploration and fishing, and satellite remote sensing applications.

Author Keywords: Marine Fishery Comprehensive Scientific Survey Vessel

articleTitle: An Effective Incentive Mechanism for Individual Data Sharing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, an elegant mechanism of data-sharing and incentive is constructed based on personalized local differential privacy. We also proved that the mechanism is perfectly data privacy, arbitrage-free, ex-interim individually rational, Bayesian incentive compatible, and equilibrium. By this way, data consumer can maximize estimation accuracy with the lowest capital budget or minimize capital budget with the considerable accuracy.

articleTitle: Measurement and Analysis of the Transient Electric Field Generated by the Operation of the Disconnector in a 330 kV Substation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The making and breaking operation of the high voltage switch can generate transient electromagnetic field around the switch. This kind of switching transient EM field is a kind of radiated electromagnetic interference to the electronic equipment in the substation. On the other hand, it also contains the operation state information of the switch itself. So, this paper briefly reviews the research status on the switching transient electromagnetic environment in the substation. In addition, this paper measures the switching transient E-field pulses caused of the disconnector in a 330 kV substation. The measurement results can reflect the basic waveform characteristics of the switching transient E-pulse in both time and frequency domain. More importantly, the spectral differences between the three phases of the disconnector are also found. This is useful for locating pulses sources in the substation.

articleTitle: Public Opinion Forecast of Mobile Network for Targeted Poverty Alleviation Based on GA Elman Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In the era of mobile Internet, there are various ways of information transmission, and it is more and more convenient for people to obtain online public opinion information. Based on the theory of targeted poverty alleviation, this paper conducts accurate identification and prediction of some regions in China (including the east, middle and west) under the background of mobile Internet. This work will establish a GA Elman curve model based on targeted poverty alleviation mobile through literature analysis and use prediction methods to make pre judgment, and use prediction technology to build targeted and easy statistical calculation and other characteristic indicators to achieve dynamic optimization. After that, we designed a precision poverty alleviation mobile network public opinion prediction model, and conducted an experimental study on the model. The test results showed that the mean square error and absolute error of the model were 0.9 and 0.8, respectively, floating up and down, and the trend accuracy rate was the highest, up to 85.60%. Therefore, the prediction mobile network based on network public opinion was more accurate, more reliable, and more efficient, and its prediction mobile network effect was better. The prediction effect of the GA Elman model proposed in this paper was ideal.

articleTitle: Design of home burglar alarm based on MCU and PIR sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Along with the progress of The Times, anti-theft doors and Windows and civil air defense the way it is difficult to meet the needs of the People's Daily to prevent, pyroelectric infrared sensor due to its rapid development, relatively mature and the price is low wait for an advantage, application is more and more widely, based on pyroelectric infrared sensor with single chip microcomputer made home burglar alarm has good prospects for development. This design aims to develop a home anti-theft alarm based on MCU. This design intends to use the STC89C52 microcontroller produced by STC MCU Limited as the core device, in order to achieve the alarm design with infrared home anti-theft function. Because pyroelectric infrared sensor device has the function of detecting human body or animal by emitting infrared ray and converting detection information into corresponding electronic signal, this sensor is used for this alarm. The alarm system supports two different working states: manual emergency alarm state and deployment alarm state. In the state of manual emergency alarm, when the user presses the alarm button, the alarm will immediately sound and light alarm; In the deployment and alarm state, when the user presses the deployment button, the system triggers the sensor to work and monitor the deployment area. When an intruder is found, the sound and light alarm is triggered.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Design of Wireless Sensor Network with Particle Swarm Optimization and Improved Firefly Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Since wireless sensor network coverage belongs to the category of combinatorial optimization, to improve its coverage in the case of a limited number of nodes, we introduced and improved the PGSO hybrid algorithm. In this paper, the utilization rate of nodes and the adequate coverage of the network are first taken as the optimization goals, and we established the corresponding mathematical model. We carried out the simulation experiments under the condition of a certain number of nodes, and the coverage of the proposed hybrid algorithm is optimal. Compared to other algorithms, the convergence speed and coverage rate are improved. The first part of the article briefly describes the primary use of hybrid algorithms, and the second part models and compares the four algorithms.

articleTitle: A Stochastic Resource Management Scheme for Multi-Energy Group Control System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The interaction between various energy supply systems (cold, heat, electricity, gas, etc.) is becoming more tightly coupled as social economy and technology advance. Multi-energy systems are ineffective because different types of energy systems run independently. In order to protect the data privacy of each sub-system, this research suggests an ideal resource management framework for a multi-energy group control system. The energy hub (EH) paradigm is first suggested. When deploying EHs, the physical constraints of various energy systems are taken into account. Through scenario-based stochastic programming, the uncertainties of renewable energy are considered. According to the leader-follower relationship between multi-energy group control system operators and energy hub operators (EHOs), Benders decomposition is applied to decentralize the decision-making process. Finally, an example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed model and algorithm.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection Method for Connecting Bolts of Generator Rotor Coils Based on Local Enhancement and Regional Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The real-time detection of the state of the connecting bolt of the rotor coil in the hydro generator unit is of great practical significance for predicting and analyzing the electrical fault of the generator. In this paper, a bolt image detection method based on local enhancement and regional features is proposed. First, the image is locally contrasted in a fixed window to eliminate the problem of uneven image brightness caused by illumination in the visual detection system; Then, the real-time motion blurred image is restored by Wiener filtering, and the bolt shadow extraction algorithm is proposed to recognize the bolt. The experimental results show that the method has high detection efficiency and reliable performance. This method can meet the real-time detection requirements of generator rotor connecting bolts, and has broad application and promotion prospects.

articleTitle: Design of service robot control system for epidemic prevention and control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In view of the fact that Covid-19 is highly contagious, which poses great threat and inconvenience to people's production and life, a multifunctional robot control system with single-chip microcomputer as the control core is designed, aiming at the problems of centralized isolation points in communities, complicated situation and difficult management. Firstly, Gmapping algorithm is used to realize the robot's autonomous positioning and avoidance. Secondly, a three-degree-of-freedom robot arm is designed to disinfect any indoor space. Finally, Gmapping algorithm is used to recognize and measure the temperature of human face. Through the simulation experiment, this method can improve the efficiency of searching the shortest path and carry out disinfection work while reducing human contact, improving public safety and has practical value.

articleTitle: Design and Research of High Resolution Satellite Image Data Receiving and Processing System Based on RS Error Correction Coding
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Firstly, this paper studies the overall structure, key technologies and core hardware design of the high-resolution satellite image data receiving and processing system. The system adopts a real-time parallel image data receiving and processing algorithm based on RS error correction coding. At the same time, according to the characteristics of a single chip, combined with software design, the system has made corresponding research on RS decoding, noise reduction and signal processing software, and has carried out effective scheme and simulation verification design for different needs. The system can provide users with an intuitive and accurate user experience by using real-time point to point data transmission and automatic analysis of processing results for calculation. Image signal has rich and bright color expression and clarity. Compared with similar data sources, the spatial resolution is greatly improved. In traditional image processing, channel coding is the simplest and most convenient coding method, but it is more serious for low noise and inter symbol interference; Now, the satellite image data processing is basically to compress and store the collected data, decode and compress them, and then upload them. In this way, the decoder and storage device do not need to work at the same time, and the computing resources are greatly increased.

articleTitle: Research on BERT-based Text2SQL Multi-task Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the continuous development of computer technology, the Internet has entered the era of big data, which has spawned massive data in various fields and stored it in the database in a structured form. As an important national infrastructure, the power system is also constantly generating various types of data, and has become an important resource for daily operation and maintenance. During the interaction with the database, business personnel need to manually write SQL statements, which poses a challenge to a large number of nonprofessionals; At the same time, for experienced professionals, the conditions of SQL statements are complex and changeable, which is easy to make mistakes, thus affecting the utilization of data and the efficiency of queries. Therefore, how to fully explore the relationship between natural language and SQLstatements and apply them to power operation and maintenance is an important research topic. This paper studies the method of transforming natural language into SQL statement according to the current situation of power field. In terms of solution strategy, this paper divides the problem into several subproblems and combines BERT to carry out multi task learning. The experimental results show that this method is effective on Text2SQL tasks.

articleTitle: Research on Innovation Governance Intellectual Property Management System under the Integration of Digital and Intelligent Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Combining IPFS, SHA256 algorithm and digital certificate technology, this paper proposes a four-level, three-module public-tested intellectual property trusted management system. The system first extracts the information management process on the basis of sorting out the agent-oriented intellectual property business process. Then this paper establishes the intellectual property information integration platform model and designs it from the aspects of platform function architecture and security guarantee. Finally, the PMF software integrated development environment is selected to implement the model system software from three main aspects: data management function, process control function and application management function. The study found that the system can achieve the expected purpose and function, and promote the development of intellectual property management.

articleTitle: The design and application of multi-specialty electric power simulation training system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: As an important tool for electric power company to train dispatchers, monitors and substation operation and maintenance, electric power training simulation system plays an irreplaceable role in improving trainees' daily monitoring, normal operation, anomaly and accident handling skills. This paper describes the development process of electric power training simulation system and points out the lack of customized training mechanism for the role. Based on the "Internet +" intelligent learning platform of State Grid Gansu Electric Power Company, the design and application of an electric power simulation training system suitable for multiple majors are proposed, and the key technologies and technical details are introduced in detail. Relying on the "Internet +" intelligent learning platform, it standardizes the work flow of substation operation and maintenance personnel, improves the trainees' daily monitoring, normal operation, abnormal and accident handling skills, and provides continuous and reliable manpower support.

articleTitle: Research on Image Positioning Design of Bluetooth Circuit Breaker Detection Pipeline
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The image positioning system of the bluetooth circuit breaker detection pipeline is designed to realize the positioning detection of the circuit breaker tripping screw. Based on computer vision technology, the Hough gradient method is used to obtain the feature point information of the tripping screw, and the image preprocessing method is used to optimize the image quality, control the action of the servo motor, and accurately track and adjust the position of the screw and nut. Design the operation interface of the circuit breaker trip screw system, and complete the functions of image preprocessing, center coordinate extraction, and image center detection and display.

articleTitle: Research on the Optimization of Underwater Vehicle Dynamic System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the research status and application of the underwater vehicle system at home and abroad, the simulation analysis of the proposed underwater vehicle model was carried out with the help of CFD fluid dynamics simulation software. During this process, after careful consideration of the resistance in the case of long-distance operation, the model simulated the fluid resistance, viscous resistance and horizontal thrust in the movement of underwater vehicle in water. In this way, the layout and design indicators of the engine are optimized, which would provide reference for the subsequent optimization of the underwater vehicle power system.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Grid Infrastructure Intelligent Monitoring Platform Based on Distributed Real-time Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The construction of the power grid is a huge project involving various aspects such as electricity, communication and transportation. Distributed systems have the characteristics of convenient and flexible nonlinear data collection, so higher requirements are put forward for distributed equipment monitoring. At present, domestic research on intelligent network technology is still in its infancy. However, with the rapid development of social and economic levels, more and more demands for power supply security and reliability have also increased. At the same time, the traditional power grid has serious network failure problems in the construction process, it cannot adapt to the modern communication system of modern cities, which has caused a huge impact on the power grid construction. The distributed real-time monitoring platform can timely detect the problems in the urban power system for the power supply department, and provide reliable, accurate, stable and safe services. This paper first analyzes the distributed optical fiber sensing technology, which uses the unique characteristics of optical fibers to connect the distributed optical fiber sensor array to the power grid monitoring network, and then uses the traditional power transmission method to monitor the urban distribution network in real time, determines grid operating status through data analysis and simulation measurements. Secondly, this paper analyzes the software scheme and implementation of remote real-time monitoring system, which provides technical support for the construction of distributed real-time monitoring system. Finally, this paper proposes the data transmission based on distributed gateway and monitoring network communication, and uses network routing protocol to monitor and protect parameters such as grid voltage, current and signal in real time, so as to realize the real-time monitoring of grid voltage.

articleTitle: Intelligent Recognition Method for Transformer Acoustic Signal Based on MVF Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper proposes a transformer acoustic signal intelligent identification method based on MVF algorithm to analyze the transformer noise signal, extract the fault features, and realize the fault diagnosis. Through the multi-perspective feature extraction, selection and fusion, the multi-dimensional collection that can effectively represent the operating state of the transformer is constructed, and the accurate identification of the transformer operating state is realized through the parameter optimization support vector machine. The examples show that the proposed method can identify the operating status of transformer.

articleTitle: Research on modular charging systems based on digital twins
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The development of ammunition loading technology plays a vital role in the improvement of my country's national defense construction level. Compared with the traditional charge, the modular charge has the advantages of high interchangeability and modularity, and can realize the rapid filling of the charge. However, for the application of modular charging technology, when building unit modules, it is still necessary to manually teach the charging target point, and the modular charging technology has the disadvantage of being difficult to adapt to flexibility. Therefore, in the face of the diversity of ammunition, modular charge is not conducive to the rapid and efficient production of ammunition. The current automation technology is difficult to improve the flexible adaptability of modular charge. Aiming at the disadvantages of modular charging technology, a modular flexible charging system based on digital twin is proposed, including the construction of virtual charging workstation, key point identification, automatic trajectory generation and automatic robot program generation. The system greatly improves the production efficiency of modular charge, provides a reference for the research of modular flexible charge, and improves the digital manufacturing level of ammunition production.

articleTitle: Multi Vehicle Queue Forming Control Based on Multi-agent Swarm Motion Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The multi vehicle queue system composed of intelligent networked vehicles has attracted wide attention because of its high road traffic rate, low energy consumption and strong vehicle safety. It is generally regarded as one of the basic forms of intelligent transportation in the future. Most of the existing researches involving multi vehicle queues focus on the longitudinal stability control of the queue system. The implicit assumption is that vehicles have formed a queue or are located in the same lane. However, in the real traffic scene, due to the complexity of the environment, the vehicles are likely to travel in different lanes at different speeds, so the research of multi fleet formation control has important practical significance.

articleTitle: Research on Risk Warning Technology of Electric Power Backbone Communication Network Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the development of the electric power communication network, there is a large amount of services transmitted through the network. The scale of data gets larger, and types and sources are diversified in the communication network. Meanwhile, the reliability of electric power communication system is increasingly important in the production department. The traditional methods governing network data are greatly influenced by subjective factors, big data governance technology of the communication network has become the mainstream direction in researches. The paper introduces the event graph electric in the actual operational work of the electric power backbone communication network, then it could predict and diagnose network faults, which effectively avoid potential faults and risk in the network, and further ensure the safe and reliable operation of the electric power network.

articleTitle: A Monocular SLAM System Based on the ORB Features
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the rise of the AR/VR industry and the development of intelligent mobile robots and driverless vehicles, the industry has seen a spurt in demand for SLAM technology. On the other hand, the development of sensor technology, the abundance of computing resources, and the advancement of algorithms make SLAM technology transition from algorithm to product. The visual SLAM technology relies on the small size, low power consumption, and information-rich visual sensors to provide a map of the environment. Its positioning results in the map for robots in unknown environments, which is of great significance for robot automation and intelligent applications. Among the many vision SLAM technologies, ORB-SLAM stands out for its outstanding performance as an open-source project and a complete SLAM system that incorporates various current mainstream approaches. This paper presents the main components and methods of Monocular ORB-SLAM and tests and evaluates them using current popular datasets. Monocular ORB-SLAM can perform well in slow-movement, textured scenes but still needs to overcome the issue of tracking lost due to camera shake and fewer textures.

articleTitle: Constructing the Evaluation Index System of Chinese-Portuguese Machine Translation using the Delphi and Analytic Hierarchy Process Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Quality assessment is an important part of ensuring the quality and long-term development of machine translation. There is still much room for research into the evaluation of machine translation from Chinese to Portuguese, and no specific evaluation metrics have yet been developed. This study uses the Delphi method and Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) to construct an index system of Chinese-Portuguese Machine Translation and analyzes the relative index weight. The system includes four first-level indicators and nine second-level indicators. The weight of primary indicators, from high to low, is "Accuracy, fidelity" (52.5%), "Readability" (22.9%), "Fluency" (16.8%), and "Acceptability & Usability" (7.8%). The secondary indicators with the highest weight of each primary indicator are "Correction", "Lexicon", "Readability", and "Utility". AHP was used to transform the qualitative problems in evaluating Chinese-Portuguese Machine Translation into the quantitative problem in order to provide a theoretical basis and practical guidance for the future manual evaluation of Chinese-Portuguese Machine Translation, and for the eventual modification of automatic machine translation evaluation methods.

articleTitle: Data Augmentation for building QA Systems based on Object Models with Star Schema
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Enterprises produce massive amounts of data every day. Data records generated in various formats are usually classified into structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data [1]. Many transactional data records are crucial and need to be exchanged between systems, thus data conversion becomes necessary and even tedious. Moreover, decision-makers always make "ad hoc" requests that require searching within large volumes of data. Therefore, an intelligent system is needed to respond rapidly to the demands of modern enterprises. In this paper, we purpose a novel method to build a question-answering (QA) system from a transactional system. We use object models that are translated from a star schema to represent the transactional system, such that it can generate questions (Natural Language, NL) and answers (SQL statements) as the training data. Then, we use an end-to-end (E2E) neural network to train a QA system with the generated data. Our experiments show that the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network with a 0.95 BLEU value is more accurate than the Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) network with a 0.90 BLEU value. Consequently, the proposed method can automatically generate training data from object models, and the trained artificial intelligence (AI) model can further become a QA system for us to ask questions directly.

articleTitle: Research on time series based on improved LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the development of neural networks, the application of LSTM model has become the focus of relevant scholars. This paper first introduces the model of LSTM, CNN-LSTM, LSTM-ATtetion, and then carries on the practical application. Taking the CSI500 and CSI300 index from 2007 to 2022 as the research object, this paper uses the long short-term memory model (LSTM), and combines it with Attention mechanism and convolutional neural network (CNN) respectively to build a composite model for time series prediction.It is concluded that LSTM and its composite model have excellent predictive ability.

articleTitle: Privacy Preserved Federated Learning for Skin Cancer Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In recent years, the use of artificial intelligence to assist the medical industry in making more accurate diagnoses has become popular. To achieve a more accurate diagnosis, more data is often needed to constantly improve the model. However, when data needs to be shared by patients from different hospitals, patients may be reluctant to share their privacy with unknown institutions that they do not trust. This situation creates a Data Silo problem that hinders progress in AI diagnostics. Therefore, in this paper, we propose to use the Federated Learning framework to train models with private patient data on local clients and aggregate models on a central server, allowing participants to jointly train models without sharing data and technically breaking down Data Silos and enabling AI collaboration. Experiments demonstrate that compared to traditional CNN training, the CNN model base on the Federated Learning framework sacrifices 8% of accuracy to accomplish the above requirements. Due to the inherent nature of the distributed system, the training time and node communication time is also favorable.

articleTitle: PalmMatchDB: An On-Device Contactless Palmprint Recognition Corpus
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: A palmprint recognition system identifies a person by using palmprint qualities that may or may not be apparent to the naked eye. It has proven to be appropriate for a variety of purposes and applications such as access control, law enforcement and forensic analysis. Although there are several existing palmprint recognition systems in the literature, they are mostly developed based on localized database, thus querying optimality in other locations. Due to the sparsity of publicly accessible palmprint image databases for black people, we built a non-contact palmprint image database containing 12,000 grayscale images captured from 200 black subjects using three different mobile phone cameras with 5-, 8-, and 12-megapixel resolutions respectively. The palmprints images were preprocessed using mean filtering technique, segmentation and alignment, and this study presents the preliminary results with respect to the dataset for the proposed palmprint recognition system.

articleTitle: Integrated and Optimal Scheduling Model for Microgrids with Multiple VSG Types
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The mixed grid connection of multiple types of Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) increases the complexity of microgrid operation control and scheduling, and the coordinated control and energy management of different resources is a key problem to be solved in VSG-containing microgrids. In this paper, we develop a coordinated and optimal scheduling model for VSG-containing microgrids in the context of low carbon and environmental protection, taking into account low carbon and environmental protection, reliability, and economy. The model takes into account the virtual inertia of each type of VSG (wind turbine VSG, photovoltaic VSG and energy storage VSG) in terms of reliability, and the operating cost of each generation unit, interruptible load compensation cost, ladder carbon trading cost and pollutant treatment cost in terms of low carbon and environmental protection and economy. The simulation results validate the rationality and effectiveness of the proposed model, which can meet the urgent needs of low carbon, environmental protection and economic, reliable and effective dispatch of microgrid.

articleTitle: Extracting the Extreme Mode Operation of Coal Mills Using the Gaussian Mixture Model Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Coal mills have been the heart of running coal-fired power stations. Coal mills must operate safely and normally to avoid unnecessary unit load losses and complete shutdowns. It has been desirable to have a model that can detect anomalous behavior of a system. The objective of this paper is to be able to isolate unsafe operations or clusters from an unlabeled coal mill dataset. In this paper, Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) algorithm was implemented on a two-year dataset from an MPS-type vertical spindle coal mill of a power plant located in South Africa to label and classify them into different clusters. To implement GMM, one must assume the number of clusters in advance. Cluster performance evaluation criteria were selected to confirm and evaluate the assumed number of clusters.
