Furthermore, the operating behavior of coal mills was considered. GMM algorithm was found to fit the system dataset well, and it is good at isolating safe and unsafe modes of operation. This depends on finding the right balance in choosing the appropriate number of clusters and features.

articleTitle: Back-projection Residual Low-light Image Enhancement Network with Color Correction Matrix
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Pictures taken in low light conditions suffer from low brightness, feature loss, and color distortion. To address the problem, a Back-projection Residual Network with Color Correction Matrix (BRCCM-Net) for Low-Light Image Enhancement is designed through the following two stages. First, the BRCCM-Net extracts shallow features and inputs into numerous Residual Lightning Back Projection (RLBP) to adjust brightness and learn the residuals of normal light estimations together with the Feature Recalibration module (FRM) to capture and fuse more important feature information, which helps to recover the dark areas of low-light images. Second, a color correction matrix (CCM) model was designed to calibrate luminance and color. The experimental results on the LOL dataset show that the designed network has greater subjective visual effects such as brightness improvement, less noise, color distortion, and sharper and more natural image details. Comparatively, the results for objective indicators (PSNR, SSIM, and MSE) are also superior to those of other existing techniques.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of spatial electromagnetic field of transformer core considering nonlinear B-H curve
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Transformer core excitation characteristics are directly related to transformer operating conditions and life losses, and different core characteristics produce different spatial electromagnetic field distributions. In this paper, this paper construct a single-phase E-shaped transformer core model considering the nonlinear B-H curve, based on the principle of field-circuit coupling, and apply an external excitation source to investigate the trend of spatial electromagnetic field distribution and the distribution law of heat loss under nonlinear conditions. The simulation results show that when the core is saturated, the spatial electromagnetic field changes to nonlinear characteristics, at which time the spatial electromagnetic field is concentrated in the center column of the transformer, and the loss in the center column is too large; secondly, the loss in the upper and lower ends of the core is low, and the loss reaches the maximum at the corner of the center of the core. At the same time, the transformer current distortion occurs, the loss will increase sharply, and there is a rapid reduction in output current.

articleTitle: Next Point-of-Interest Recommendation for Cold-start Users with Spatial-temporal Meta-Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Next point-of-interest (POI) recommendation is to recommend the next POI that the users may want to visit according to their check-in trajectories. When there are few check-ins in the trajectories, it will cause the cold-start problem that traditional next POI recommendation methods can't capture users' preferences accurately and no longer has the ability to forecast the next POI. Based on the few-shot meta-learning method of MAML, this paper proposes a new method named STMeta to recommend the next POI for cold-start users. Following few-shot learning, the main idea of the proposed method is to train a model based on the long trajectories of other users with the aim to learn some transferrable and generalized knowledge which can be reused under the cold-start environment. For this purpose, it constructs a lot of short trajectories with only two POI checkins next to each other from the long trajectories to simulate the cold-start environment, and uses them to train a MLP with the ability of measuring the spatial-temporal transition information between two POI check-ins. This information indicates the probability that the users visit the next POI from current POI. And by computing such transition information between users' current POI and all candidate POIs, the most nearest POI can be recommended to users. Based on the public datasets of Gowalla and Brightkite, our experiments have shown that the proposed method achieves better performance in recommending next POIs for cold-start users when compared with related methods.

articleTitle: Research on power entity recognition technology base on BiLSTM-CRF
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the increasing demand for data automation and intelligent management in the field of electric power, knowledge atlas plays a particularly important role in intelligent query, electric power knowledge management and decision support. Entity recognition is the basis of building power knowledge map. In the field of power grid, because of its many types, large numbers and strong professionalism of entities, it is difficult to extract them by rules or manually, and it is also impossible to directly reuse entity recognition methods in other fields. For the field of power, this paper first analyzes the subject and characteristics of entity recognition, defines the task objectives of entity recognition, and then studies the entity recognition methods and technologies, and combines the advantages of BiLSTM and CRF, and proposes a method of power entity recognition based on BiLSTM CRF. Firstly, bi-directional features of text are extracted based on BiLSTM, and then the best sequence mark is obtained based on CRF method as the segmentation result. Based on the corpus of power science and technology papers, a comparative experiment is carried out. The accuracy rate of identifying power entities is about 88%, which is 3%~10% higher than the current common methods, which proves that this method can effectively identify power entities.

articleTitle: Research on image classification algorithm of domestic garbage based on deep learning method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Garbage classification and treatment is a necessary measure to fully implement garbage reduction, recycling, harmlessness and the construction of ecological civilization. With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, the use of artificial intelligence technologies such as deep learning to automatically classify images has become possible, and the classification of domestic garbage based on images has also become a specific problem in the field of deep learning. Therefore, this paper focuses on the widely concerned domestic garbage image classification problem, adopts the open source domestic garbage image dataset and the self-made unbalanced domestic garbage image dataset as the research object, studies the image classification task based on deep learning, and builds a deep learning-based domestic garbage image classification system based on the research results of this paper for users to quickly and accurately classify domestic garbage. The research results of this paper will provide valuable reference and reference for the research and practice of garbage image classification method based on machine vision, as well as the application of Flask framework and My SQL database design framework in garbage classification tasks.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Approach for Anomaly Detection in Power Mixing Equipment Intelligent Bearing Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Bearing and Gear are the essential and most significant pieces of pivoting machinery utilized in ventures. Normal applications incorporate planes, autos, power turbines, and steel plants. In the event of flaws happening in any bearing or gear, of these machines during working circumstances, serious outcomes are to happen. The issue determination utilizes the vibration signal at the beginning phase of shortcoming event. Vibration-based investigation is taken as a result of its simplicity of estimation. The viability of the astute shortcoming finding strategy is approved utilizing different datasets gathered from turning bearing and gear parts from an only made test rig in the research center through planned plans. For the robotized bearing shortcoming finding framework, three distinct and novel plans were figured out, and it is assessed. Also, for gear issue conclusion, another three unique and novel plans were modeled and assessed independently. In bearing issue determination, contain wavelet parcel change for highlight extraction, half and half hereditary calculation and particle swarm optimization for highlight choice and for coordinated ANFIS for navigation. In plot 2, Feature Extraction process did from the time and recurrence area of the gained signal, Hereditary Calculation and Particle Swarm optimization strategies with various wellness capabilities were applied. The outcomes from gear and bearing shortcoming analysis exhibit that the proposed smart shortcoming finding philosophy is exceptionally exact and successful in separating the issue examples of the two bearings and gears.

articleTitle: An Improved Support Vector Machine Attack Detection Algorithm for Industry Controls System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the application of Internet technologies in the industrial field, industrial control systems (ICS) have the possibility of suffering malicious network attacks. Because ICS is widely used in critical infrastructure, designing attack detection algorithms for it can effectively reduce losses. Many papers have built physical models for cyber-attacks against ICS and the corresponding detection algorithms have been proposed. However, the detection performance can be further improved. This paper establishes the simulation attack on the Tennessee Eastman (TE) process and proposes an improved support vector machine (SVM) method to detect integrity attacks. This algorithm uses contribution plots and recursive feature elimination to select features. Compared with the principal component analysis (PCA) feature extraction, the detection accuracy is improved. After adding system dynamics to the algorithm, the time to detect attacks is advanced.

articleTitle: Image Defogging Based on Joint Contrast Enhancement and Multi-scale Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Although the single image dehazing techniques now in use work well in certain circumstances, real-world scenarios' complex and ever-changing nature makes it impossible for them to function well. This research offers a contrast enhancement and exposure fusion-based efficient paradigm for picture dehazing. Three basic preprocessing techniques are utilized to create intermediate pictures for contrast enhancement. The first processing method is gamma correction (GC), employed to improve an image's local quality. The second technique is the newly developed color-preserving histogram equalization, which combines each channel to enhance the overall contrast. The third kind of processing is called ACE, which uses adaptability to deal with a complex and shifting environment. This paper fuses the input from GC, CPAHE, and ACE during the fusion stage using the adaptive kernel size fusion technique based on rapid structural patch decomposition. According to the experimental findings, it outperforms other cutting-edge visual and quantitative analysis techniques. The average FADE scores for the daylight and night-time scenes have increased by at least 0.09 and 0.08, respectively. This paper also describes how this strategy may be used in various contexts.

articleTitle: Research on composite grounding method of neutral point in distribution network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the rapid development of distribution network, the proportion of cable is gradually increasing, and the inherent fault location method is not applicable. The composite grounding mode, which is aimed at different fault types, chooses different working modes, and combines the advantages of various grounding modes. However, there are still some problems such as simple fault identification and imperfect control strategy. This paper studies the composite grounding mode, designs the hardware structure according to its functional requirements, and proposes an improved control strategy based on fault type identification: when the arc fault occurs, put in the arc suppression coil to extinguish the arc, if the arc extinguishment fails, put in the small resistance to cut off the fault line; when the permanent fault occurs, put in the small resistance to cut off the fault directly. The theoretical analysis of the proposed control strategy provides the basis for fault line selection. Finally, the theoretical analysis results are verified by simulation, which proves that the composite grounding method has certain advantages.

Author Keywords: arc suppression coil and small resistance

articleTitle: The calibration method of the external rotation axis for multi-line LIDAR
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The vertical field of view of the multi-line LIDAR is usually only about 30 degrees. To increase the vertical field of view, the standard method is to add an external rotation axis to form a rotating LIDAR device. Here need to calibrate accurately the position and attitude relationship between the multi-line LIDAR and the rotation axis. In order to calibrate the external rotation axis of a multi-line LIDAR, we proposed a method in this paper. First, rotate the LIDAR clockwise about the rotation axis to record the calibration board point cloud data at different rotation angles, and the corresponding rotation angles. Then, rotate these calibration board point cloud data counterclockwise around the rotation axis. If there is no error in the rotation axis, these point cloud data of the calibration board point will coincide. Based on this principle, by minimizing the thickness of the calibration board point cloud data, the rotation axis is iteratively optimized to obtain the optimal result. The performance of this algorithm is verified on a series of real data and synthetic data. Compared with similar methods, the estimated parameters of the proposed method show that the TPC (point cloud thickness) error is reduced by 5.4%.

articleTitle: Research on Base Station Location Based on K-Means Clustering and Simulated Annealing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the rapid development of mobile communication technology, the coverage range and signal quality of base stations are required to be higher and higher, so it will be of positive significance to choose the appropriate site. The problem of low signal coverage of the existing network is solved by setting up stations in weak coverage areas under the premise of considering the cost of setting up stations. In this paper, K-Means clustering algorithm is used to optimize the program time complexity, and the optimal station setting method is obtained by establishing the nonlinear programming equation and combining with the simulated annealing algorithm. For problem 1: This article first to the existing data preprocessing to reduce the data density, after combining set cost of station, station can complete portfolio to introduce the concept of value coefficient and value coefficient at various points as decision variable quantity, in the process of set up a new base station value coefficient as the target function, considering other constraints, using simulated annealing algorithm for the solution, The optimal solution method is 844 macro base stations, 156 micro base stations, the total cost is 8598, and the service coverage is 98.58%. For problem 2: after we cover model for simple planning, the monte carlo simulation considering the coverage of the sector as much as possible and matching for each base station as to achieve the maximum of its cover business sector set pattern, finally calculated the total business case coverage rate of 91.37%, still can satisfy the requirement of the high coverage rate. For problem 3: We specify that if the distance between two coverage points is not more than 20, they should be clustered into a category. At the same time, the coordinates of base stations are visualized and the location of existing base stations and weak coverage points is considered to reasonably select the site of the new base station. Then K-means clustering is carried out and DBI value is calculated to represent whether the clustering effect is good.

articleTitle: Generation Expansion Planning Model Considering Offshore Wind Power and Rotational Inertia Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: As the proportions of uncontrollable power such as DC power and offshore wind power increases, there will be a big challenge of the planning and operation for the receiving-end system. This paper proposes a generation expansion planning model considering offshore wind power integration and rotational inertia constraints. Firstly, based on the characteristics analysis of offshore wind power, scenario analysis method is introduced to describe the uncertainties of offshore wind power. Then, with the goal of minimizing annual comprehensive cost, a bi-level generation expansion planning model consisting of an outer-layer for planning optimization and an inner-layer for operating optimization is proposed in this paper. The quantitative relationship between the synchronous inertia and the Rate of Change of Frequency (RoCoF) is deducted, and introduced to the inner-layer to ensure adequate inertia supporting capabilities. Case studies verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: A Time Series Data Classification Method Based on Basis Function Expansion and Bagging Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: For the time series data classification problem, we propose a method combining basis function expansion and Bagging framework. The proposed method can capture the functional features of time series by using basis function expansion, and deal with the problems of high dimension and large noise of time series. Furthermore, since the importance of each coefficient of basis function expansion for the response variable is unknown, we can model it using a bagging framework. Since the base classifier is free, we can use different classification models to capture the linear and nonlinear information between the coefficients of basis function expansion and the response variable. In the actual data analysis, we consider three expansion methods such as functional principal component basis, Fourier basis, and B-spline basis, and use GBDT as the base classifier under the Bagging framework. The experimental results show that the proposed method has better classification performance than the traditional classification method and shows a certain universality.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Deep Immune Network Algorithm for Smart Grid Fault Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the effect of traditional neural network in fault data diagnosis of power system is not obvious, inspired by the application of deep learning image recognition, this paper combines immune algorithm and deep learning, and proposes a new smart grid fault data analysis method based on deep immune network. Deep immune network is an immune-improved deep learning network, which extracts features from data through the multi-layer structure of convolutional neural network, and inputs feature samples into the immune-optimized radial basis network to classify faults. By analogy with the immune process of biological immune system, a fault diagnosis immune model suitable for power grid fault data analysis is proposed and established. By establishing a one-to-one mapping relationship with biological immune system, the model structure was improved and optimized accordingly. Finally, the experiment proves that the fault diagnosis immune model has excellent learning ability and the fault recognition efficiency is improved compared with the traditional fault diagnosis method.

articleTitle: Nonuniform Doppler Shift Estimation for Fast Moving Underwater Acoustic Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, based on the traditional Orthogonal Matching Pursuit (OMP) algorithm, we add a dynamic adjustment mechanism to the OMP algorithm to make the estimation algorithm have the advantage of adaptive channel sparsity by using the residual energy as the condition for iteration termination. The estimation algorithm is able to adapt to the sparsity of the channel and dynamically adjust the number of iterations according to the characteristics of the timevarying channel. In addition, when expanding the data support set, the atom selection step in the iteration process is adjusted according to the signal residual energy, which can both estimate the signal accurately and avoid increasing the computational effort. The performance of the algorithm is simulated under different SNR conditions and different relative motion speeds, and it is verified that the method has excellent accuracy and noise immunity for dynamic hydroacoustic communication nonuniform Doppler factor estimation in shallow sea environment; the large Doppler factor can be estimated accurately for high-speed motion at speeds up to 60 knots; and the sparsity adaptive Doppler factor estimation can be achieved, Compared with the OMP algorithm, the computational effort is significantly reduced.

articleTitle: Hybrid Recommendation Algorithm Combining Content and AHP
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Personalized recommendation system is an effective way to help users quickly obtain demand data in the era of information overload, but there are still problems such as sparse data, cold start, inaccurate similarity calculation, etc. In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes a hybrid recommendation algorithm that combines content and analytic hierarchy process. First, the user profile constructed by user information, project information and scoring information is fused with the content based recommendation algorithm. Then, we use AHP to improve the similarity calculation and prediction score of the traditional collaborative filtering algorithm. Finally, the content recommendation algorithm based on user profile and the improved collaborative filtering algorithm are mixed in a weighted way to obtain a hybrid recommendation algorithm that combines content and analytic hierarchy process. Experiments show that, compared with other comparison algorithms, the algorithm proposed in this paper can overcome the limitations of a single algorithm, effectively improve the accuracy of the recommendation results, and thus improve the recommendation quality.

articleTitle: Hybrid Recommendation Algorithm Combining Project Importance and Prediction Score
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of long tail and poor recommendation quality, a hybrid recommendation algorithm combining item importance and predictive score is proposed. Firstly, the Personal Rank algorithm is used to calculate the item importance. Taking the project score as the edge weight, optimizing its graph structure; Increase the wandering probability of minority projects and high score projects to further capture the potential relationship between users and projects; Generate a set of candidate recommendations by ranking items by importance. Secondly, Slope One algorithm is used to predict the score of the items in the candidate recommendation set. In order to improve the accuracy of prediction, the deviation calculation method was optimized considering the similarity of user scores. The final prediction score was corrected using the credibility weight. Finally, the influence of project importance and predicted score value on recommendation is integrated, and the recommendation is completed by ranking the comprehensive recommendation value. The proposed algorithm was verified and analyzed on the real data set. The experimental results show that the proposed hybrid algorithm has improved the recommendation indexes compared with other literatures, which proves that the proposed algorithm effectively alleviates the long tail problem and improves the recommendation performance.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous Embedded Resource Management under Space-based Edge Computing Environment with Kubernetes Device Plugin
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Edge devices are widely applied in space scenarios for their compact size and diminished power consumption. To avoid the collision of different applications, containerizing applications becomes a more welcomed option compared to virtual machines for its light-weightiness and short loading latency. Kubernetes, considered a de facto framework for orchestrating containers, allows automatic allocations of resources connected to nodes, but it only supports management on CPU, I/O, network, and storage by default. Supported devices can be extended with its device plugin mechanism however, official device plugins might not work on edge devices, as their functionalities are constrained due to its compactness, such as NVidia TX2 that is not supported by the official Nvidia GPU device plugin. Moreover, devices vary in type, and architecture and even some do not support operating systems, making it unintelligent to develop device plugins separately. Therefore, managing device plugins becomes an urgent problem for edge cloud providers. In this paper, we proposed and implemented a paradigm of orchestrating devices that allows Kubernetes manage edge devices, even if they do not run operating systems. As for the obstacles of being unable to report the device topology of a single node to the scheduler, we proposed an approach to hijack the scheduling process without establishing a new scheduler. We conducted experiments and the results showed that the platform we proposed can enable Ku-bernetes to manage various devices without device plugins, both on on-board embedded devices and non-OS-supported devices. We tested its performance and capacity with a simulated device, and the result shows that it only causes 6.34 % overhead, and its embedded scheduling method has an adequate performance compared to optimum method, which is only 7.7 % slower.

articleTitle: The Prediction of SOH and Capacity for Battery Based on Charging Voltage Curve during Equalizing Charge
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Based on the relationship between the characteristics of the small charging voltage curve and the current full capacity, a method to evaluate the capacity of lead- acid batteries by extracting the health characteristics (HF) of the charging voltage curve and bringing them into the mathematical model is proposed in this paper. In the charging stage of the battery, the time interval between equal voltage rise periods as the HF and the ergodic method are used to search for the best voltage rise period. Then, with HF series as input and usable capacity series as output, a Gaussian process regression (GPR) model reflecting the capacity change of batteries was established. To improve the accuracy of the GPR model, the rational quadratic covariance function is used as the core function, and the conjugate gradient algorithm is used for optimization . At last, the experimental results of lead-acid batteries show that the proposed method can predict the stage of health(SOH) under different charging conditions effectively with small training samples, reflecting the advantages of short estimation time, high accuracy, small training sample size, and strong application prospects .

articleTitle: Forecast of State of Charge and Adaptive Voltage for Lithium-ion Batteries Using Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: An accurate forecast of the state of charge (SOC) of lithium-ion batteries is vital to ensure the safe use of lithium-ion batteries. The accurate estimation method of lithium-ion battery (BAT) SOC is realized by optimizing the neural network parameter method and stable and fast transverse filtering algorithm (SFTA).The backtracking search algorithm (BSA) is used to optimize the output weight and threshold of Radial basis function neural network(RBFNN), to realize the SOC prediction of ternary lithium polymer battery. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can achieve reliable SOC estimation and parameter identification of a combined empirical model. The adaptive voltage estimation error is controlled within 2%, and the SOC prediction accuracy under the different temperatures of the RBFNN-BSA algorithm is controlled within 2.5%, which meets the actual requirements.

articleTitle: Construction of LC Filter Integrated Circuit and Analysis of Control System Function
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: As one of the important components of integrated circuits, inductors play an important role in filtering, energy storage and impedance matching in many fields, such as communication and manufacturing. However, the existing traditional filters are not highly integrated, and have the defects of large volume and high energy consumption. Therefore, in this paper, constructs an integrated square spiral inductor model based on MEMS technology by using a finite element simulation method. First, through the simulation analysis of performing the model, the inductance coefficient is calculated and we analyze the spatial electromagnetic field distribution characteristics, and then the functional rationality of the model is verified. It is used to build the LC filter and analyze the principle of different filtering functions. Second, based on Proteus simulation software, an integrated circuit single-chip microcomputer control system with an LC filtering function composed of square spiral inductors is built. Finally, through the analysis of the simulation results, the results show the LC filter integrated circuit constructed in this paper has the characteristics of low-pass, high-pass, band-pass and band-cease filtering functions, and can be associated with the external control system to realize the intelligent operation of the integrated circuit.

articleTitle: Influence of the Solid Heat Storage Electric Boiler on Optimal Operation of a Combined Heat and Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to clear and define the influence of Solid Heat Storage Electric Boiler (SHSEB) on the operation of the Combined Heat and Power (CHP) plant, this paper builds a feasible operation region model and a coal saving rate model of the extraction condensing unit equipped with SHSEB. Moreover, the heating capacity power of SHSEB, regulation capacity and the cost to operate CHP plant is analyzed and compared with electrode electric boiler and water storage heat accumulator. Deflating the features of the current CHP plant, a prevalent day-ahead optimization operating plant model is constructed. As via original operation data of the CHP plant in Northeast of China, the models which were just being discussed above along with the analyzed theory results are verified. The model and research results can contribute to the theoretical tools and references for the optimal operation of CHP plants.

articleTitle: Research Control a Smart Car Based on Chinese Voice Recognition Technology through the Raspberry Pi 4B Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: A substantial proportion of ways controlling small smart cars such as wireless remote control and mobile phone remote control are achieved through manual controlling the cars. This paper proposes a smart car control system based on speech recognition technology, which controls smart car movement via voice command and improves the level of intelligence and individuality efficiently. The key of the project is to combine voice recognition with intelligent car control through the Raspberry Pi 4B platform. This paper combines the voice recognition module and coding in Python to realize the effective voice control of the intelligent car.

articleTitle: FRTB-Fast Blockchain architecture based on block data and data protection system’s file partition tables
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: At the beginning of its birth, Blockchain technology solved the "Byzantine general" technology to realize the distributed consensus mechanism, data traceability and other functions in the insecure and untrusted network environment. The earliest application of Blockchain consensus mechanism started from the proof-of-work(PoW) mechanism of Bitcoin application in 2008, but PoW has low service throughput and low performance. The subsequent PoS, DPoS, and Practical Byzantine (PBFT) and other new consensus mechanisms are based on the performance improvement of distributed consensus to improve the Blockchain tampering, low performance and other problems. These consensus mechanisms require a lot of computation for distributed consensus. These also bring the possibility of Sybil Attack and Double Spend Attack by malicious nodes, and the node malicious attack events facing the Blockchain are also increasing. Based on this, this paper proposes a fast Blockchain architecture FRTB, which based on block data and data protection storage file partition table(FAT). On the basis of the original Blockchain architecture, the architecture adds block Data Protection system and block data storage file partition table information, which has a direct role in Blockchain’s traceability and tamper-proof. It has the characteristics of physical tamper-proof, traceability, fast distributed consensus and so on.

articleTitle: Power equipment parameter acquisition system based on single chip microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper made a parameters acquisition and transmission system of power equipment, and is mainly used in power distribution network, at the end of the power equipment of electric energy parameters measurement and wireless transmission to the mobile client, high-risk or valuable real-time monitoring of power equipment, to improve the quality and safety of residents and industrial power provides a solid guarantee. The system uses STM32 as the processor of the system. RN8302 chip processes the parameters such as voltage, current, frequency and power of the collected power equipment, and sends them to the mobile phone client through ESP8266 wireless module. At the same time, they are displayed on the LCD screen. And broadcast under certain circumstances. Through the system design and the software and hardware debugging, various modules are normal and stable work, this system can realize collection and transmission of electric power equipment parameters, can be effective for monitoring of power equipment, and the power equipment parameter collection and transmission system to accomplish the expected design requirements, measurement accuracy, has certain anti-interference ability, and has certain market potential.

articleTitle: Global Target Tracking Algorithm Based on Improved Twin Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The target tracking algorithm based on twin neural network is a classical deep learning target tracking method, and has attracted much attention due to its superior and stable tracking performance. GlobalTrack is a tracker for global instance search based on twin neural network architecture. Tracking globally can greatly improve the success rate of tracking. However, when the tracking target has motion blur, fast motion and other challenges, the tracker will lose track. To solve the above problems, a global target tracking algorithm based on improved twin neural network is proposed. Swin Transformer with better feature extraction ability, is introduced as the backbone network of feature extraction to improve the ability of target feature extraction. A regional proposal network that guides anchor points is introduced to improve the quality of generation of candidate frames for models in motion blurred scenes. A regional convolution neural network is used, According to the ROI characteristics of the target template, the prediction of its label and border is refined, and then the final prediction is obtained by classification and regression. Through a large number of experiments on OTB2015 and VOT2018 datasets, the tracking effect of this method is good, and it has strong robustness and adaptability in a variety of complex situations such as motion blur, fast motion, and meets the real-time requirements of the tracking algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Distributed Phase Modifier Configuration Method for Short Circuit Ratio Requirements
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The MRSCR of renewable energy multi-station short-circuit ratio can visually and effectively measure the voltage strength of renewable energy multi-station access system, and the distributed regulator can make the short-circuit ratio of renewable energy stations effectively better to effectively avoid the renewable energy stations to reduce power output and maintain the system’s stable operation. Therefore, in the face of the increasing proportion and importance of renewable energy generation, to research the optimal configuration of distributed regulator for short-circuit ratio demand has great practical value. This thesis theoretically deduces the definition and calculation method of MRSCR of renewable energy multi-station short-circuit ratio, gives its general formula, and analyzes the factors affecting MRSCR and its critical value; analyzes and compares different methods (centralized, distributed and hierarchical decentralized) for optimal configuration of distributed regulators. On this basis, the configuration method of the distributed type of the dimmer is chosen based on the lowest point of MRSCR configuration. Finally, with the measured data of a large renewable energy base in northern China, the PSD-BPA SCCP short-circuit calculation program is used to check on the simulation calculation of the method proposed in Chapter 3 of this thesis to configure the distributed phase modifier at the lowest node of the short-circuit ratio. The calculation results prove the effectiveness of this method phase modifier configuration.

articleTitle: Exploration and Classification of Materials using Tactile Sensors and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Advancing sensing systems is one of the core issues of Electrical Engineering. The sense of touch gathers information through the direct contact of skin and an object, making tasks such as manipulating objects and ascertaining their properties, such as temperature, roughness, and stiffness, possible. Tactile sensors replicate one or more dimensions of the sense and have potential applications in robotics and quality control. In this research, I propose a new method that uses a simple tactile sensor and machine learning algorithms to analyze materials. Two datasets, one with common materials such as felt, cotton, and wood, and another with wrinkled and smooth paper to simulate defects, are created. Two Machine Learning models, Support Vector Machine and Convolutional Neural Networks, evaluated the datasets. After optimization, both models reached accuracies around 90% for both datasets, demonstrating that combining Machine Learning and simple tactile sensors for material classification and defect detection is a viable research direction. This research throws new light on applying Machine Learning to traditional engineering disciplines such as Embedded Systems.

articleTitle: Semi-supervised Spatial Spectral Local Discriminant Analysis for Hyperspectral Image Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Making full use of the spatial spectral features contained in hyperspectral images, a hyperspectral image feature extraction algorithm (S<inf>4</inf>LFDA) for semi-supervised spatial spectral local discriminant analysis is proposed, in view of the spatial consistency of hyperspectral datasets, the pixels are first spatially reconstructed to preserve the neighbour relationship of hyperspectral data, and then the spectral information divergence is introduced to reconstruct the similarity between cells, and in order to make full use of a large number of unlabeled samples to improve the performance of the algorithm, the fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm is used to cluster the samples to obtain pseudo-labels. Then, the normalization term is added to the intra-class divergence matrix and interclass divergence matrix of the local FDA algorithm to maintain the consistency of the cluster structure of the unlabeled samples, and finally the local FDA algorithm is used to maximize the interclass divergence and minimize the intra-class divergence of the labeled samples and solve the best projection vector. The S<inf>4</inf>LFDA algorithm not only maintains the divisibility of the data set in the spectral domain, but also maintains the neighbour relationship of the pixels in the spatial region, rationally uses labeled samples and unlabeled samples, and improves the classification performance of the algorithm. Experiments were carried out in Pavia University and Indian Pines, and the overall classification accuracy reached 95.60 and 94.38, which effectively improved the performance of feature classification compared with other dimensional reduction algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Target Detection and Grabbing Positioning Method Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: For livestock and poultry carcass segmentation, the labor intensity is high, the skill requirement is high, and the segmentation efficiency is low; The segmentation process of livestock and poultry meat takes a long time, which is easy to cause secondary pollution of meat and other problems. It is necessary to upgrade the existing livestock meat processing industry and improve the intelligence degree of the current livestock carcass processing technology. In this paper, a fast adaptive histogram equalization method is proposed to enhance the contrast of the pig leg image captured by 3D camera, and then the trained YOLOV4 model is used to detect and calibrate the specified bone position of the pig leg image. This method first needs to establish local coordinate systems for the manipulator and the grasping target respectively, then uses Eye to Hand hand calibration system to obtain the corresponding conversion matrix, and transmits the position information of the grasping target to the manipulator, so that the manipulator can move to the designated position correctly and complete the grasping operation successfully. Field experiments verify the feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Advance in 3D printing defect detection technology based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the development of manufacturing industry, defect detection is more and more widely used in industrial production, and there are more and more strict requirements for the accuracy and efficiency of detection. Compared with traditional manufacturing methods, 3D printing, with its unique manufacturing method, has unique advantages in small batch and multi batch manufacturing. This review aims to introduce some of the mainstream methods of industrial defect detection. First, it introduces the background and characteristics of industrial defect detection, introduces the industrial CT of classical nondestructive testing methods, and introduces the classical methods of defect detection and deep learning methods. The 3D reconstruction of defects is also introduced, and the methods of obtaining defect detection data and optimizing industrial parameters are introduced, and the commonly used defect detection data sets are summarized. Finally, the future development trend and potential research directions in this field are prospected.

articleTitle: Combining spatial attention and cross-layer bilinear pooling for fine-grained image classification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: To address the problems of large intra-class difference and small inter-class-class difference in fine-grained images and the difficulty of obtaining effective feature representations, this paper proposes a method combining spatial attention and cross-layer bilinear pooling for fine- grained image classification, which can learn a more powerful fine-grained feature representation. In the paper, extract the underlying image features through ResNet50 network and inspired by the multi-scale detection algorithm of small-size objects, a spatial attention mechanism is used to achieve adaptive adjustment of the spatial weights of each layer features in fusion, which promotes more effective fusion of higher-level features and lower-level features to complement each other. In addition, cross-layer bilinear pooling is proposed in the paper to integrate the features of each layer after two- by-two interaction in order to explore the correlation of features between layers. Finally, by evaluating on three publicly available datasets, the experimental results indicate that the proposed method is superior to the existing classical methods in terms of classification.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis for Central Lithium-ion Batteries: Security Concerns and Recycle Strategies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: As of late, the ascent of new enterprises, like new energy vehicles, has advanced the turn of events and market inclusion of force lithium batteries. Ternary lithium batteries and lithium iron phosphate batteries have generally showed up on the lookout. With the steady development of the business, the expansion in decommissioning, and the rising a worldwide temperature alteration pattern, the security, and reusing of ternary lithium batteries and lithium iron phosphate batteries have progressively turned into the main examination course. In this paper, the state-of-the-arts lithium-ion batteries are comprehensively analyzed in terms of operation principles, thermal modeling, aging, and the recycling relevant strategies.

articleTitle: Borehole Trajectory Optimization System Based on Snake Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The wellbore trajectory directly affects the whole drilling efficiency and safety. at present, there are many studies on the calculation of wellbore trajectory, but there are still some problems, such as inaccurate calculation, not comprehensive consideration of factors and so on, which will easily affect the follow-up engineering. In order to solve the above problems, through the geometric analysis and force balance analysis of the wellbore trajectory, the snake optimization algorithm is used to optimize the track length, resistance and other multi-objectives, which can obviously increase the calculation accuracy and speed. Finally, based on the content, a set of reasonable acceptance criteria for drilling completion is put forward, and the space margin is set as a sufficient constraint, and the other three indexes are weighted to get that the track length, resistance and torque weight are 0.485, 0.205 and 0.311 respectively. Compared with other methods, the calculation speed is faster and the accuracy is higher.

articleTitle: Review of Research on Running Condition Monitoring of High Voltage Cables
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: At present, the reliability of power supply of high-voltage cables is a technical hotspot and difficulty that is closely watched in the world. This paper reviews the running condition monitoring techniques applied to high-voltage cables. First, the principle analysis and characteristic comparison of various PD detection techniques are reviewed; secondly, the overview and principles of five running temperature monitoring techniques are reviewed; in addition, the theory and application of ground current detection techniques are reviewed; finally, the cable condition diagnosis technology is reviewed. To monitor the running condition of high-voltage cables, make reasonable judgments, find defects in time, and then improve the reliability of power supply. This paper provides theoretical and application guidance.

articleTitle: Path planning optimization strategy of mobile robot in two-dimensional fixed environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In two-dimensional space, this paper aims at the problems of slow convergence and poor real-time performance of existing path planning algorithms. A free growing tree algorithm (SOGT) is proposed. The algorithm mainly includes three parts: heuristic biased sampling, exploratory expansion to generate sampling points, and path optimization. The heuristic bias sampling part uses the concept of dynamic target gravity field, which can improve the utilization rate of sampling points, control the sampling range to the direction of the target point, and improve the convergence speed of the algorithm; When choosing the parent node, the heuristic expansion approach can minimize the number of collision detection.; Path optimization employs maximum distance and corner optimization techniques to shorten the path’s length, as well as its angle and number of corners. The simulation results show that the SOGT algorithm is feasible and effective, and achieves high real-time performance and fast convergence speed.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of StateGrid Blockchain-Based Regulation Platform of Source-Grid-Load-Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the explosive growth of the electricity market, electric energy storage and flexible load are constantly integrated into the power grid, which makes the traditional distribution network architecture change greatly. Source-grid-load-storage technology can adapt to the needs of energy transformation, promote the evolution of the traditional power grid from the function to the energy Internet, and upgrade to the new generation of power system from the technical point of view, and its physical characteristics, structural form, operation mechanism and control mode are obviously different from the traditional power system, which is considered to be the key to the continuous and in-depth promotion of China's energy transformation. In this paper, we proposes a source-grid-load-storage regulation system based on State Grid blockchain, which take advantages of the characteristics of decentralization, immutable, consensus and smart contracts of blockchain. The system introduce transaction and data collaboration model based on blockchain, deeply integrates blockchain technology and source-grid load-storage technology, effectively promote the establishment of market-oriented and financialized energy trading platform construction, and verifies the broad prospect of the combination of blockchain technology and source-grid-load-storage technology.

articleTitle: Self-supervised Image Classification Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Image classification has been a trendy research topic in the field of pattern recognition and computer vision, which extracts different features of images and predict the category of images. Thanks to the development of deep learning, powerful convolutional neural networks can be used in the field of image recognition. However, existing deep learning-based image recognition research mostly follows the framework of supervised learning, and model learning relies on a large number of accurate labels. Providing a large amount of label data will undoubtedly require laborious human effort and expensive costs. Therefore, image recognition based on unsupervised learning (without using any image category labels to achieve classification) has become a spotlight for research. In this paper, explorations on the image classification by self-supervised framework SimCLR on image classification successfully clusters a large number of images into an optimum amount categories. Qualitative results have show SimCLR is particularly effective in recognizing the colors of images; both qualitative and quantitative results shows SimCLR is great at identifying simple contours. However, when the colors are similar, and contour lines are complex, SimCLR does not obtain satisficing results. The accuracy on classifying Mnist dataset is 32%.

articleTitle: Residual Life Prediction of Rolling Bearings Based on Multi-source Domain Sub-domain Adaptive
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: To solve the problem of low prediction accuracy of remain useful life (RUL) of rolling bearings caused by limited information of single source domain and insufficient alignment granularity of domain adaptation, Multi-source and subdomain adaption network (MS_SAN) prediction method for residual life of rolling bearings was proposed. This paper has said, the collected original vibration signal is processed by FFT, and the frequency domain signal is input into the model. Perform one-dimensional mapping to visualize data of multiple target domains and source domains in the common feature space. Then adjust the degradation stage of each target domain and source domain to meet the independent requirements of the feature space. Finally, combined with the output of RUL prediction module in various fields, the final prediction results are obtained. The experimental results on the real world dataset PHM2012 show that the proposed model MS_ The performance of SAN is superior to the most advanced methods, and it can effectively predict its remaining use value.

articleTitle: AttRSeq: Attack story reconstruction via sequence mining on causal graph
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With massive alerts to investigate, cyber analysts often face with alert fatigue and may miss true attack events. As cyber-attacks are becoming increasingly targeted and sophisticated, many attack story reconstruction techniques are proposed to trace back attack steps based on causal graphs and help cyber analysts understand how an attack unfolds. However, most existing techniques are heuristic or rule-based and require a great deal of effort to develop the rules or heuristics. This paper presents AttRSeq, a framework discovering similar attack steps across different APT instances and identifying nodes that contribute to an attack. Regarding attack entities in causal graphs, AttRSeq extracts a set of attack sequences recording critical steps of an APT attack. It then leverages an attention-based Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) to learn key sequential patterns of attack and non-attack behaviors to detect ones that contribute to an attack. To verify the effectiveness of our proposed method, we conduct comparison experiments on a public dataset. The results show that our proposed model has a robust performance that exceeds the current state of the art.

articleTitle: Refined Modeling and Simulation Method of Raw Signal Returns for Space-based Radar
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Radar echo refinement simulation is an important means to provide data for space-based radar design demonstration. Most of the current simulation methods ignore the real surface topography and complex geomorphic distribution, and the target characteristics are not sufficiently described, resulting in a shortage of refined radar echo data, which is difficult to meet the demonstration requirements of space-based radar early warning detection system. This paper proposes a more refined simulation method for space-based radar echo, mainly from the background clutter and target echo two aspects of fine modeling: Firstly, based on the real ground battlefield environment fluctuation model and complex geomorphic distribution attributes constructed by GIS (Geographic Information System) data, a refined space-time two-dimensional clutter simulation model of space-based radar is constructed which simultaneously includes the characteristics of terrain fluctuation scattering distribution, terrain occlusion and diffraction, earth-sea clutter distribution and earth rotation. Secondly, based on the efficient modeling technology of ray-tracing high-frequency electromagnetic scattering, the target characteristics in the detection scene are finely modeled, which can fully consider the changes of target characteristics under different conditions. Finally, the rationality of space-time two-dimensional echo signal is verified and analyzed by simulation cases. The echo generated by this method is closer to the real situation, and provide support for the research of space-based radar system design and clutter suppression algorithm.

articleTitle: Solving the point cloud registration based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Point cloud registration is used to create a complete environment map with multiple pieces of scans. It is used mostly to guide autonomous robots when the surrounding is complicated. However, the problem is hard to solve so deep learning networks are often utilized. Most neural networks proposed need manual annotation and selection of patches which is time-consuming and makes the model only work for one particular scenario. In this work, a new method is studied in which a self-supervised learning technique is incorporated into the network. The input to this network is one raw point cloud without any labels or annotations, and as a result, the need for annotating or selecting patches is removed. A key point sampling process is also implemented in this network, which filters non-relevant points and further improves the performance. Based on our experiments, this self-supervised model has the capability of performing better than those requiring manual processing of the input.

articleTitle: Research on Reactive Power Impact and Optimization of Photovoltaic Power Distribution Network Based on the Concept of Power Flow Direction Change
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the development of the national economy, the distribution network equipment has been continuously upgraded and the operation level has been continuously improved, and the distribution network has gradually developed in the direction of automation, forming an active distribution network with high penetration, high reliability and self-healing rate of distributed power sources. However, the large-scale access of distributed photovoltaics in the active distribution network often leads to problems such as voltage fluctuation, harmonic over-limit and power factor reduction in the distribution network, which has a great impact on the power supply quality of the distribution network. Among them, the reduction of the power factor of the distribution network will lead to an increase in line loss, a decrease in voltage, and a decrease in equipment utilization, which is extremely detrimental to the power quality of the public grid. Based on the actual situation and operation data of distributed photovoltaic in distribution network of XC District, a city in Shandong Province, this paper conducts a practical study on the impact, causes and improvement measures of low-voltage distributed photovoltaic reactive power in active distribution network. Firstly, according to the actual operation of distribution network, the concept of transformer power flow direction change point (stage) is proposed. Then, based on the concept of transformer power flow direction change point (stage), this paper studied the impact of public transformer distributed photovoltaic access on power factor using a large number of operating data, and deeply analyzed the reasons for the reduction of power factor of public transformer connected to distributed photovoltaic through vector method, and then proposed a transformer refined reactive power compensation scheme based on intelligent fusion terminal of distribution transformer. Finally, this paper proved the correctness and scientificity of the research methods and results through an engineering reconstruction example.

articleTitle: CNN-MLP-based transformer digital twin model construction and fault diagnosis and condition evaluation analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: To address the problems of low accuracy of real-time condition assessment methods and difficult fault diagnosis identification of large oil-immersed power transformers, this paper uses a Convolutional neural network (CNN) and Multilayer perceptron network (MLP) to construct a digital twin model for transformer condition assessment and fault diagnosis. Network (MLP) fusion to build a digital twin model for transformer condition evaluation and fault diagnosis. Firstly, the digital twin model of the transformer is established based on the characteristics of the transformer’s physical structure and operating conditions. Secondly, the fusion of CNN and MLP algorithms is used to construct a fault monitoring classification model to extract the advantages of data characteristics of different fault types of state parameters so that the constructed model can entirely remove the implied statistical features of a transformer operating data. Finally, using the hierarchical analysis method, a weight matrix is constructed to derive the scores and fault classes of each group of condition data. The experimental results show that compared with other models, CNN-MLP has better generalization ability and can realize real-time monitoring and diagnosis of transformer faults with a correct overall rate of 98%.

articleTitle: Interpretation of Remote Sensing Data of Pipeline Geohazards
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: For natural gas pipelines across the area in southwest China(2470km<sup>2</sup>), the small baseline subset SAR interferometry (SBAS-InSAR) and the differential InSAR (D-InSAR) are used to acquire the deformation information of the entire area from 2016-07 to 2021-21 based on the image data of Sentinel-1A and ALOS-2 high-resolution synthetic aperture radar (SAR). The results show that InSAR technology, as an emerging technical means of monitoring pipeline geohazards, can be used to monitor wide-area surface deformation, providing significant technical support for pipeline geohazard prevention and control. SBAS-InSAR can be used in the comparison between ALOS-2 data and Sentinel-1 data for pipeline geohazard prevention. The overall quality of ALOS-2 data interferogram is better than that of Sentinel-1 data, especially in areas covered by vegetation, the former can keep a fair coherence and have a higher resolution. For the analysis of pipeline geohazards in a wide area, it is recommended to adopt the block division by the same type according to the terrain trend. In addition to that, key areas can be divided into smaller blocks. In the analysis of InSAR data, the time series for analysis can be appropriately lengthened when the SBAS-InSAR technology is used. For areas with poor coherence and small hazard points, wavelet filtration shall be adopted to prevent effective coherent points from being masked; In areas with higher coherence, filtration shall be properly strengthened to eliminate error noise. A same area shall be divided into small blocks for InSAR identification, by which the results will be more accurate than that by the whole-area identification, and the small blocks shall be preferably between 50-130 square kilometers.

articleTitle: A Dependency Links Removal Strategy to Improve Robustness of Cyber-Physical Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Cascading failures in smart grids can lead to widespread blackouts, which result in huge economic losses and catastrophic consequences. We find that the propagation of cascading failures can be expended by the topological imbalance between nodes at both ends of the dependency links cyberphysical power systems (CPPS), further weakening robustness of the system. Therefore, we propose a strategy to improve network robustness via imbalanced dependency links partial removal. First, we define an imbalance index of dependency links to assess the imbalance of nodes at both ends of an interdependent link by nodes’ importance, which integrates topology and function because the difference assessment between dependency links only from topology is incomplete. Then, we perform dependency links partial removal according to the ranking of dependency links imbalance index (DLI) in descending order. Finally, we employ IEEE39-bus case and scale-free network to model a cyber-physical power system. The numerical simulation illustrates that the proposed dependency links strategy is practical and feasible, robustness can be improved 50%-100%, the effect is even more obvious for high importance nodes. Moreover, the proposed strategy has obvious advantages over using an index in terms of a single topological metric (e.g., node betweenness) for interdependent links removal.

articleTitle: End-to-end efficient cascade license plate recognition system in unconstrained scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Automatic License Plate Recognition (ALPR) has become a necessity for today’s urban information and transportation systems. However, the variable and unconstrained environment in real-world applications makes the license plate (LP) detection and recognition task still challenging. In this work, we design a robust end-to-end trainable LP recognition system. It employs a simple cascade framework to achieve efficient and accurate LP detection and recognition tasks. The system corrects LPs in the LP detection phase, which greatly improves LP recognition accuracy in nonideal views. Adding the attention module (containing both channel attention and spatial attention) to the LP recognition network enhances the adaptability of the network and helps the accurate delineation of characters. Experimental results show an average recognition accuracy of 98.7% on the CCPD dataset and a very good 94.4% on the Challenge sub-dataset. In addition, simultaneous recognition of multiple LPs can be achieved on the invisible CRPD dataset, demonstrating the excellent generalization capability of our system.

articleTitle: Application of Cloud Theory in Evaluation of Driving Skills of Armored Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In view of the existing problems and application deficiencies of the current armored vehicle driving skills assessment methods, cloud theory was introduced into the application of armored vehicle driving skills assessment. Firstly, the index system of cloud model was established, and the index value was obtained by collecting the driving data of real vehicles. Then determine the index weight, and finally get the evaluation result. The results show that the armored vehicle driving skills evaluation method based on cloud theory can accurately evaluate the driving process of armored vehicles, and provide a technical path to solve the problem of relying on experience teaching in the driving evaluation of armored vehicles.

articleTitle: Research on Detection Algorithms of Weak Electromagnetic Spectrum Signal
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The weak electromagnetic spectrum signal drowned in the noise is difficult to be detected and identified. To solve this problem, the frequency-domain superposition algorithm and the power-entropy algorithm are proposed respectively. Considering the actual electromagnetic spectrum signals detection scenario, three types of experimental scenarios in which the DS-BPSK signal invades the frequency bands of FM, QPSK and 16QAM signals are simulated. By comparing the advantages and disadvantages of two different algorithms, it is proved that the power-entropy algorithm is much more effective. Even there exists the strong electromagnetic spectrum signal, the weak electromagnetic spectrum signal can be easily distinguished and not be ignored.

articleTitle: Unscented Kalman Filter and Its Implementation in Digital Image Correlation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the development of industrial technology and the improvement of automation level of industrial production, automatic recognition and prediction has gradually become another key issue in automated production. The main purpose of this paper is to elucidate the many advantages of the unscented Kalman filter (UKF) method and to demonstrate its full applicability to many identification and prediction processes in order to explore more possibilities for prediction and state estimation. This study focuses on the new application of unscented Kalman filter in recognition and prediction, explains and discusses its principles and functions, and explains its advantages and functions with an example of digital image correlation method. In the fourth part, an example of the application of unscented Kalman filter in digital image correlation is given, and its specific principle and advantages are explained. The function of unscented Kalman filter in digital image correlation is demonstrated to speed up the operation and avoid errors. Finally, it is concluded that the UKF can be well suited for various prediction and state estimation tasks.

articleTitle: Image Style Transfer–A Critical Review
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Style Transfer refers to the conversion of images into two different domains. Specifically, it provides a style image, converts any image into this style, and preserves the content of the original image as much as possible. Image style transfer is now often employed in image processing applications. It offers a number of evaluation techniques for contrasting numerous prevalent and significant applications of image style transfer algorithms on various level. The examination of numerous Neural Style Transfer applications and unresolved issues for further study comes to a close in this paper.

articleTitle: Optimization of LEACH Routing Protocol Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the advantages of convenient communication and low cost, wireless sensor network (WSN) is widely used in many areas for information collection, and LEACH protocol is one of the routing protocol used in WSN. Therefore, optimizing LEACH protocol can improve the performance of WSN, including the speed, lifecycle and coverage. The optimization of LEACH protocol mainly focuses on improving network energy efficiency, reducing node energy consumption, improving ways to select cluster head nodes, and extending network lifetime. On the basis of extending the network lifetime, this paper optimized the energy allocation and choosing cluster heads. With our method, the new energy threshold is established, and the nodes whose energy is lower than the threshold is not eligible to compete for cluster heads. The amount of cluster heads that can minimize the total energy consumption of the network is found, as well as the optimal P- value is confirmed. The threshold formula for selecting cluster heads is optimized. The final results of simulation show the optimized node death time is significantly later than that before optimization, which can prolong the network lifecycle of LEACH protocol.

articleTitle: An Improved Object Detection Method Based on NAO Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: As a popular humanoid robot in recent years, NAO robot has been loved by the majority of researchers because of its rich functions and compact characteristics. When NAO robot is applied to face recognition, tracking, grasping and other scenes, whether it can effectively detect and recognize the object will directly determine the deployment of subsequent tasks. At present, the object detection algorithm used by NAO robot is relatively simple, which is greatly affected by the environment and light. At the same time, the categories that can be detected are relatively single. In order to solve the above problems, this paper introduced the current mainstream one-stage detector (YOLOv5) into the object detection system of NAO robot, and designd a set of object detection algorithm deployment process for the deployment environment of NAO robot, which effectively improved the object detection capability of NAO robot.

articleTitle: End-to-End Multi-View Structure-from-Motion with Hypercorrelation Volume
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Image-based 3D reconstruction is one of the most important tasks in Computer Vision with many solutions proposed over the last few decades. The objective is to extract metric information i.e. the geometry of scene objects directly from images. These can then be used in a wide range of applications such as film, games, virtual reality, etc. Recently, deep learning techniques have been proposed to tackle this problem. They rely on training on vast amounts of data to learn to associate features between images through deep convolutional neural networks and have been shown to outperform traditional procedural techniques. In this paper, we improve on the state-of-the-art two-view structure-from-motion(SfM) approach of [11] by incorporating 4D correlation volume for more accurate feature matching and reconstruction. Furthermore, we extend it to the general multi- view case and evaluate it on the complex benchmark dataset DTU [5]. Quantitative evaluations and comparisons with state-of-the-art multi-view 3D reconstruction methods demonstrate its superiority in terms of the accuracy of reconstructions.

articleTitle: Research on the Control Strategy of Microgrid Inverter Based on Adaptive Virtual Synchronous Generator System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Considering the high penetration impact on the grid system brought by the grid-connected distributed energy, there is the fact that the conventional grid-connected inverters do not have the advantage of rotational inertia, which can increase the operational risk of the system. Combined with the wind farm multi-terminal DC transmission system, an adaptive virtual synchronous generator control strategy based on the adaptive virtual governor function is proposed. Combined with the virtual synchronous governor module, a virtual synchronous generator (VSG) control strategy with inertial response and primary frequency regulation capability is established. However, considering the fluctuating and intermittent characteristics of distributed power supply, the power supply and demand imbalance will lead to the load state of the energy storage equipment exceeding the safe operation range during the long-term operation. Based on aforementioned questions, the method of adjusting the sag coefficient according to the charge state is extended to the VSG-based control. By introducing the concept of adaptive sag characteristics, the VSG control is further improved by using the method of shifting sag characteristics. The improved VSG control method reduces the impact on the system stability and represents more conducive to the rational distribution of active power and the rapid adjustment of the charge state. The simulation results validate the rationality of the proposed control strategy by using the Matlab/Simulink tool.
