articleTitle: Construction of Image Recognition Model Based on Second-Order Local Feature Aggregation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper analyzes the mathematical model constructed by the Net VLAD method, and proposes a second-order function based on the Net VLAD method to solve the problem that the obtained image feature encoding is a first-order function of the local information of the image. Image feature encoding learning dictionary. Use the Net VLAD classifier as the fully connected layer of the CNN model, design the reconstruction residual weight, and redesign the image feature extraction module for the control of the reconstruction residual value range; when the image feature encoding in the Net VLAD learning dictionary is described by a first-order vector, there is a problem that it is difficult to derive and calculate the minimum value of image features. In the image dimensionality reduction transformation kernel, the first-order linear function is promoted to a second-order nonlinear function, and the image dimensionality reduction transformation kernel is used as a breakthrough, and the second-order nonlinear transformation kernel is used. The activation function has the characteristic of being derivable, and the local features of the image samples are subjected to dimensionality reduction processing to achieve more accurate dimensionality reduction calculations for image features. In the experiment, the accuracy of image feature classification, the recognition rate of image samples, and the training and testing efficiency of image samples are used as verification data. By using the CNN deep convolutional neural network model, the Net VLAD learning dictionary and the improved learning dictionary proposed in this paper, the Multiple image sample sets are compared for training and testing, which verifies that the improved learning dictionary based on Net VLAD proposed in this paper has obvious advantages.

Author Keywords: Net Vector of Locally Aggregated Descriptors

articleTitle: PV panel fault detection based on improved ResNet
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: At a time when photovoltaic power generation is becoming more and more mature, the maintenance of photovoltaic modules has also become a major problem. In order to avoid the environmental impact of photovoltaic hot spot damage photovoltaic panels, this leads to a decrease in power generation efficiency, as well as the current detection means small hot spots are often be missed, combined with the need for speed and accuracy in the UAV inspection and cleaning, for the traditional two-level detection method, a ResNet residual network-based full convolutional network model, and further use grayscale, filtering and edge gradient fitting and other measure to enhance the model evaluation conditions, achieving accurate hot spot location on PV panels.The experimental results show that the improved full convolutional network model is very useful for small photovoltaic panels. The experimental results show that the improved full convolutional network model is also effective in detecting small photovoltaic hot spots.The application of this model not only satisfies the requirements of PV inspection for real time, but also has a lower cost, stronger portability, can be applied to most scenarios and greatly reduces the requirements on the environment and the working state of PV modules.

articleTitle: Semantic segmentation of vehicle vision based on two-branch Enet network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Semantic segmentation has important research significance in environment perception in unmanned field. By improving the Enet model, adding spatial branches, turning the original model into a two-branch structure, cropping the original structure as semantic branches, and using the attention mechanism to fuse the spatial and semantic branch feature maps to retain the image spatial information and improve the grid effect. The improved algorithm is tested on dataset Cityscapes and dataset BDD100K, and the average cross-merge ratio is improved by 2.75% and 2.41%, respectively. The implementation of the two-branch Enet network makes it easier to obtain information on the drivable area of the vehicle, obstacles ahead, etc.

articleTitle: Automatic Spraying of Insulator Persistent Room Temperature Vulcanized Coating Based on Digital Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Pollution flashover prevention has always been the focus of external insulation design and renovation. Reducing pollution flashover accidents is of great significance to reducing power grid failures. Persistent Room Temperature Vulcanized (PRTV) coating is a permanent anti-pollution flashover composite material for external insulation, which is an important material to prevent insulators from pollution flashover at present. In this paper, the method of digital image processing for insulator PRTV coating is adopted for coating spraying. Firstly, the technical characteristics of PRTV coating are studied, and the quality problems of common coatings are analyzed. Then the sprayed PRTV coating is processed by image processing. Finally, the defects are detected through image recognition to achieve effective spraying of PRTV.

articleTitle: Intelligent Monitoring and Analysis System for Boiler Combustion Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper introduces an intelligent monitoring and analysis system based on boiler big data combustion. The system solves the problem of uneven combustion of boilers by real-time monitoring and analysis of tangential deviation, air-coal ratio, dynamic characteristics of coal mills, air leakage of various parts, etc., which greatly promotes the intelligent, economical and safe combustion adjustment of power plant boilers. The application of the system in many power plants in Jilin Province has played an important role in saving operating costs, improving economic efficiency, guiding the operators to adjust combustion and monitoring the boiler state.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction and Application of Power Grid Information Model Based on Information Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, a hierarchical multi-source information fusion method for power grid fault information diagnosis is proposed. Firstly, this paper carries out feature fusion and decision fusion for wavelet packet transform features and power spectrum features of power grid fault information. At the same time, an unsupervised feature reduction method based on entropy measure is used to reduce the power spectrum features. The system realizes the rapid diagnosis of single fault based on the switching quantity of SCADA system. At the same time, the switching quantity information is integrated with the electrical volume information of fault recorder and WAMS. The simulation results show that this method can get accurate fault diagnosis results by fusing the information of electric volume and switching quantity. This method has a good application prospect in power grid fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: A study on acoustic emission signal processing of wood damage and fracture based on VMD and sample entropy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The analysis of acoustic emission signals from wood materials can be used to evaluate the damaged state of wood, but the acoustic emission is easily affected by various disturbances. In order to evaluate the damage state of wood more accurately and suppress the interference of acoustic emission signal and reduce the noise content, the following processing methods were applied to the signal in this study. Firstly, Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) method was used to decompose the acoustic emission signals generated from wood. A particle swarm algorithm is used to optimize the parameters of the method. Then the effective components obtained from the decomposition are selected by calculating the sample entropy values of each component. Finally, the signal phases are characterized by using alignment entropy. The results show that the various stages of wood can be effectively separated by the research method in this paper.

articleTitle: Design and Strategy Research of Primary Frequency Modulation Monitoring and Assessment System for Thermal Power Unit
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Power plant enterprises lack intuitive monitoring means for primary frequency modulation (PFM) process, and in complex power environment, there may be information delay or inconsistency between the monitoring and assessment of dispatching center and the actual frequency modulation (FM) of power plants, which will seriously affect the accuracy of unit FM and the economic benefits of power plants. In view of the above problems, a monitoring and assessment system for PFM of thermal power units is designed. The system is built in the power plant to dynamically monitor the running status of grid connected units and conduct real-time assessment calculation of PFM, ensuring the stability of the unit operation and fairness of dispatching assessment.

articleTitle: Dynamic analysis of the fifth order Chua circuit memristor system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: According to the basic idea of Chua circuit, more variables are introduced to construct a fifth order memristor system, which is composed of inductor, capacitor, memristor and other components. In order to better study the dynamics characteristics of the fifth-order Chua circuit memristor system, multi-dimensional analysis methods such as bifurcation diagram, Lyapunov exponent, phase diagram and Poincare cross section diagram will be used. Finally, Simulink simulation will be used to verify its effectiveness. This circuit will be paid attention to in many fields such as chaotic dynamics and chaotic secure communication.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a personal loan default prediction platform based on LightGBM model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The LightGBM algorithm is used to provide new research ideas for the analysis of customer data information in the practical application of personal loan default models, in view of the fact that financial institutions are not able to reasonably assess the default risk in each lending. By comparing the accuracy, precision, recall and ROC curves, we found that the personal loan default model constructed by the LightGBM algorithm has better prediction results than the personal loan default prediction model constructed by the Random Forest algorithm, with the prediction accuracy reaching Then, based on the personal loan default model constructed by the LightGBM algorithm, a personal loan default system platform was built using the python language and the Flask framework, which was able to achieve real-time input of customer information data to predict the probability of whether the customer would default or not.

articleTitle: Research on Signal Enhancement Method of Magnetic Flux Leakage Testing Simulation for Strain Clamp
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Magnetic flux leakage testing is a new method in the field of testing the crimping quality of the strain clamp, but it has some disadvantages, such as weak signals and unclear characteristics. In this paper, the magnetic flux leakage signal and characteristic quantity are increased by adding magnetic flux gather structure, and three magnetic flux gather structures with different shapes are designed. A comparative study of different sizes is made by means of simulation. In this paper, a corresponding relationship between the magnetic flux leakage signal and the steel anchor structure of the strain clamp is proposed, which has certain guiding significance for the magnetic flux leakage signal to calculate the stress zone of the strain clamp.

articleTitle: Research on AC/DC Hybrid Distribution Network System Based on Distributed Energy Access Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper proposes a technical scheme for a new type of AC and DC energy storage system. The solution supports diversified development and provides flexible and diverse distributed energy orderly access services. An improved on-grid/off-grid droop single-mode switching control strategy is proposed based on the grid-connected distributed energy. The switching process is controlled by an improved nonlinear droop curve. This paper realizes the flexible access of distributed energy and electric vehicles based on the new physical structure of AC and DC distribution network of energy storage modules. The system can meet the needs of AC and DC users such as data centers and provide stable, high-quality and highly reliable energy supply. A smooth and seamless switch between on/off grid is achieved. The experimental simulation results verify the feasibility of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Design of edge computing gateway for textile machine remote monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper presents a design and implementation of edge computing gateway for textile equipment remote monitoring system. First, the overall architecture of the monitoring system from the edge computing gateway to the cloud platform is given. Then, taking the cotton spinning drawing frame as an example, the implementation of edge microservices and cloud platform functions is introduced in detail, and the specific implementation and operation results are given.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Smart Curtains
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Aiming at the demand of modern people for smart home and low-carbon life, and in response to the national call for carbon neutrality and energy conservation, we have designed a smart curtain system based on IoT (Internet of Things), voice technology, AI (Artificial Intelligence) and solar energy by analyzing the current situation and prospects of the smart curtain market. The designed function is tested and verified by the built object. The test results show that compared with the traditional mode, the system of smart curtain can be controlled in two ways, and the work is reliable, has high precision and meets the modern humanized design. In addition, the system can not only supply power for curtains, but also for other furniture, combining green resources and intelligence. The project has achieved the anticipation.

articleTitle: Design of Dual-link Shared GRE over IPSec VPN on P2MP Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Communications between the enterprise head office and multiple branches are usually carried on public networks, or open and insecure communication environments such as satellite channels, which can rely on IPSec VPN to achieve secure communication and constitute an IPSec P2MP network. Most of the time, in order to improve the reliability of the communication, the head office communicates with each branch using double links. In this paper, we propose an innovative design of dual-link shared GRE over IPSec VPN on P2MP network to provide a secure channel for unicast and multicast data transmission for both two-direction and one-direction communication between the head office and branch offices.

articleTitle: Construction of CNN model based on hard-assigned coding of image features
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper proposes a CNN model based on hard-assigned coding processing of image features. By clearly describing the relationship between the input image sample features participating in the learning dictionary training and the atomic description features in the learning dictionary in the HC hard-assigned image feature encoding transformation, two sets of parameters are designed to calculate the input image sample features and the atomic description features in the learning dictionary. The minimum distance between them, and the HC hard-assigned image feature coding transformation is improved; the HC hard-assigned coding transformation algorithm is introduced into the last convolutional layer and pooling layer in the CNN model, and a complete CNN deep neural network is designed. Improve the model. The advantages of the model constructed in this paper are verified by experimental comparison with a variety of image feature encoding transformation algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Automatization Technology of Human Large Data Communication in Automobile Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Industrial robot automatic production line has become the mainstream and development direction of automation equipment. This paper describes the modern communication method of PROFINETI0 industrial Ethernet. At the same time, this paper designs a monitoring system of automobile manufacturing robot based on Zigbee wireless network communication technology. The system is designed to solve the problem that the monitoring process is unstable and the monitoring result is inaccurate due to the influence of unstable network and incomplete information transmission when the monitoring system of automobile manufacturing robot collects environmental information. The experimental results show that the delay vibration frequency of the robot monitoring system based on Zigbee wireless network communication technology is low. It shows that the robot monitoring system based on Zigbee wireless network communication technology has higher network communication stability. The system can better ensure the accuracy of monitoring results.

articleTitle: Modeling of Coherent Evolution of Ocean Turbulence Based on Time-dependent Intrinsic Correlation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Turbulence is an irregular chaotic fluid state, whose generation and evolution are mainly carried out through the multi-scale coherent structures contained in the ocean water. In order to further understand the evolution mechanism of spatio-temporal coupled turbulence energy, a NA-MEMD-TDIC based turbulence evolution modeling method was proposed by using the shear fluctuation of nonlinear Marine microstructure measured by matrix turbulence profilers. The coherent structure of turbulent space-time synchronization is modeled. Firstly, noise-assisted multivariate empirical mode decomposition was used to adaptively decompose ocean turbulent shear signal multi-scale vortexes, and then energy contribution was used to identify main-scale vortexes. Finally, the time-dependent intrinsic correlation model of spatial multipoints was established. The results show that turbulence evolves irregularly in space-time, and the established model can effectively excavate the spatiotemporal evolution structure of turbulence.

articleTitle: WTLA: Time Series Prediction Based on Wind Turbine Oil Temperature
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The rapid development of wind turbines has led to concern about monitoring the operating status of wind turbines to ensure their regular operation. Gearbox oil inlet temperature data is related to the regular operation of wind turbines. In order to predict the gearbox inlet oil temperature on real data sets, we propose a time series forecasting model-WTLA based on Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) combined with Attention mechanism. The data preprocessing is done by smoothing the real data set with a combination of interpolation methods, reducing the dimensionality of the data set with principal component analysis, and removing the noise with Denoising Autoencoder. The model design is based on Encoder-Decoder with LSTM combined with attention mechanism. Finally, our model significantly improves the forecasting performance compared with the baselines.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis method for substation grounding network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, a fault diagnosis method of grounding network is studied, which includes: collecting magnetic field data of multiple conductors of grounding network according to the excitation current and acquisition parameters in the grounding network; Each magnetic field data is identified for the grounding grid conductor; The collected magnetic field data is processed; Send the processed magnetic field data to the substation server through wireless communication; Substation server according to the grounding network conductor identification, confirm the processing of the grounding network first conductor magnetic field data is less than the first preset threshold, diagnose the grounding network first conductor fault. This application has accurate fault location, high detection efficiency, and can realize online real-time detection.

articleTitle: A Measurement System of Transient Overvoltage of Secondary Equipment Port During Digital Substation Switch Operation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to ensure the reliable operation of the secondary equipment and formulate the corresponding EMC evaluation standards and protective measures, it is necessary to measure and master the characteristics of the electromagnetic disturbance voltage applied to the secondary equipment port, and design the electromagnetic shielding measurement system of the secondary equipment port that meets the specific requirements. In this paper, a high-voltage probe based on the principle of resistance-capacitance voltage division and a data acquisition device with a high-speed digitizer as the core are used to develop a measurement system that meets the above requirements. The system uses high-speed digitizer instead of oscilloscope and optical fiber to control long-distance communication. The system is small in size, light in weight, strong in anti-electromagnetic interference ability, portable and low in cost. Through the verification experiments of DC high voltage, square wave and lightning wave, it is proved that it has high measurement reliability for transient voltage with single peak of 30kV and rising edge of not less than 5ns.

articleTitle: Research on cold chain logistics distribution path optimization based on improved ant colony algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In real life, how to quickly and accurately plan the optimal path for cold chain logistics distribution in the complex traffic environment is one of the key issues in the cold chain logistics distribution vehicle operation system. Based on the classic ant colony algorithm, combined with the particularity of cold chain logistics distribution, considering the factors such as transportation cost, maximum vehicle load, distribution distance and traffic capacity of each road section, an optimal model of cold chain logistics distribution path planning based on the improved ant colony algorithm is established. On the basis of the classical ant colony algorithm, a cold chain logistics distribution path planning optimization model based on the improved ant colony algorithm is established. The model takes into account the special characteristics of cold chain logistics distribution in terms of transportation cost, maximum vehicle weight, distribution distance and access road capacity. In this paper, numerical simulation is performed with the help of MATLAB software to test the scientificity and rationality of the algorithm. The conclusion shows that the improved ant colony algorithm can get the distribution path suitable for the attributes of cold chain logistics and reduce the total transportation costs. The problem of selecting the optimal path of cold chain logistics distribution vehicles can be reasonably solved. This is conducive to improving the distribution efficiency of cold chain logistics and has strong practicality.

articleTitle: A BP Neural Network-based Approach to Intelligent Computer Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The computer image recognition model based on BP neural network can effectively identify the convergence recognition error. To solve the problems of low convergence speed and inability to quickly reduce recognition errors in the practical application of traditional image recognition methods, an optimized model for computer image recognition based on GA & BP deep neural network algorithm is proposed through computer image data acquisition and processing, image recognition model construction based on BP neural network and computer image recognition model training.

articleTitle: Specific Emitter Identification Based on CNN via Variational Mode Decomposition and Bimodal Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Specific emitter identification (SEI) refers to the technology of identifying specific emitter individuals by the RF fingerprint carried by the emitter transmitting signals. RF fingerprint is a hardware difference feature caused by the nonlinearity and tolerance of the components inside the emitter, and can be used as the unique identification of the emitter. In this paper, we propose an emitter identification scheme based on convolutional neural network (CNN) via variational mode decomposition (VMD) and bimodal feature fusion. Firstly, four stray components of LoRa signals are extracted by VMD, which contain unintentional modulation features of the original signals. Then the time-frequency features (VMD-S) and temporal features (VMD-T) are extracted from the four stray components. Consequently, a CNN-based two-channel feature extraction network is built with an attention module and a bimodal feature fusion strategy which realizes the fusion of VMD-S and VMD-T. The experimental results show that the proposed SEI scheme achieves higher identification accuracy in comparison with the scheme without feature fusion at the low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) region.

articleTitle: Research on Method of Eliminating Spectral Background Signal of Water Quality Monitoring Based on Dynamic Reference
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In view of the dynamic effects on spectrum measurement’s background signal of water quality monitoring caused by the absorption of turbidity, chroma and a variety of unknown materials, according to Beer-Lambert Law. the relationship between solvent and solute has been analyzed; and combining with the on-line water quality monitoring principle based on spectral analysis, the concept of "dynamic reference" has been put forward. Meanwhile, a method based on the "dynamic reference" to eliminate the background interference of spectrum measurement signal has been proposed too, Applying the above signal processing method to the self-developed water quality monitoring instrument. the field contrast experiment with the national standard analysis methods for on-line measuring the hexavalent chromium in the same actual environmental water sample has been carried out; and the accuracy of measuring results by "dynamic reference" are better than that by "static reference". Moreover, the accuracy also meets the superior to the national environmental protection standard (the relative error of contrast experiment to actual water sample A≤10%). The experiment results show that the proposed signal processing method can dynamically eliminate the background spectrum influence caused by water matrix interference, so as to ensure the accuracy of spectral measurement signals and improve the accuracy of on-line water quality monitoring instrument.

articleTitle: Fault current suppression method of MMC-HVDC DC side based on edge devices
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Based on the analysis of various factors affecting the DC fault current, this paper proposes a current-limiting control strategy suitable for HB-MMC DC power grid, which utilizes the high controllability of the flexible DC power grid and presets the limit through the outer loop control command. The two links of the current and the adaptive current limiting based on the DC voltage change realize the current limiting of the DC side fault. The simulation results show that the current-limiting control strategy proposed in this paper can reduce the voltage fluctuation after the fault is removed, and can also ensure better current-limiting effect of DC current, AC current and bridge arm current. This research can be applied to a large number of edge computing devices to avoid equipment damage caused by abnormal current.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Face Recognition Algorithm for Internet of Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In recent years, face detection and recognition technology has been widely used in many important scenarios, especially for automatic driving scenarios and future Internet of vehicles. Practical challenges such as computing resource limitation and real-time processing of edge nodes need to be fully considered. In order to cope with the problem of severe computing resources limitation on the edge of the Internet of Vehicles, this paper optimized the lightweight network model Lightened CNN for face depth feature extraction. By the batch normalization mechanism, the vector distribution of facial features of different identities is dispersed. The relative feature center distance is increased. It gives the extracted features a better classification aggregation feature. According to the design flow of face recognition algorithm, the method of face alignment and similarity measurement is studied. It is designed to complete the face recognition scheme adapted to the Internet of Vehicles scene. After experiment and analysis, the face depth feature extraction network designed in this paper occupies less embedded system resources. At the same time, the face recognition algorithm designed by combining lightweight face feature extraction network, and face alignment and similarity measurement has higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Multiuser Cyclic Shift-Aided RA Code for Gaussian Multiple Access Channel
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: A multiuser cyclic shift-aided RA code is proposed for a Gaussian multiple access channel (MAC). In this scheme, every user utilizes a serial concatenated, which is constituted of regular RA code and spreading, followed by the identical chip-level interleaver and a user-specific cyclic shifter. The advantage is that our proposed code save bandwidth resources, and reduce storage space and high latency at the transmitters and receiver, since the identical interleaver serially concatenated the different cyclic shifters avoid complex interleaving operations and replace the random interleavers of IDMA scheme. A factor graph is utilized at the receiver for iterative multiuser decoding. Numerical results show that, our proposed multiuser cyclic shift-aided RA coding scheme supports to distinguish user and performs well in the error rate performance. Moreover, the performance of our proposed code exceeding that of the conventional IDMA scheme.

articleTitle: M-element spread spectrum multi-user detection algorithm based on interference cancellation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Multiple Access interference (MAI) is one of the main factors affecting the performance of M-element spread spectrum multi-user communication systems. To solve this problem, this paper proposes to use the interference cancellation multi-user detection technology at the receiving end, to reconstruct the signal decision after M element de-amplification, to get the MAI estimated signal of each user, received signal minus MAI estimated signal, so that each user can get more reliable data information, sent to the next level for M element de-amplification decision. Monte-Carlo simulation is carried out in Gaussian channel with m sequence and Gold sequence as spread spectrum codes, respectively. Comparing the simulation results, it can be seen that the algorithm can quickly suppress or even eliminate the influence of MAI on the performance of M element spread spectrum multi-user system, and improve the system capacity.

articleTitle: A Frequency Control Strategy of Large Grid with Energy Storage Based on Multi-Agent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Under the "dual carbon" strategic goal, the development of the dual-high power system is accelerating, and the power grid regulation capacity is constantly declining, and more flexible control resources are urgently needed. Electrochemical energy storage can be used as a good control resource and can adapt to different time dimensions. Its widespread use and coordinated, optimal operation with "source, network, load" and other regulating resources can significantly increase the system's capacity for stable operation. Therefore, a multi-agent algorithm-based frequency control technique for large power grids with energy storage is suggested in this study. Firstly, a frequency control architecture for a large power grid that includes thermal power, renewable energy, and large-scale energy storage power stations is created based on the frequency control model of large-scale energy storage units that takes the randomness of consumers into account. Second, a grid frequency controller structure with energy storage participation is suggested based on the MA-DDPG algorithm, and the state space, action space, and reward function of the agent are constructed in accordance with the actual control requirements of the power grid. Finally, the simulation results demonstrate the high efficiency of the multi-agent coordinated control technology, which is well suited to the erratic properties of energy storage clusters and new energy units. This technology also significantly enhances the stability and robustness of system frequency control.

articleTitle: Lightweight skeletal key point extraction algorithm based on TransPose network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: TransPose achieves excellent results in human pose estimation tasks, but it has disadvantages such as a lot of network parameters, high computational complexity of the model, and slow convergence speed. The TransPose model is improved to address the above problems. First, we use the Ghost module to change the ordinary convolutional structure in the convolutional backbone network HRNet to decrease the quantity of model parameters and calculation complexity; second, we use the multi-head mechanism of attention to increase the encoder learnable information and improve the model accuracy; third, we introduce the normalization structure of the front layer to accelerate the model convergence. It is proved by experimental results that the amount of computation of the improved TransPose model on COCO dataset is reduced from 21.8G to 15G, the number of parameters is reduced from 17.5M to 4.85M, and the model converges faster while maintaining a high accuracy rate.

articleTitle: Data Processing Optimization of Power Grid Dispatching Control Cloud Based on Edge-Cloud Collaborative Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Cloud computing technology is widely used in power grid systems. In response to the data with strict delay requirements and a large amount of data generated by the operation of the power grid system. New challenges are raised to the delay of business processing. In order to achieve the goal of minimizing the system average latency time of task processing, based on the power grid dispatching cloud architecture, a delay optimization method based on SDN edge-cloud collaborative computing is proposed. The goal is to minimize the system average delay of task processing. Introduce continuously variable edge and cloud and task distribution coefficients. The delay optimization problem is transformed into the task allocation coefficient optimization problem. And finally get the task allocation optimization strategy based on the model calculation. The experimental results show that when the edge node tasks are reasonably loaded into the cloud center for processing, the system delay of the business can be effectively reduced. Compared with the previous methods, the edge-cloud collaborative computing method proposed in this paper reduces the system delay and utilizes the control mechanism of SDN that can coordinate cloud computing and edge computing. The algorithm can be used in the power system cloud platform system based on SDN.

articleTitle: Research on the platform of metrological inspection calibration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Although the existing metrology institutions have put forward many new methods and ideas that are worth learning, the systems developed by each metrology institution are mainly based on their own needs. In addition, the system has poor applicability and single function in measuring and testing data processing, it cannot dynamically calculate the complicated formulas in the measuring and testing work. In this paper, through the research on the calculation problem of the measurement data formula, the measurement formula is analyzed, the calculation unit library belonging to the measurement and detection work is established, and the rule relationship of each unit is also described, at last the complicated formulas in the measurement and inspection work are dynamically calculated. This paper proposes a framework design of a metrological inspection calibration service platform studies the content of the service platform's hierarchical function division, obtains a complete metrological inspection calibration process and specification.

articleTitle: Timely Rendering Algorithm of Virtualization System Based on CUDA for Smart Scenarios of Power Grid Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In recent years, with the rise of the Internet, Internet resources are gradually becoming the same infrastructure as water and electricity, and virtualization technology plays an important role in it. CUDA technology can be used for the realization of virtualized systems in smart grid infrastructure scenarios, and can achieve a performance acceleration effect of more than ten times. The purpose of this paper is to render the virtualized system of the smart scene of power grid infrastructure based on CUDA in time, and use the rendering algorithm to compare the rendering equation, through the measurement methods of four cases, and compare the results obtained by the experiment. Experiments show that the proposed optimization algorithm for large-scale and complex grid infrastructure smart scene rendering can greatly improve the rendering efficiency of large-scale and complex grid infrastructure smart scenes.

articleTitle: Algorithm Research and Application of MCNP Coupling Point Kernel Integration on γ Biological Shielding Design
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: MCNP based on Monte Carlo method and RSC based on point kernel integration method, being used separately on γ biological shielding design causes problems in calculation time or accuracy. To improve efficiency of γ biological shielding design, biological shielding simulation calculation software is developed to couple the two methods, make up for the defect of separate calculation of two program. Through calculation, the results of RSC and MCNP are similar, which proves the feasibility of coupling the two programs, and verifies improvement of γ biological shielding design efficiency of the biological shielding simulation calculation software.

articleTitle: A new improved clustering method of incomplete data based on K-nearest neighbors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Clustering algorithm has been widely studied and applied in machine learning. Most of the clustering algorithms are only suitable for complete data sets; however, real-world data sets may have missing values for a variety of reasons. To solve this problem, this article propose a fuzzy C-means (FCM) clustering algorithm based on K-nearest neighbors(KNN) imputation. Unlike the two-stage strategy that executes imputation and clustering separately, this article take missing values as the optimization variable of the objective function to make imputation and clustering negotiate with each other to achieve the optimal. The proposed algorithm has a good effect on clustering for incomplete data. The experimental results on UCI data sets can verify that the proposed approach is obviously superior to several other approaches.

articleTitle: Research on Network Information Security Perception Technology Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The network is easily interfered by various attacks, and these attacks are extremely rich, so the risk factors faced by network security are diversified. Network security perception is generally divided into three stages: situation element extraction, situation understanding and situation prediction. In order to better protect the sense of use and information security of individuals and countries, this paper studies the perception system based on the perception element extraction system of SDN honeynet from the perspective of big data. It is hoped that it can make a greater contribution to the development of network security and give full play to the practical application of this system.

articleTitle: Research on Biometric Identification Recognition Method of Radial Artery Combined with Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The radial artery of human body contains the physiological information of human body, which is nonstationary and non-periodic. In order to extract the characteristics of radial artery and improve the efficiency of human signs recognition. In this paper, a method based on CNN-EMD as radial artery feature vector was proposed to recognize human signs by support vector machine (SVM). Firstly, the original signal is decomposed by empirical mode to obtain the intrinsic mode function (IMF), and the information entropy of IMF is calculated. Secondly, convolutional neural network (CNN) is applied to the original signal to extract morphological features, and the result and information entropy constitute the feature vector. Finally, the support vector machine algorithm is used to classify the extracted features. A total of 219 radial artery samples from Creative Commons platform were used to identify normal and abnormal human features with an accuracy of 78.57%. The study shows that the proposed method improves by 8.57% compared with the commonly used method of EMD combined with SVM, which shows that the method can effectively identify human body features.

articleTitle: Detecting System of High Voltage Voltage Transformer Based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: High-voltage(HV) voltage transformers(VT) are widely used in the power industry, and their accuracy is directly related to the interests of power users and power grid-related enterprises. Therefore, it is of great significance for transformer verification. However, nowadays it mainly relies on manual verification, which is inefficient, and the verification work in a high-pressure environment will threaten the safety of the verification personnel. In this regard, the HV voltage transformer detection system developed in this paper based on digital signal processor (DSP) reduces manual intervention, not only improves the accuracy and reliability of verification results, but also improves the safety level of verification operations. In the application analysis experiment of the detection system, the phase test experiment of the voltage signal proves that the phase output accuracy of the verification system designed in this paper meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: Large-scale energy storage battery technology participates in the application of AGC frequency modulation in thermal power plants
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the increasingly strict AGC assessment, energy storage system to participate in AGC frequency modulation technology to meet the development opportunities. This paper introduces the application status, basic principle and application effect of the largest side energy storage system in China, analyzes the comprehensive frequency modulation performance index and economic benefits before and after the energy storage system is put in, and the inspiration of energy storage system combined with thermal power plant frequency modulation to the power grid.

articleTitle: ISAR Image Registration Based on Normalized Correlation Coefficient
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: As an important part of attitude estimation for space target, the accuracy of ISAR image registration directly affects the result of attitude estimation. In this paper, we analyze the model of ISAR image registration and propose a novel method. First, the image is binarized to reduce the impact of echo SNR, and then the global normalized cross-correlation coefficient between the images is taken as the cost function to estimate the parameters with Snake Optimizer algorithm to achieve registration. The experiment proves the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Automation Information System Based on Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper describes how to obtain user and behavior information by obtaining user location information and characteristic data on ARM architecture. At the same time, this paper will model and analyze the information with the corresponding data for recommendation and interactive use. The system can obtain more detailed information flow through ARM architecture. The system expands the instruction set of the ARM architecture by adding blemishes to page entries to identify data from untrusted data sources. The information flow tracks the transmission process of data at the instruction level and completes the stain transmission accordingly. Because it does not depend on the server, it can track and feed back to the user directly on user attributes. The contents of the program running memory and register dynamically detect and record the information flow of the program so as to realize the location and prevention of malicious attacks.

articleTitle: Flux-weakening Control of PMSM Based on Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this study, an effective flux-weakening control for permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) is proposed, which combines model predictive control (MPC) with vector control. On the one hand, in order to achieve full-speed domain control, the optimal working point of the motor running is tracked and the reference current is calculated according to the feedback information in the speed control loop. On the other hand, MPC replaces the three PI controllers of the speed loop and the current loop in the traditional vector control, which not only does not need to set the PI parameters, but also improves the rapidness and accuracy of the speed control system. The results show that, compared with traditional vector control, the proposed control method has a great dynamic response and disturbance rejection performance in the full-speed domain.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence of Single Line Configuration of Auxiliary Engine on Coal Power Unit
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The single row configuration of auxiliary equipment of coal power generation units is widely used in Europe, especially in Germany, and domestic power plants have started to try in recent 10 years. The unscheduled outage probability of single row units is higher than that of double row units, but lower than that of double row units. The single row configuration is superior to the dual row configuration in terms of equipment cost, operation and maintenance cost. The existing design standards recommend dual row configuration, but do not exclude single row configuration.

articleTitle: Control Strategy Analysis of Brushless DC Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Sensorless technology and torque ripple suppression are always the hot and difficult points in the research of brushless DC motor control strategy. This paper deeply analyzes the structure and working principle of brushless DC motor, and theoretically analyzes PID control algorithm, predictive control algorithm and sliding film control algorithm. It verifies the control strategy of brushless DC motor through practical cases, and looks forward to the application prospect and development trend of brushless DC motor in the industrial process.

articleTitle: A Printing Defect Recognition Method Based on Class-imbalanced Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Printing product is very common in people's daily life, such as newspapers, books, advertisements, product packaging and even banknotes. Because of various printing defects occurring in printing process, the quality of printing product is directly affected. During the high-speed printing, it is necessary to detect various printing defects quickly and accurately for eliminating defective printing products from qualified ones. The printing defect recognition method based on machine vision is replacing manual defect recognition in printing industry because of its automation, high efficiency and recognition accuracy. We use deep learning method to detect printing defects. The number of printing defects in different categories is often uneven. The quantity of normal samples and dirty points is significantly larger than other defect types. In this paper, a printing defect recognition method based on class-imbalanced learning is proposed. In addition, a warp-based bundled homography model is also proposed to improve the registration accuracy, which is beneficial to improve the efficiency of defect recognition. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method can detect printing defects quickly and effectively.

articleTitle: Research on architectural CAD-aided design based on computer 3D reconstruction technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The traditional building 3D modeling method is time-consuming and labor-intensive, and the accuracy is low. This paper adopts a new type of computer 3D reconstruction technology, which is based on the rapid assembly design method of 3D embedded parts based on generalized parametric templates. Through a large number of feature points and linear data of a large number of buildings, a general parametric template of embedded parts can be established, including various information such as 3D parametric shape structure, installation and positioning method, and 2D projection sketch, so as to quickly carry out architectural CAD assistance Design rebuild work. The method in this paper has been integrated into the 3D CAD software Inters for commercial and industrial building structures and has been applied to practical engineering design.

articleTitle: Practical research on lane recognition and driving state monitoring method based on computer vision
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper mainly discusses the monitoring method of lane recognition analysis and real-time monitoring of driver driving status by vehicle-mounted camera using computer vision technology, and carries out practical research by combining the monitoring method with specific application scenarios. Driver face recognition and road straight line detection are implemented through OpenCV to provide certain auxiliary functions for driver driving. By using Yolov5 for fatigue detection and detection of objects such as cell phones and water cups, in order to improve driver concentration and enhance driving safety. More and more cars on the market are being equipped with driver assistance systems. Some research data shows that driver assistance systems can increase driving safety, but the high selling price reduces the audience. Cars belong to the category of durable goods, and there are still a large number of ordinary cars driving on the road. We have developed a low-cost, general vehicle-specific solution to this problem. This product does not require expensive LIDAR sensors and other equipment and does not require significant changes to the vehicle in terms of deployment. The software and hardware are low cost and cater to the market demand. The latest technologies and frameworks such as OpenCV and Yolov5 are also used to develop face recognition and detection, item recognition, and blink count through training datasets.

articleTitle: Constructing Safe Flight Corridors for Quadrotor Navigation in Cluttered 3-D Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: As the use of quadcopters becomes more widespread, the need for safe and timely quadcopter flight increases. In particular, operating a quadrotor in a cluttered environment presents the challenge of non-convex obstacles and safe flight trajectory generation. This paper presents two methods for generating the safe flight corridor (SFC) step in the three steps of quadrotor 3D trajectory planning, octree-based flight corridor generation, and inflated ellipsoid flight corridor generation, and verifies their superiority by comparing them with existing algorithms (RRT* based planning and IRIS) through an experimental method of computer simulation. Finally, the limitations of both methods are presented and conjectures for solutions are made based on the establishment and experimental validation methods of both methods.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Detection Using ResNet with Hyperparameter Tuning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: There are more than 2 million new cases of breast cancer each year, which is one of the leading causes of death worldwide. Early diagnosis improves cure rates and reduces mortality and misdiagnosis. However, a common way to diagnose breast cancer is based on mammographic images, which may misdiagnose. In this paper, a convolutional neural network with a pre-trained Residual Neural Network (ResNet) is proposed to diagnose breast cancer based on histology images. The proposed model employs ResNet to extract features from the images, then classify them into benign or malignant. Then a hyperparameter tuning process using the hyperband algorithm is applied to find the optimal hyperparameters in the model. To verify the effectiveness of the proposed method, the default model is compared with the models from tuning results using the histopathological images from other datasets. The comparison result is based on the AUC, ROC, validation accuracy, and validation loss. The experimental results demonstrate that the best-modified model has a 99.63 percent of validation accuracy. The analyses illustrate that the modified ResNet model performs better on detect breast cancer based on histopathological images than the default model.

articleTitle: Optimization Model of Industrial Engineering Neural Network Algorithm Based on Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, a neural network optimization method for analyzing rotor failure problems in industrial engineering is established. A new fault detection method based on neural network is proposed for the traditional fault detection technology. At the same time, a new combined mode analysis method is used to discretize it to obtain the IMF of a characteristic mode. It can reflect the different frequency components of the original system. The higher the correlation with the initial signal, the higher the correlation degree of the IMF component. In this paper, a neural network is used to perform the relationship between the sampling characteristic vector and the failure. This paper proposes a novel multi-scale one-dimensional convolutional neural network for fault detection of electric motors. Finally, the experimental results show that the algorithm is effective in different working environments and noisy conditions.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Method for Transient Stability Assessment of Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Machine learning is playing an increasingly important role in transient stability assessment. However, as the scale of power grids gradually expands, the number of data dimensions also increases greatly, which places higher demands on the performance of the model. In this paper, based on the physical characteristics of the power grid, a feature set that can reflect the operating state of the power system is defined and a Pearson correlation analysis is performed. The XGBoost model is then constructed and applied to the transient stability assessment process, which solves the shortcomings of traditional machine learning models in terms of poor interpretation and draws decision boundaries for different classification models for the important features. The results show that the XGBoost algorithm has good predictive performance in terms of accuracy and recall.

articleTitle: Research on Accurate Timing System of Dispatching Automation Communication under Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: IEC61850 has a very high accuracy requirement for sampling value synchronization accuracy. A protocol conforming to IEEE1588 is proposed in this paper. It can be used for a new scheme of precise time synchronization in distributed system protection communication and the software and hardware structure model is given. At the same time, this paper presents a method to quantitatively evaluate the reliability of PTP using fault tree analysis. Then the system theoretically calculates the availability of PTP network structure recommended by IEEEPC37238. The system can set up a time scale generator independently and realize the function of boundary clock for switches. It is found that IEEE1588 protocol can realize the precision and safety requirements of clock synchronization in the whole power network.

articleTitle: A novel smart substation secondary circuit simulation training system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Compared with traditional substations, the secondary circuit of smart substations is quite different in terms of transmission channel and protection function realization, which puts forward higher requirements for the knowledge level and business capabilities of smart substation operation and maintenance personnel. It is necessary to develop a set of teaching tools suitable for the training of secondary circuits in smart substations. This paper proposes a set of smart substation simulation secondary circuit simulation training system. The system builds the dynamic drawing model of the secondary schematic diagram, secondary wiring diagram, and secondary expansion diagram of the smart substation through visual modeling tools; with the help of the drawing monitoring module, the system can monitor the status of drawing elements in real time, dynamically calculate the input and output of drawings, and record the action sequence of elements; the system can build training cases based on typical protection action events and alarm events of smart substations. Thus, the system can be used to carry out drawing recognition training and defect tracking training for the secondary circuit of smart substations. This system enriches the content of the simulation training of smart substation secondary circuit, and has achieved good results in practical applications.

articleTitle: Research on Integrated Energy System Data Set Monitoring System Based on RPA Process Automation Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Integrated energy system integration is an important technical measure to realize energy saving, emission reduction and energy saving. Loads in energy systems tend to vary non-linearly within a specific period. Aiming at the automatic control technology of RPA process, this paper uses Kalman filter to forecast the short-term comprehensive load of energy. In this paper, the model is used to make short-term forecast of energy comprehensive load. It shows that this method is better than Kalman filter in prediction accuracy. MATLAB simulation results show that this method can open a new path for short-term load forecasting of energy systems.

articleTitle: A Skin Cancer Detection System Based on CNN with Hair Removal
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Skin cancer refers to a malignant skin tumor of different types, with a high morbidity and fatality rate. Since skin cancer could be easily cured during the early phase, skin cancer diagnosis becomes considerable. Numerous methods have been employed to categorize skin cancer in recent years because of the advancement of deep learning and image processing techniques. Nevertheless, fewer methods are deployed for the general public. In this paper, a web application is developed based on the convolutional neural network (CNN) to effectively diagnose skin cancer. First, the HAM10000 dataset is preprocessed using the Dull Razor algorithm to remove the hairs on the skin to reduce distraction. In addition, random oversampling techniques and data augmentation are used to enlarge the dataset to handle the overfitting problems. Eight convolutional layers are used in the model's architecture to extract features, while four max pooling layers are used to reduce noise. Besides that, batch normalization and dropout layers are also utilized to deal with the overfitting problems and increase training speed. Then the model is compiled on Nadam optimizer with a 0.002 learning rate and 128 as batch size for 100 epochs. The CNN model reaches 0.9703 in accuracy and 0.0844 in loss on the testing data. Based on the Flask web framework, the model is deployed for users to submit their skin images and get predictions.

articleTitle: Research on pedestrian collision test method based on depth learning algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The research on automatic driving test scenarios and collision warning methods is of great significance to the training and test verification of vehicle active safety and accelerated automatic driving algorithm. This paper deeply studies the in-depth learning algorithm, incorporates the common active safety technology in the autonomous driving scene, uses the principle of back propagation to carry out pedestrian collision detection, and analyzes different types of vehicle and pedestrian head collision test results, and verifies the effectiveness of the proposed pedestrian collision simulation algorithm, provides technical reference for the real-time collision warning model and collision avoidance strategy of intelligent connected vehicles.

articleTitle: Algorithm optimization of multi-source heterogeneous big data in the context of cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Nowadays, Internet technology has rapidly spread to all over the world, which brings a large amount of information data, and how to achieve efficient processing in these rapidly growing heterogeneous data has become a research hotspot in the field of big data nowadays. For this hotspot, this paper firstly introduces multi-source heterogeneous and cloud computing, and then proposes a multisource heterogeneous big data optimization method, which obtains big data information sources for data scheduling priority calculation by threshold comparison in the context of cloud computing, determines data by priority value, and selects suitable processors for execution, and proves that this algorithm has the advantages of higher acceleration ratio and throughput by comparing this algorithm with traditional big data scheduling methods.

articleTitle: A Study of Stroke Prevalence Prediction Based on Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Brain stroke is one of the diseases with a high mortality rate worldwide, and it is a great threat to the health of people around the world. In this paper, the data were firstly processed by SMOTE to avoid the problem of oversampling, and then mathematical models based on random forest algorithm, support vector machine and logistic regression were developed to predict the risk of stroke based on the existing data. When comparing the prediction results of each model, the prediction accuracy of the model based on the random forest algorithm was the highest (accuracy = 96.94%), while the prediction results of the support vector machine and logistic regression were slightly lower than those of the random forest (support vector machine accuracy = 76.40%; logistic regression accuracy = 94.51%). In terms of the ROC curve and recall of the data, the random forest model achieved an AUC value of 97.46%, proving its excellent prediction performance.

articleTitle: Two dimensional wave power analysis based on Simulink simulation and particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: As an important marine renewable resource, wave energy can be researched, developed and utilized to help achieve sustainable development of energy resources. The energy conversion efficiency of wave energy devices is one of the key issues in the large-scale utilization of wave energy. The wave energy device studied in this paper consists of a float, an oscillator, a central axis and a PTO system. The float consists of a cylindrical shell and a conical shell, with a compartment between them as a support surface for the installation of the center shaft. The cylindrical shaped oscillator is threaded on the central shaft and is connected to the base through the PTO system. When a wave is applied to the device, the float moves first and then the oscillator is moved, and the relative motion of the two drives the work of the damper and outputs it as energy.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Control and Regulation System of Central Air Conditioning Based on Computer Automatic Control Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Based on the computer automatic control technology, this paper designs the energy efficiency optimization method for the traditional water-cooled central air conditioning host system. The chilled water control based on load prediction fuzzy control and the cooling water control based on adaptive fuzzy algorithm are used in the system, and the cooling water supply of the chiller is matched with the end load demand, and the cooling water system is running at maximum efficiency. Then on the basis of the single point fault tolerance design and the key points of energy-saving automatic control design, the design effect of HVAC system in data room is analyzed. Compared with PID control and single neural network reinforcement learning control, the total energy consumption of the system is reduced by 5.36% and 1.64%, and the total proportion of non-comfort time is reduced by 2.32% and 1.37%, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Food Processors Supervision System for Smart City Construction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Driven by the new generation of information technology, smart city has gradually become a hot word in the new era. Smart city is to strive to achieve the deep integration of industrialization and urbanization, which improve the quality of urbanization and the quality of life of citizens, enhancing the effectiveness of urban management. In addition, with the substantial improvement of economy and science, people's pursuit of food has gradually shifted from being full to being safe and nutritious. Based on this background, food safety has become the focus of social attention. At present, there are still loopholes in China's food safety system, which fails to fully implement the technological level in the construction of food safety. The grass-roots supervision and risk prediction mechanism are not perfect enough. The State Council has issued policy documents continuously, emphasizing the full implementation of food safety, pointing out that the most important thing in market supervision at this stage is food safety. At the same time, today, with the sustainable development of smart cities, the related technologies of food safety are not yet mature. This paper proposes an intelligent food processor supervision system, which can supervise food processors by checking masks, overalls and foreign objects in hands. As mask wearing detection and overalls wearing detection have become mature, this paper uses YOLOv5 algorithm to realize real-time hand foreign object detection, realizes intelligent supervision of food processors, liberates manpower to identify and shortens inspection time and greatly improves efficiency and accuracy.

articleTitle: UAV formation optimization model based on ant colony algorithm and particle swarm optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Based on the research of azimuth-only passive positioning of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) flying in formation, this paper establishes a reasonable positioning information determination mode, which can effectively analyze and judge the flight status of UAVs, minimize the positioning time and improve the accuracy. Based on the ant colony algorithm, for the determination of uav in the signal receiving process, to simulate the way of by drone signal more comprehensive to determine the location of the unmanned aerial vehicle (uav), according to the direction of the received information for unmanned aerial vehicle (uav) position adjustment, through data analysis and calculation more reasonable distribution of unmanned aerial vehicle (uav) location scheme, then using the particle swarm optimization (pso) algorithm, To further optimize the positioning problem of different types of formation UAVs, the previous model is still adopted. At the same time, the particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to improve, upgrade and optimize the latest position of UAVs, and the two groups of reasonable and accurate flight modes and schemes under the conical formation are summarized.

articleTitle: Design of three-dimensional warehouse access material control system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern production technology and the continuous prosperity of social material, the storage of planar warehouse for goods has been far from meeting the current needs, so the three-dimensional warehouse has become an important part of production and life, for the three-dimensional warehouse research is also in constant depth. This design mainly introduces the background of the subject research, the development and development trend of the three-dimensional warehouse, the mechanical equipment used in this design is briefly introduced, including the basic knowledge of PLC technology, and the use of the programming software (Siemens TIA Portal software) that is needed in this design is explained. The core part of this design, including the composition of the stereo warehouse access material system, working principle and equipment parameter configuration, control flow and PLC program. Stereo warehouse program design ladder diagram in the appendix to write for readers to understand the design. Through analyzing the characteristics of the storage requirements and the design, the integrated application of PLC control technology, servo control technology, network communication technology, etc., through two PLC S7-1200, one of them to control the level of the material car moving, another one PLC to control the material car vertical movement and feed control, two PLC site to exchange information communication way, Realize the cooperation, realize the automatic control of material in and out of the warehouse. This design fully meets the operation requirements of the storage and storage of materials in the three-dimensional warehouse, and realizes the automatic control of the storage and storage of materials in the three-dimensional warehouse. It greatly improves the work efficiency and reduces the waste of the corresponding production resources. Greatly improved the previous production level and production efficiency. At the same time, the automatic control of the three-dimensional warehouse can also provide great help for the upgrading of the logistics industry.

articleTitle: Optimized SVM based on improved whale algorithm for EEG signal pattern classification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to improve the classification accuracy of moving image electroencephalogram ( EEG ) signals, aiming at the problem that the traditional support vector machine (SVM ) parameter value is not accurate, which leads to poor classification model, this study introduces Sobol sequence, reverse learning strategy and piecewise nonlinear time-varying factor. In order to improve the random layout strategy of boundary processing, Levy flight strategy improves the traditional whale algorithm, combines the improved whale algorithm with SVM, and compares the combined SVM classifier with other classifiers for EEG signal classification. The results show that the accuracy of the optimization algorithm is 2 ~ 4 percentage points.

articleTitle: Automatic identification technology and realization of main and side lobe tracking of shipborne measurement and control radar based on digital guidance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: For shipborne measurement and control radar, in the process of tracking the target, how to correctly identify the main and side lobes of the target is very important, which is related to the accuracy and stability of the tracking. Aiming at the problem of identifying the main and side lobes of the shipborne radar without a guide antenna and only the main antenna, this paper proposes a method for identifying the main and side lobes based on digital guidance, which can realize the automatic identification of the main and side lobes by software.

articleTitle: Explore Effect of Connection Radius on Cascading Robustness of Spatial Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Previous research on the robustness of spatial networks has primarily focused on network topologies and attack schemes. However, the connection radius of the network’s nodes can also influence the network’s escalating robustness. In this essay, we investigate a novel component that affects the robustness of spatial networks with cascading failures by introducing the concept of target nodes. We discuss the impacts of the target nodes' connection radius on network robustness. Scale-free networks and random networks are two different forms of spatial network topologies that have their resilience performance evaluated.
