Moreover, based on the characteristics of the target nodes. The target nodes are designed based on new expansion tactics. The experimental results indicate that changing the connection radius of nodes will result in varying degrees of cascading network failure. Furthermore, cascading failures can occur in various situations and networks.

articleTitle: Electrical lighting design and intelligent control of a industry-education integration building through load calculation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper is the electrical design of a general industry-education integration training building - electrical lighting and anti-grounding system design, mainly including two aspects, namely the design of lighting and socket system, and the design of power supply and distribution system. Lighting includes general lighting and emergency lighting, and in the design process usually includes the selection of lighting fixtures and light sources, illuminance calculation and arrangement methods; The design of the socket system is arranged according to the needs of the project and the actual use. In this paper, radial power distribution is used to provide electrical energy, and the appropriate equipment is selected through load calculation. In order to provide reference for the design and construction of similar training buildings.

articleTitle: An upper monitor system design for security packet processing testing based on IEC 60870-5-104
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: To better test the FTU in distribution automation system, this paper designs the upper monitor software for testing the security packets based on IEC104. The article adopts the asynchronous communication to optimize the packet process method and solves the packet disorder, packet loss and retransmission problem which provides ideas for the design of security test system for power distribution terminal equipment.

articleTitle: Application of PlayMaker-based visual programming in VR mobile game production
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In the rapid development of the game market in recent years, the digital technology has also been developed accordingly. Games have become one of the main ways of entertainment, and people will increasingly experience games. For example, the immersive launch of experience VR games. This article will explain the use of Unity3D game engine to build a Cardboard VR android mobile game environment, and then through the game design elements in the engine (for example, connect the "lantern" programming, game 3D model, sound effects, etc.) to form a complete game.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Distributed Photovoltaic Grid Connection Scheme Based on New Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper firstly evaluates the solar radiation, ambient temperature, wind speed and other factors in the photovoltaic power station site area, as well as the situation of substations suitable for access voltage levels around the site to determine the rationality of photovoltaic power station site selection. On this basis, a feasible access system scheme is proposed. Secondly, this paper conducts a technical analysis of the feasible access system scheme through electrical calculations such as power flow, short circuit, reactive power compensation and so on. Demonstrate whether the power flow distribution of the relevant substations is reasonable after the photovoltaic power station is connected to the power grid, whether the power grid is unstable, and the short-circuit current exceeds the standard. And give a reasonable reactive power compensation scheme. Finally, this paper proposes a reasonable and reliable relay protection configuration scheme, scheduling automation configuration scheme and communication design scheme for the access system scheme of this project. This ensures the safe and stable operation of the power grid. The experimental simulation shows that the photovoltaic grid-connected scheme proposed in this paper is economical and practical.

articleTitle: Research on electricity theft identification methods using big data and large dimensional random matrix
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Qualitative evaluation of power theft suspicion based on large dimension, determination of quantitative judgment of power theft time zone, rapid identification of quantitative judgment of power consumption abnormality of key suspect users, identification of power theft behavior based on large dimensional random matrix theory and process, determination of power theft time zone of power theft users to achieve identification of power theft behavior.

articleTitle: Selecting a Suitable Portable X-ray Equipment Based on the Non-destructive Testing of Crimped Power Fittings on Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, we use different types of X-ray and pulse equipments to carry out some non-destructive testing experiments based on various aluminum and steel crimping type power fittings. A series of comparative experiments showed that the 80kV voltage ray equipment could not successfully penetrate our samples of steel or steel-aluminum alloy fittings. In fact, long-distance power transmission lines in China will involve power fittings of different materials, types and thicknesses, and in most cases, climbing power towers manually is required to carry out high-altitude flaw detection operations. Therefore, how to balance the relationship between the weight, voltage, penetration effect of X-ray equipments, personnel safety and test efficiency is a task worthy of in-depth investigation.

articleTitle: Multi-closed-loop Noise Model of MEMS Gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: MEMS gyroscope with closed-loop detection in mode-matched case has good overall performance, and it is one of the micro-gyroscope schemes with development potential at present. However, the existence of multiple closed loops makes noise sources of measurement and control system more. By constructing noise model, the contribution of each noise source to zero rate output can be quantified, and the influence of structure and circuit parameters on noise performance parameter can be found out. In this paper, the generation mechanism of mechanical thermal noise, pre-amplifier noise, feed-through noise and other noises in gyroscope resonant system is studied, and three noise coupling paths from driving loop to detection loop are constructed, thus the gyro system-level noise model is constructed.

articleTitle: Exploration and Application of Transformer Substation Automation Data Channel Based on UHF Wireless Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: According to the investigation of automation test task in the construction of new energy transformer substation, it is found that the automatic data channel of OPGW fibre-optical high-voltage line is delayed due to various reasons, which seriously affects the project grid-connected power generation. Therefore, the automation test before the project is put into operation must look for a reliable wireless data channel to replace the formal fiber-optic communication channel, in order to complete the relevant electrical automation test tasks. According to the characteristics and advantages of UHF wireless technology, this paper studies deeply the realization method of communication link based on UHF wireless technology, and fully demonstrates the flexibility of UHF wireless technology as an advance debugging channel in transformer substation construction, it has a positive development prospect.

articleTitle: Research on SDN Network Structure Optimization System Based on Computer 5G Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Based on computer 5G technology, this paper proposes a SDN architecture application scheme for tactical access network topology. Firstly, aiming at the network delay problem existing in the new IVN architecture, this paper establishes a low-latency optimization mechanism. Then this paper uses the device hierarchy to optimize the network topology to achieve the maximum separation of device routing control and data forwarding. Thirdly, the link utilization weight is introduced to optimize the equivalent multipath selection algorithm. The experimental results show that the optimized traffic load is more balanced, the delay, jitter and packet loss rate of packets are significantly reduced, and the network scalability, security and transmission quality are significantly improved.

articleTitle: Multi-Scale Pedestrian Detection Algorithm Based on YOLOv3
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Deep learning has excellent achievements in computer vision such as pedestrian detection. Based on YOLOv3 algorithm, this paper introduces CBAM to improve the feature representation ability and improve the overall accuracy of target detection. Then the easy to implement CSPNet is used to reduce the computational workload while maintaining the original accuracy. The experimental results based on INRIA dataset show that after the introduction of CBAM attention module and CSPNet, the efficiency and accuracy of object detection are improved, so it has better performance.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Energy Management of Fuel Cell Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the development of fuel cell technology, how to effectively reduce hydrogen consumption of fuel cell vehicles has become a technical focus and difficulty. This paper proposed an adaptive energy management algorithm which was suitable for fuel cell vehicles. First, the ECMS algorithm considering the durability of the fuel cell was established. In order to ensure the good performance of the ECMS algorithm, an equivalent factor optimization model was established, which adjusted the equivalent factor according to the changes of battery SOC and future velocity. Considering that in the actual driving environment, it was impossible to accurately obtain the upcoming driving velocity in the future. Therefore, it was hard to quickly adjust and select the equivalent factor. This article established a neural network velocity prediction model, and the predicted velocity were provided to the equivalent factor optimization model, and the adaptive energy management algorithm was accomplished. Simulation results showed that the adaptive algorithm reduced hydrogen consumption by 2.6% compared to the basic ECMS algorithm, while battery SOC was in a suitable wording window.

articleTitle: Real-time flight path conflict detection method based on space box
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Flight conflict detection is an important guarantee for flight safety. The traditional real-time flight conflict detection is based on probability, statistics and geometry. Conflict calculation is performed on air targets in turn. The common shortcomings such as large amount of calculation, high complexity, time delay and poor stability do not apply to the air traffic control system in large-scale airspace. In recent years, with the development and application of multiprocessor and distributed computing technology, a real-time flight path conflict detection method based on space box is presented, which can be used in distributed computing environment to solve the problem of flight conflict detection in large-scale airspace air traffic control system. The algorithm transforms conflict detection that used to be centered on air targets into centered on space boxes. First, the air traffic control airspace is divided into cube-shaped space boxes. Calculate the space box where the target location is located based on the received target spot information. Then, the number of air targets in the space box is counted, and track conflicts are calculated for multiple batches of targets in the same space box to determine the possibility of conflicts. The simulation results show that the calculation time reaches 10 milliseconds, the computational complexity is greatly reduced, and the operation is stable. It can be used in engineering applications directly.

articleTitle: Grid-connected Debugging Method of Digital Power Grid Based on LR Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: As an important data analysis method, LR has been widely used in many fields. In applications to practical classification problems, LR tends to give good results. However, traditional LR has significant weaknesses in overcoming the complexity and redundancy of the solution. To this end, many solutions have been proposed, which tend to be a common approach with few results. The main purpose of this paper is to research and design the debugging method of digital grid connection (GC) based on the logistic regression model (LRM). On this basis, this paper proposes an accurate autoregressive model and provides detailed information to ensure the reliability and excellence of the model, which is verified by experiments. The experimental results show that using different classification methods, the test error and selection of data sets have different results. It can be seen that the ten-fold cross-validation error for adaptive elastic net LR is 1/38 and the test error is 1/34. Compared with other methods, the classification performance of adaptive elastic net LR is also superior, even better than other classification methods.

articleTitle: A theory of causal inference based on additive noise model and its application to radiological security projects
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Security is particularly important in the process of radioactive material transportation. In order to solve the impact of the uncertain dynamic characteristics of the actual system and the complex uncertain noise containing in the target tracking and positioning of BDS(BeiDou Navigation Satellite System), an algorithm of causal inference is constructed to explain and deal with the state estimation method of the complex uncertain noise system. The measurement of noise variance is performed by using the covariance matching principle and real-time updated noise data with additive measurement noise of the system. an adaptive process detection model is proposed for the modeling problem of the Kalman filter. In comparing and testing the models, The adaptive process measurement model can give ideal estimation results regardless of the initial value of the measurement noise variance in the results. The paper demonstrates that the adaptive process measurement model has good robustness and is highly effective in dealing with state estimation problems for systems with noise which is complex and uncertain.

articleTitle: Research on Wireless Network System Based on Computer Mobile Communication Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper uses data aggregation to reduce the amount of data transmission. Then this paper uses the network dynamic change structure to plan efficient transmission. The system solves the problem of limited computing capacity of mobile terminals through the capability of multi-stage computing nodes in cooperative network. Then, this paper uses intelligent transmission mechanism to overcome the unstable transmission capability of mobile channel through efficient spectrum sensing, layered coding and adaptive air mouth transmission. Finally, this paper uses the idea of dynamic programming to carry out data aggregation transmission time planning in aggregation routing tree to eliminate intra-tree conflicts. And the experiment is carried out on the real taxi moving trajectory dataset. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm improves the data collection rate by about 1/4 compared with the existing algorithms, and the average delay of the collected data is also smaller.

articleTitle: Application of LSTM Neural Network Based on Grid Search Optimization in ThinkPHP Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In light of the swift advancement of network technology, the hidden dangers of network security become more and more obvious. Therefore, network security talent development is receiving increasing attention from colleges and institutions. However, how to improve students' comprehensive quality and carry out scientific and effective academic supervision is still an important problem to be solved urgently. To address this issue, this paper uses the learning behavior data of students from a university in China in the self-developed ThinkPHP network information security attack and defense training platform, proposes to use LSTM recurrent neural network model to predict the course performance, and optimizes the search for model parameters using the grid search technique. Additionally, in order to thoroughly assess the model's performance, RMSE and MAPE model performance assessment indicators will be utilized to validate the model's performance. The experimental results show that the model can accurately predict students' course achievement, and help teachers to improve teaching methods and teaching quality to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Build a real-time building segmentation network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Recently, most existing building segmentation networks have high memory usage and computational resource. And a large number of methods of the lightweight model have problems, such as the sharp decrease in segmentation performance due to parameter reduction, limited arithmetic power and real-time. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a new lightweight network based on the SGUnet segmentation network. Our network is a hourglass-like-depth-separable-convolution-based sgbunet segmentation network, pruning the sgnet and using residual connections. The core idea is that, shallow features are more important in lightweight networks. According to this point of view, increasing the proportion of features in the shallow part of the model successfully improved the accuracy of the model by 1%. Finally, the Cheap operation module is reused to further reduce the amount of network parameters. In the end, the parameter amount of the network is reduced from the original 260k to 70k, which greatly reduces the amount of model parameters.The sgbunet segmentation network have a reletive improvement, achieving 97.329 and 80.823 for Accuracy and Miou respectively in the building segmentation.

articleTitle: Structure Design and Analysis on Crane Boom Detection Device
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The crane boom, as the main load-bearing component in the lifting process of the crane, is susceptible to cracks and other defects caused by the bending moment when lifting the load. For the purpose of defect detection of crane boom, a device is designed to automatically crawl along the boom and carry out full-coverage detection of the boom’s magnetic field. Based on the profile and variable section of the boom, the detection device is modeled in three dimensions with SolidWorks. The detection device was statically analyzed at the maximum boom elevation with the finite-element simulation software ANSYS Workbench, the structural strength was verified, and the rationality of the design was validated via the development of the prototype device.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Retrieval Algorithms for Recommendation Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The recommendation system is an important technology to solve information overload and capture users' interests, which is widely used in recommendation platforms such as e-commerce, movies, and books. The overall process of a recommendation system is that candidate items enter the recommendation system, a small number of items that users may be interested in are filtered by the retrieval layer, and then the final recommendation list is obtained by more precise filtering by the ranking layer. As the first stage of the recommendation system, the retrieval layer’s efficiency determines the ability of the recommendation system to quickly filter information, and it determines the upper limit of the ranking effect. However, few works have elaborated the retrieval layer in detail. Since the great achievements of deep learning techniques in recommendation systems, this paper focuses on the deep learning methods often used in the retrieval layer, which is of referenceable significance for the optimization of recommendation systems.

articleTitle: Research on Frequency Modulation Capability of Motor Generator Pair Driven via Photovoltaic Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Large-scale new energy units connected to the grid can reduce the inertia of the power system, and the motor generator pair (MGP) can provide a real, time-free inertia response for the grid. Based on the structure of MGP grid-connected system, the electric-mechanical model of MGP is established, and the inertia response principle of MGP and virtual inertia control is compared. By comparing the similarities and differences of frequency response between traditional unit and new energy synchronizer, an active power control strategy based on photovoltaic load shedding operation and droop control is proposed. The inertia response ability of MGP and the effectiveness of the improved control strategy are verified in the simulation system with 3 machines and 9 nodes. Furthermore, the improvement effect of the proposed strategy on the frequency modulation ability of photovoltaic is verified by comparing with the virtual inertia and droop control strategy. The simulation results generated from PSCAD/EMTDC show that the improved control strategy can enhance the frequency response ability of photovoltaic grid connected by MGP.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of the all-in-one machine for killing and sorting in the small and medium-sized logistics center
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: To stop the COVID-19 spread, artificial intelligence and new technologies are also actively participating in the battle. For fighting against the virus, disinfection is one of the effective ways to block the spread of the virus. According to the preliminary market research, only in the large distribution centers is the operator-controlled machine disinfection, at present most of the small and medium-sized express logistics stations are through human resources to carry out disinfection, and sorting of express packages, so the dependence on human costs, medical resources can be imagined. To this end, we designed ultrasonic atomization disinfection, sorting, and whole load notification integrated machine based on deep learning <sup>[1]</sup> and Internet of Things <sup>[2]</sup> technology to cope with the trend of normalization and recurrence of the epidemic. After testing logistics with different labels, the experimental results show that the system can effectively distinguish different labels and carry out a series of operations such as disinfection, sorting, and notification of full load, which can be put into production and contribute to epidemic prevention work.

articleTitle: Research on Python Crawler Search System Based on Computer Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper uses Python crawler technology, designed a commodity collection and analysis method. The system uses Python operation automation testing framework to simulate manual web browsing to bypass the complex anti-crawler encryption algorithm edited by complex JavaScript in some dynamic web pages and obtain the specified page information. This article uses the Requests library to download the resulting item information from searches by keyword. Both regular expressions and Beautiful Soup were used for initial cleaning of the data. Finally, the system stores the data into MongoDB database. Practice shows that Python language has very high feasibility and effectiveness, which not only ensures the implementation effect of web crawler framework, but also improves the performance of web crawler system. The system brings good user experience.

articleTitle: Improved ViT-Based Fine-grained Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The transformer architecture, originally used in the NLP tasks, is recently applied in computer vision tasks. The accuracy is improved when taking the ViT block into consideration. However, the improvement is limited since the Vit focuses on local details and breaks the global coherence of the image. In this paper, progressive multi-step training and knowledge distillation strategies are adopted in the vision transformer, preserving and providing more information from the macro view. The model progressively learns the information stored in the image crossing multiple granularities by adopting progressive training. After processing the whole image, the learned identifiable features flow into the self-distillation framework making it possible for massive data scale tasks. The experiments are conducted on several generally used datasets, and the output performance achieves a distinctive increase in accuracy when working on the CUB, CAR and AIR datasets compared to current state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Study on breakdown characteristics of BOPP film under multi-frequency field strength
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, the typical engineering application scenario simulation model of BOPP film is established, and the typical operating voltage waveform characteristics are obtained by simulation analysis. Based on this, the breakdown field strength test platform of the film under AC and DC composite voltage is established, and the breakdown field strength of typical size metallized film under different harmonic content and different harmonic times is measured. The test results show that the breakdown field strength peak of the metallized film is basically the same as that under pure DC voltage when the number of DC superimposed harmonics is not more than 5 times and the harmonic voltage is not more than 600 Vrms. Therefore, when designing BOPP film insulation, the peak operating voltage can be equivalent to pure DC voltage. Insulation design also needs to consider the overvoltage multiple requirements and insulation safety margin of the capacitor.

articleTitle: Research on Noise Control Technology of DC Fast Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the rapid development of new energy vehicles, the vehicle pile ratio is still far from the planning goal. With the continuous improvement of the charging power of the charging pile, its noise also increases, and the complaints from residents are also increasing. Taking the noise of DC fast charging station as the research object, the noise characteristics and control scheme of the charging station are studied. The test results show that the sound pressure level of the charging pile noise is 65.4~80.1dB (A). In addition to low frequency noise, there is high frequency noise of 1000-3500Hz. On the basis of the sound insulation barrier scheme, the inlet and outlet of each charging pile shall be equipped with silencing elbows, which can make the sensitive buildings meet the requirements of less than 50 dB(A).
